line: But it's more than that. He means something to you. Something personal?

title: Improbable Cause
line: Ah, now you've just moved from deduction to supposition.

title: Improbable Cause
line: You're not the kind of man who would go to such lengths simply to repay a debt.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Are you trying to say that I have no sense of honor?

title: Improbable Cause
line: That remains to be seen.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Yes.

title: Improbable Cause
line: You wouldn't risk going into Cardassian space for just anyone. It would have to be someone important to you, someone you cared about. I think you were more than Tain's advisor. I think you were his protégé and he was your mentor. That is, until he sent you into exile. And yet, despite that, you care enough about him to risk your life for him. Or is all that just supposition?

title: Improbable Cause
line: A very interesting analysis. Very interesting. Particularly coming from you.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Oh?

title: Improbable Cause
line: It's been my observation that you always act from a sense of justice, or at least what you consider justice. There's no feeling behind what you do, no emotion beyond a certain distaste for loose ends and disorder. You don't know what it means to care about someone, do you? People are just interesting creatures to be studied and analyzed.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Is there any point to this?

title: Improbable Cause
line: Only that I find it interesting that you ascribe feelings and motivations to me that you know nothing about. Or am I wrong? Tell me, is there one person in this universe you do care for? One person who's more than just an interesting puzzle to be solved. Is there, Odo? Anyone?

title: Improbable Cause
line: If there were, I certainly wouldn't tell you.

title: Improbable Cause
line: And that would be a wise decision.

title: Improbable Cause
line: I'm taking us out of warp. We're approaching the Unefra system.

title: Improbable Cause
line: What's that?

title: Improbable Cause
line: I'm detecting a subspace energy surge directly above us. A vessel of some kind is decloaking.

title: Improbable Cause
line: It's a Romulan warbird.

title: Improbable Cause
line: In Cardassian space?

title: Improbable Cause
line: They've locked onto us with a tractor beam. Take the helm. I'm going to try to send out a distress signal.

title: Improbable Cause
line: I can't pull away. The tractor lock is too strong.

title: Improbable Cause
line: They're jamming our transmission.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Do you think you got through?

title: Improbable Cause
line: I don't know. I'm going to hail them, see what they want.

title: Improbable Cause
line: I think we're about to find out.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Tain.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Ah, Garak. It's good of you to come. It spares me the trouble of having to send someone else to kill you. Come in, come in. It's been a long time, Elim. So, you're a tailor now. Is this one of your creations?

title: Improbable Cause
line: A minor example of my work, yes.

title: Improbable Cause
line: I don't think I like the neckline.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Well you always did have a keen sense of fashion, but you seem to have let it go along with your once trim figure.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Constable Odo, I've always wanted to meet you.

title: Improbable Cause
line: I wish I could say the same.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Oh come now. Haven't you ever been the least bit curious about me, about my relationship with Garak, or our work in the Obsidian Order?

title: Improbable Cause
line: I seldom waste time speculating about retired spymasters and their associates.

title: Improbable Cause
line: He's good. He hides his true feelings almost as well as you do, Elim. He'd have made a good operative in the old days.

title: Improbable Cause
line: I had the same thought myself. But then, those days are long gone. At least they are for me. You, on the other hand, seem to have left your retirement far behind. Unless you're simply on a pleasure cruise with your pointed-eared friends.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Cunning, isn't he? He makes a racial slur within earshot of two Romulans, putting me in the position of either defending them, thus giving away my allegiance to them, or letting the comment pass, in which case he's managed to plant a seed of discord between us.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Frankly, I don't find any of this interesting. You both go to such lengths to hide the true meaning of your words you end up saying nothing.

title: Improbable Cause
line: I think you'll find when I have something to say, you won't have any trouble understanding it. To answer your question, Garak, no I'm not on a pleasure cruise. This ship is part of a fleet of Romulan and Cardassian vessels. A fleet that will very soon be traveling through the wormhole into the Gamma Quadrant.

title: Improbable Cause
line: I take it you're not on a mission of peaceful exploration.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Not exactly.

title: Improbable Cause
line: You're going to attack the Dominion, aren't you. You're going to stage a first strike against them before they can come into the Alpha Quadrant.

title: Improbable Cause
line: A clear and precise analysis. Commander Sisko must find you a valuable advisor.

title: Improbable Cause
line: A daring plan. I didn't think there was anyone in the Central Command bold enough to take on the Dominion.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Who said anything about the Central Command? This is a joint operation between the Obsidian Order and the Tal Shiar. We've been building a fleet of ships in the Orias System for months now.

title: Improbable Cause
line: If you attack the Dominion they'll certainly strike back. You'll be taking Romulus and Cardassia into war. A war you may not win.

title: Improbable Cause
line: I don't think they'll be striking back. Our intention is to wipe out the Dominion in one single blow by eliminating the Founders. Without them, the Dominion will collapse. You seem disturbed by this, changeling. Why? After all, didn't you turn your back on your people.

title: Improbable Cause
line: You seem to know a great deal about me and my people.

title: Improbable Cause
line: We know everything you know, including the location of their homeworld.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Starfleet has shared their intelligence on the Dominion with the Romulans.

title: Improbable Cause
line: And the Romulans have shared it with me.

title: Improbable Cause
line: You'll forgive me if I reduce the scope of this conversation to something a little more personal, but why was it necessary to kill me and the rest of our former colleagues, in order to embark on this excursion into the Gamma Quadrant?

title: Improbable Cause
line: Because, Garak, I don't plan on going back into retirement when this is over. I plan on going back to my old job and my old life.

title: Improbable Cause
line: And you were afraid we knew things, things that could be used against you, and so you decided to have us eliminated.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Like I used to say. Always burn your bridges behind you. You never know who might be trying to follow.

title: Improbable Cause
line: You always used to say as well that the Tal Shiar was sloppy. You never should have relied on them to burn your bridges.

title: Improbable Cause
line: True. They should never have hired the Flaxian to blow up your shop.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Actually, I blew up my shop. It was a way of piquing the interest of the good constable.

title: Improbable Cause
line: You blew up your own shop? You, my friend, are a true original. If you hadn't betrayed me, things would have been very different.

title: Improbable Cause
line: I never betrayed you! At least, not in my heart. Why do you think I'm here? I came because I thought the Romulans were trying to kill you. I came here to save you.

title: Improbable Cause
line: I never thought I'd hear myself say this, Garak, but I believe you. You can go.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Excuse me?

title: Improbable Cause
line: The changeling of course will have to stay, but you're free to go. Your runabout is in launching bay three.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Just like that?

title: Improbable Cause
line: Just like that.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Aren't you concerned that I might warn Central Command and Starfleet about your plans?

title: Improbable Cause
line: It's too late. Central Command will have a war on its hands, whether it wants one or not. And as for Starfleet, this isn't their fight. They won't interfere.

title: Improbable Cause
line: It's a trick, Garak. After all this, he won't let you just walk away.

title: Improbable Cause
line: It's not a trick, it's a choice. You can walk out that door, or join me.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Join you?

title: Improbable Cause
line: That is what you've been waiting for, isn't it? To end your exile, to come back into the fold. I'm asking you to serve Cardassia again, by my side.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Well you'll pardon me if I appear a little startled, but are you saying that all is forgiven?

title: Improbable Cause
line: I can't forgive what you did but I can try to forget, to put it aside as if it never happened. So, do you want to go back to your shop and hem pants or shall we pick up where we left off?

title: Improbable Cause
line: Garak, this is the man who put you into exile. This is the man who just two days ago tried to have you killed.

title: Improbable Cause
line: Yes, he is. But it doesn't matter. I'm back. To be continued...

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I found twenty seven voles in his storeroom.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Vole infestations are not uncommon on this station. If you don't believe me, ask Chief O'Brien.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: When I came in, he and Morn were painting numbers on the voles' backs.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: We were just counting them to see how many we'd caught.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: You were getting ready to stage a vole fight.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: A vole fight? I'm appalled. Do you really think that was what Morn was up to?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Constable, I want the voles confiscated and removed from the station.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: You can't confiscate Morn's voles. They're like his pets.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I'll see if I can get him some goldfish. Now, gentlemen, if you will excuse me, it's late.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Poor Morn. This is going to break his hearts.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Ops is yours, Lieutenant.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: You going somewhere, Chief?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Sir, I need to talk to you. It's kind of private.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: We were just leaving. Come on, let's go break the news to Morn.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Do you want to talk in my office?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Actually, I thought we might go to my place.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Commander.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Stand down.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Get on the transporter pad. Move.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Computer, energize on my command.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Energize.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Where are we?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I guess you could say we just stepped through the looking glass.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Sit down. Make yourself comfortable.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Right now I'm not feeling very comfortable.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: There. That's better.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: That was a pretty nice move.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I'm glad you liked it.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Of course, it doesn't change anything. You can't go home unless I reconfigure the transporter, and I'm not about to do that. I guess you've got a lot of questions.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Not as many as you think.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: You know where we are?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: If I had to guess, I'd say that this is the same parallel universe that two of my crewmembers visited a year ago.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: You're quick. Just like our Sisko. That saves me having to give you a history lesson. But I'd better update you on current events. Since your officers left here, we've started a rebellion against the Klingon-Cardassian Alliance. We're fighting for our lives.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I wish you luck, but I don't see what that has to do with me.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: It has everything to do with you. You were the leader of the Terran Rebellion. At least, our Benjamin Sisko was.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Was?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Captain Sisko's dead. The Cardassians blew up his ship.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Ah. So you want me to take his place.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Like I said, you're quick.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Well, I've got a better idea. We're going to walk back to the transporter pad and you're going to send me home.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Wait. Hear me out. I'm not asking for a lifetime commitment. All I need is for you to finish the mission Sisko was on when he was killed.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I'm sorry, but you're going to have to find someone else. I don't belong here and I'm not about to interfere with events going on in this universe.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: At least let me tell you about the mission. And then if you decide not to help, I'll send you home. There's a Terran scientist working for the Alliance. Our sources tell us she's close to completing a new transpectral sensor array that will allow the Alliance to locate our bases in the Badlands. Without a safe place to hide, the Alliance will be able to track us down and kill us all.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: So, you want me to prevent this scientist from finishing her project?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Captain Sisko was convinced he could change her mind, get her to work for us instead.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: How did he plan to do that?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: She was his wife.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Jennifer.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: You know her?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: She was my wife too. But in my universe, she's dead.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Not here she isn't. Not yet, anyway.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: What do you mean not yet?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Unless you can persuade Professor Sisko to join our cause, we'll have no choice but to kill her.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Kill her?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: We cannot let her finish the sensor array. It'd mean the end of the rebellion.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I can't let her die. Not again.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: You're the only one who can save her.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Delectable. And so are you.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Enter.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Mister Garak said you wanted to see me.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Yes. Come. Join us.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: If you're wondering when the new sensor array will be finished, the answer is

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: As soon as possible. I know.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Will that be all? I have to get back to work.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I have news of your husband.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Nothing you could tell me about Ben would interest me. I haven't even seen him in five years.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I know that. And I hope that will make this easier for you. You see, Benjamin is dead.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Can I go now?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: You must've loved him very much to be so angry with him. To have become so cold.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Were other Terrans killed with him?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: A whole ship full.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: All this killing, it has to stop.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: And it will. As soon as you complete your transpectral sensors we'll be able to locate the rebel bases, disarm them and put an end to all this bloodshed. And I will be able to resume pressing the Alliance to become more reasonable to its Terran population. You do believe me, don't you?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: So it's agreed. I help you get Jennifer away from the Alliance, and then you get me home.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: You get us Jennifer, you can have anything you want. I just hope you can convince her to leave Terok Nor.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I don't understand what Jennifer's doing helping the Alliance in the first place. I mean, didn't she know that Sisko was leading the Rebellion?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Oh, she knew. The truth is, she and Captain Sisko didn't get along too well. Then again, the captain didn't really get along with anyone. In some ways the rebellion's better off without him. Don't get me wrong, the captain knew how to fight but that's about all he knew.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Ready?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: You don't look very confident, Chief.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: You'd better start calling me Smiley. That's what the Captain called me.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: All right, Smiley.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I just wish we had more time to get you ready. I probably haven't told you half of what you need to know. I hope you don't run up against too many surprises.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: If I do, I guess I'll just have to improvise.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I told Sisko he'd never get close to Terok Nor, and I was right.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I say we teach the Alliance a lesson. Throw everything we've got at Terok Nor and rip it to pieces.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I disagree. Following your suggestion would do nothing to enhance our goals and would result in a significant loss of life.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: That's easy for you to say. Those Cardassian pigs didn't kill your brother.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: We have all suffered losses at the hands of the Alliance. Nonetheless, logic dictates caution in the face of a superior enemy.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Logic isn't going to win us our freedom. We have to take action.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: And we will. But this time we do it my way.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: And what do you propose we do?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: We smuggle explosives aboard the station, plant them in her quarters, and detonate them.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: You realize it is highly unlikely that anyone assigned to such a mission would survive.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I say it's worth the risk.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Does that mean you're volunteering for the job?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Captain, you're alive.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Of course he's alive. You can't kill the Captain. He's too ornery.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I hope that doesn't disappoint anyone.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: We're glad you're all right.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I'm sure you are.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: We heard your fighter was destroyed. The Alliance said you were dead.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Just their propaganda machine working overtime. But you know what all that tells me? They're scared. And we're going to give them plenty of reasons to stay scared.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Well, well, well. It's about time you came back.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: That's to let you know I missed you.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: And that's for letting me think you were dead.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I'm glad to see you still care.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: You coming or not?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I thought you told me I was married.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: You are, technically. She's your mistress.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I see what you meant by surprises.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I'm really glad you're alive. And I'm going to make you glad you're alive, too.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: We have a lot of planning to do.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: It can wait.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I suppose it can at that.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Well these progress reports are unacceptable. Productivity in the ore processing center is down fifteen percent. You have got to do better. Or are you purposely trying to make me look bad to Sector Command?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Not at all. I've done everything I can think of to motivate the workers.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Such as?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Bribes, torture. I've even given overseers permission to execute any worker not meeting the quota.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I'm sure that pleases the overseers, but it is not getting the job done. Follow me.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Lets start with him, him, and her.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: And do what?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Execute them. I think you'll find that random and unprovoked executions will keep your entire workforce alert and motivated.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I bow to your brilliance.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Let's go. You too.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Though I do hope your mood improves before we run out of workers.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: What does my mood have to do with anything?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: If you don't mind my saying, I have noticed a certain amount of ill-humor on your part lately.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I don't know what you're talking about.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: As I recall, it began about the time you learned of Captain Sisko's death.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Now why would I be upset by such delightful news?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Well, I was under the impression that you were rather fond of him.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Well then, you were mistaken.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Well I will say this for him. He did had spirit.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Too much spirit can be a dangerous thing. It tends to infect others.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Well that's something we won't have to worry at least. With Sisko's death, and the imminent completion of the transpectral sensor array, the Rebellion is certain to collapse.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: You seem very sure of yourself.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I am.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I'll remember that. If the Rebellion continues, I'll know who to blame.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Are you sure these Alliance patrol patterns are accurate?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: You tell me. You gathered the information.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Hmm? Oh, that's right.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Are you okay? You seem a little distracted.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Just thinking.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I've been thinking too. You know, we've been fighting against the Alliance for almost a year now. And what has it gotten us? Nothing. Sometimes I think we were better off when we were collecting tribute for the Intendant.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Those days are gone.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Maybe, but I'm tired of living like this. The rebellion's a lost cause and we both know it.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Don't you want to see the Terrans gain their freedom?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Have you taken a good look at your troops lately? They're nothing but ex-slaves with delusions of grandeur. They'll never overthrow the Alliance. Let's just get a ship and go. Forget all about the rebellion.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I'm not ready to give up just yet.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: It's not like you're going to have much choice. Once that witch you married finishes her new sensor array, Alliance ships are going to be all over these Badlands. We're going to have no place to hide.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Then I suppose we'll just have to make sure she doesn't finish.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Trying to reach Terok Nor using small fighters didn't work. But we need to get Jennifer off that station, and we need to get her off there soon.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: We've been meaning to talk to you about that.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Mister Bashir is not convinced that you can persuade your former mate to join our cause.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I can be very persuasive.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Look, I don't even know why we're bothering to discuss this. The Cardassians destroyed your ship way before it got even close to Terok Nor. And even if you had made it there, there was no guarantee you could've convinced your wife of anything.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Hit him. That's what the Captain would do. Go on, hit him.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Let's face it, Captain, the woman hates you.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: What my wife thinks of me is no concern of yours.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Anyone else want to disagree with the captain?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Put it away, Dax. Go on, put it away.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: No one is questioning your authority, Captain. But we have got to stop her before she finishes that sensor array.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: And there's only one sure way to do that.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: We have to kill her.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: You've been saying that all along.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Well maybe it's time he listened.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Killing her would be a lot easier than trying to get her away from the Alliance.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Easier, but not smarter. If she's that important to the Alliance, think how important she could be to us. We could use a scientist on our side.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: You tell them, Smiley. At least someone here is using his brain.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Think about it. Who knows what other weapons the Alliance is developing. Someone like Professor Sisko could counteract anything they come up with.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: She's valuable. We need her. All right. Does anyone disagree? Good. Now let's get to work.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Tell the Intendant what you told me.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: It's about Captain Sisko.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Sisko?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: He's alive. He was able to get off his ship before it exploded.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I suppose it's possible.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: It's more than possible. It's true. But I can tell you how to get your hands on him. If you're interested.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Don't do that.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I can't help it. It itches. I hope this works.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: It'll work. Just stop scratching.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: You did pretty good back there. I don't think anyone suspected you weren't Captain Sisko. At least not once you hit Bashir.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: But you and I both know that was just a warm up. Jennifer's the one I really have to convince.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I guess seeing her isn't going to be easy for you. How long's it been since your wife died?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Five years.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Well just remember, Jennifer may look like her, but she's not. She's a completely different person.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I'll try to remember that. Do you have any idea what went wrong between her and Captain Sisko?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: From what I heard, they never should've been together in the first place. She came from one of the few privileged Terran families, people who cooperated with the Alliance. The captain he fought his way up from the mines.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: What is she like, this Jennifer?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I don't know. They'd separated by the time I got to know the captain. What was your Jennifer like?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: She was the kindest, most caring person I ever knew.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: I wouldn't get my hopes up. Hold on. I'm reading a slight energy distortion in subspace.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: What are the coordinates?

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: It's coming from all around us.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: You know, Captain Sisko would try to fight his way out of this.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Be glad I'm not him.

title: Through The Looking Glass
line: Well, if it isn't the notorious Captain Sisko and his friend the Tinkerer.

line: The only common enemy you and I share is Enabran Tain. The difference between you and I is that you don't know it.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I suggest that you think over what I've said, Constable.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Funny. I was about to make the same suggestion.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Since the Jem'Hadar are genetically addicted to a drug that only the Founders can provide, we expect the Jem'Hadar to weaken and die once their supplies of the drug run out. A matter of days by our estimates. However, that will give them enough time to stage some kind of counterattack against the Alpha Quadrant, so I suggest you place the Cardassian fleet on alert. I take this action not in defiance of the Cardassian state, but in defense of it. You in the Central Command have neglected the security of our people and allowed peace with Bajor and the Federation to blind you to the real threat, the Dominion. I intend to remove that threat. Let history be my judge.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: That message was intercepted by a Federation outpost earlier today. A similar message was sent to the Romulan Senate. Now, both governments are denying any prior knowledge of Tain's plans and calling this a rogue operation.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Are they going to do anything to stop Tain?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Both the Romulans and the Cardassians claim to be studying ways to stop Tain, but we believe that they'll just sit back and wait to see if he succeeds or not.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: But sir, that could plunge Romulus and Cardassia into war with the Dominion.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Only if he fails, Lieutenant. His plan looks like it has a fair chance of success. He's commanding a fleet of twenty ships manned by combat veterans. They know the location of the Founders' homeworld and they've modified their cloaks so the Jem'Hadar can't detect their approach.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: It sounds like you're hoping Tain will succeed.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I never hope for war, Major. But if it comes, I'd rather see the Dominion on the losing side. However, we have to plan for the worst. Ben, I want you to evacuate DS Nine of all non-essential personnel and put the Defiant on standby alert. Even if Tain succeeds, the Jem'Hadar are going to come screaming out of the wormhole looking for revenge and they may not be too particular who their targets are.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Admiral, we believe Security Chief Odo is aboard one of the Romulan ships.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Odo's message said the runabout had been caught in a tractor beam. That suggests he was captured and taken aboard one of their ships.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I'd like permission to take the Defiant into the Gamma Quadrant and try to determine if he's still alive.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I'm sorry about your officer, but there's nothing we can do. I want the Defiant guarding Bajor. That's your top priority. Toddman out.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Commander Eddington, am I correct in assuming that Starfleet is planning to send substantial reinforcements to this sector?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Yes, sir. A task force of nine starships is due to arrive tomorrow.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Nine starships. I want the Defiant prepared to leave for the Gamma Quadrant in two hours.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Sir, Admiral Toddman's orders were quite clear and

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I am not going to just abandon one of my officers. Toddman's concerned about the defense of Bajor, and so am I. If we detect a Jem'Hadar strike force heading for the Alpha Quadrant, we'll use the communications relay to warn DS Nine, and we'll do everything we can to stop them before they reach the wormhole. I consider this a volunteer mission, but don't volunteer yet. There's a good chance you won't be coming back from this mission. And even if you do, you'll probably be facing a general court martial. If you do decide to go, be aboard the Defiant at fifteen thirty hours. Dismissed.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: All stations report.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Tactical ready.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Warp and impulse engines online, cloaking device standing by.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Helm ready.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: The Security detachment is aboard and phaser rifles have been issued to every fire team.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Release docking clamps.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Commander, there's an incoming priority message from Starfleet Command. It's Admiral Toddman. He's repeating his order not to enter the Gamma Quadrant.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: That's what you think it says. How can you be sure when a transmission is as badly garbled as that one?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: You're right. There's an awful lot of subspace interference on this channel. Must be an ion storm or something.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Must be.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Aft thrusters back one quarter, port and starboard at station keeping.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: The cloaking device is operating within normal parameters.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Set course for the Founders' homeworld, warp eight.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: We know that the Founders' planet lies at approximately these coordinates within the Omarion nebula. As you can see, there are no Jem'Hadar bases nearby. This means that even if the Founders did send out a distress call, it would take at least seven hours for any help to arrive.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Our plan is to wait until we've entered orbit of the Founders' planet, then decloak and begin massive bombardment.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Computer analysis indicates that the planet's crust will be destroyed within one hour, and the mantle within five.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: That should more than take care of the Founders.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Yes, it should. Unless they have some planetary defenses we don't know about. There is one person here who might answer that question. Mister Odo.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Anything he knows about the Founders and their planet was undoubtedly included in his report to Starfleet. The constable is remarkably thorough in these matters.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: There was a time when you were eager to begin an interrogation, Elim. In fact, I remember having to restrain your enthusiasm on several occasions.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Then you should also remember the pride I took in my work. I don't think that interrogating someone who can alter their form at will is likely to provide either amusement or information.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I wouldn't worry about Mister Odo's shape-shifting if I were you. The Obsidian Order has developed a device which should prove quite effective in neutralizing him.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I was not informed about this device.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: It's only a prototype. We've never had a chance to test it, until now. Perhaps the Tal Shiar should take over the interrogation of the changeling.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: No.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: It's all right, Garak. It's my fault. I should've known you'd develop feelings for these people you've been living with for the past few years. But I just never expected that you would become friends with someone who worked for the Bajorans.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: This has nothing to do with my friends or my feelings. I simply don't believe he has the information you want.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Possibly. Colonel Lovok will find out.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: No. I brought Odo here. He's my prisoner and my responsibility.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: You don't have to do this.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Yes, I do. And I think we both know that you won't trust me until I do.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: All right. I look forward to hearing your results.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Commander, I'm reading some kind of power fluctuation in the cloaking device.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: What kind of fluctuation?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I don't know. I can't locate the source of the problem but it is getting worse.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: We're decloaking!

title: The Die Is Cast
line: All stop. Full scan, Lieutenant. Are there any other ships in the area?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: No, nothing in sensor range.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Commander, if the Jem'Hadar show up while we're decloaked

title: The Die Is Cast
line: We'll have to fight our way out of here.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Everything looks fine. The power converters are online. The projection matrix looks normal. The cloaking device should be working.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Maybe there's some kind of spatial anomaly nearby that's interfering with the cloak's power systems.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: This isn't the result of a spatial anomaly, Major. The tetryon compositor on the cloaking device has been sabotaged.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: How do you know that?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Because I sabotaged it.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Why?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I was under orders from Admiral Toddman to stop you from pursuing the Romulan-Cardassian fleet.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: You've turned us into sitting ducks for the Jem'Hadar!

title: The Die Is Cast
line: We can still defend ourselves. I didn't damage any of the ship's weapon systems or the engines. But without the cloak, we'll have to return to DS Nine. I'm sorry Commander, I didn't want to do this. Odo's my friend too but I report directly to Admiral Toddman and he gave me an explicit order. I couldn't disobey it.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I don't suppose you could. Chief, now that we know the problem is in the tetryon compositor, how long until you can fix it?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: About ten hours.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: You've got two. On your way.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I'm afraid I'm going to have to confine you to quarters, Mister Eddington.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Sir, if we run into the Jem'Hadar, you're still going to need a chief security officer.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: What makes you think we'll trust you again?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Because I give you my word.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I make it a policy to never question the word of anyone who wears that uniform. Don't make me change that policy. Man your station, Commander. But I'd stay out of the Chief's way if I were you.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I realize it must be nearly time for you to return to your liquid state, so I thought I'd bring you something to relax in.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: How kind.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: But before you go for a swim, I have a few questions I'd like to ask you.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I have nothing to say.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Well I had hoped a few hours alone might jog your memory but I can see I'm going to have to take some steps I'd hoped to avoid.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Oh, no. You're going to torture me, aren't you? How I've been dreading this. Please have mercy, Garak.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: You do have a certain flair for sarcasm. It's one of the things I like about you.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: You can go now.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I'd bring those guards back if I were you. I'm not in a very good mood.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Yes, under normal circumstances, you would pose quite a threat to me. You could turn yourself into a Vicarian razorback or stretch out your arms and strangle me from across the room. But not this time.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Oh? And why is that?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Because that device is emitting a quantum stasis field designed to prevent any changeling from altering his biomolecular structure.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Yes, it must be very disconcerting for you to be locked into a humanoid form. Especially now. I'm sure you were looking forward to returning to your liquid state. Tell me, what will happen if you can't revert to a liquid?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I don't know.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: An honest answer. But it's probably safe to say that it won't be pleasant.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Garak, this is pointless. There's nothing I can tell you about the Founders that you don't already know.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I wish I could believe that.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Then why don't you?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Because you and I are so alike. We both value our privacy, our secrets. That's why I know there's something about the Founders you haven't told anyone. Something you didn't even share with Starfleet and Commander Sisko, hmm? But you are going to tell me, Odo.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: There's nothing to tell.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Well, perhaps something will come to you. I can wait. The question is, can you?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Major, leave the chief alone.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: What makes you think I'm going to see O'Brien?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: It's been three hours. I just wanted to see if he needed some help.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: If he needed help he would ask for it. For now, the best thing we can do is to stay out of his way.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: What's the matter, Garak? You don't look very happy. Aren't you enjoying yourself?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: There's no pleasure in this for me, Constable, I assure you. I am simply doing my job.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Your job. Yes, this is the job you've been waiting for. All these years of exile and here you are interrogating a prisoner again. It must fill you with pride.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Odo, just tell me what I need to know and this will end.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: But you don't want it to end, do you, Garak? Isn't this what you've been dreaming of? Back at work serving Cardassia.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: That's right. And you have information that I need. Information that it's my duty to extract from you. It's not personal. Odo, talk to me. Tell me something. Anything! Lie if you have to, but say it now. Please.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Home. I want to go home.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: And you will, I promise. As soon as this is all over, I promise I'll take you back to Deep Space Nine.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: No, not the station. Home with my people.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: The Founders? You want to return to the Founders? I thought you turned your back on them.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I did, but they're still my people. I tried to deny it, I tried to forget, but I can't. They're my people and I want to be with them in the Great Link.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I knew there was something, a secret you were holding back.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: And now you've found it. I hope it's useful.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Repairs are complete, sir. The cloaking device is online. A souvenir of your handiwork.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Engage cloak.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: The cloak is operating normally.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Resume course to the Founders' planet, maximum warp.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Did you get anything out of him at all?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Nothing. He never broke.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Well, that's unfortunate. I see no further use for Mister Odo. Terminate him.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: On the other hand, he is a member of the Bajoran militia and an officer on Deep Space Nine. We may not wish to provoke the Federation by killing him.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I agree with Garak.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Do you?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Yes. There is no way to be certain that all of the Founders will be on the planet when we attack. We should be prepared to encounter other changelings in the future and we could use more information on their capabilities. I want to take Odo back to Romulus for further study.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: All right, in the interest of cooperation.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Bridge to Colonel Lovok.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: This is Lovok.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: We've entered the Omarion Nebula and dropped out of warp. We should be in orbit of the planet in fifteen minutes.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Acknowledged.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Well, seems the moment is nearly at hand. Gentleman.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Can I do something for you, Colonel?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Why were you trying to protect the changeling?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I wasn't trying to protect him. And as I recall, you thought it was a good idea to keep him alive as well.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: My interest in the changeling is based on what I believe to be the strategic interests of the Romulan Empire. But you, you seem to have a personal interest in him.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Tell me, what else am I feeling? I've never been psychoanalyzed by a Romulan before. This is a fascinating experience.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: You are a practiced liar, Mister Garak, but I am a practiced observer. And I can assure you, I am going to be observing you very closely.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: We are within disruptor range.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Scan the planet for life-signs.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Sensors show multiple lifeforms on the surface. They appear to be in a liquid state.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: The Founders.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Signal the fleet to charge weapons and lock onto their targets. We will open fire the moment we drop our cloaks.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: All ships report ready. All weapons charged.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: So much for the Dominion. Open fire.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: The first barrage is complete.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Effect?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Thirty percent of the planetary crust destroyed on opening volley. No change in lifeform readings.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: What? That's impossible. Some of them had to be killed.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Our sensor readings have been confirmed by three other warbirds. There has been no change in the number of life-signs on the surface.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: They're using an automated transponder to send back false sensor readings. The planet's deserted.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Colonel, signal the fleet to

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Colonel, there are ships coming out of the nebula.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: What type of ships?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Jem'Hadar fighters.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: How many? I asked you a question.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: One hundred fifty.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Tactical display on screen.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: It's a trap. They've been waiting for us all along.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Cardassian cruiser Koranak has been destroyed. Romulan warbirds Makar and Belak have lost main power.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Bring us about to three one eight mark two one five. Concentrate fire on ships attacking on the port quarter.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: The Jem'Hadar will destroy every ship if we stay. Our only hope is to return to the Alpha Quadrant.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: There's no way out of here, Garak. The Jem'Hadar have cut us off. We need to consolidate the fleet and make our stand here.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: How could this be? What have happened?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I'm afraid the fault, dear Tain, is not in our stars but in ourselves.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: What?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Just something I learned from Doctor Bashir.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Main power's out. Switching to emergency backups.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Bridge to Engineering. We need power to the weapons. Bridge to Engineering, respond. I'll be in Engineering. Tain, take command of the Bridge.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Four more Jem'Hadar vessels are closing on our position.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I take it that the attack on the Founders is not proceeding according to plan.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: No, it's not, but I suggest we make our way to the runabout.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: For once, Garak, I agree with you.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: You will need this in order to gain access to your runabout.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Why are you doing this?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Because no changeling has ever harmed another.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: You are one of the Founders?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Of course. This whole plan was the Founders' idea in the first place. You wanted the Tal Shiar and the Obsidian Order to combine forces and come into the Gamma Quadrant so you could wipe them out.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Not exactly. Tain originated the plan, and when we learned of it we did everything we could to carry it forward. The Tal Shiar and the Obsidian Order are both ruthless, efficient organizations. A definite threat to us.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: But not after today.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: After today the only real threat to us from the Alpha Quadrant are the Klingons and the Federation. And I doubt that either of them will be a threat for much longer. It is not too late for you, Odo. Come with me. You can still become one with the Great Link if you wish.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Thank you. But my answer is still no.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Come on. I don't think we have much time.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: The runabout is that way. Two decks down. Section twenty five. Wait for me there.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Where are you going?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: To the Bridge, to get Tain.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: What?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I know it's difficult for you to understand, Constable, but I still owe him a personal debt and I have to try to repay it. Wait for us as long as you can.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Tain, we have to go!

title: The Die Is Cast
line: There must have been an informant. That's the only explanation.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Yes, there was an informant. You're right. Colonel Lovok is a changeling.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Lovok.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Yes, but that's something we can discuss it at another time. Right now we have to

title: The Die Is Cast
line: It appears I have underestimated the Founders. I should have seen it coming. There was a time when nothing got past me. You remember, don't you, Elim?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Yes, I do. But now we have to go!

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Go where? Back to Mila and my quiet retirement? I don't think so. I must be getting old. I let my pride override my instinct. Wouldn't have played it that way in the old days. In the old days I would've kept Lovok at arms length. He was too cagey, too smart.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I can't just leave you here.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I always did have a soft spot for you, Garak. Another of my flaws.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Enabran!

title: The Die Is Cast
line: These Founders, Elim. They're very good. Next time we should be more careful.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: You can be very persuasive on occasion, Constable. But in the future I hope you'll consider using gentler language.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I'll keep that in mind. A Jem'Hadar ship is following us. Raise shields and charge the weapons.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Aft shields down to fifty percent. More speed would be advisable.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: The warp drive is offline.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Shields down to thirty percent.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Another Jem'Hadar ship is approaching to starboard. Hang on!

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Shields down to fifteen percent.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Main power's failing. We're losing speed.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: The shields are gone. Odo, I hope that you will accept my sincere apologies for all this.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: A little late, isn't it?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Nevertheless.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I may not agree with what you did, but I can certainly understand your desire to return home.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Thank you.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: What?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Three more coming in off the port bow.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Fire on the lead ship, then bring us back to the runabout.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Two life-signs on the runabout, Commander.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Drop shields. Bridge to Transporter room. Beam them aboard, Chief.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Aye, sir.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Four more Jem'Hadar ships closing to starboard.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: O'Brien to Bridge. I've got them.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Raise shields.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Welcome back.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Thank you.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Oh, that looks painful.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: It is. But it did save my life.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Shields at eighty percent.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Attack pattern omega four. Full impulse power. Hold your fire until we're within five hundred meters.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: We might get pretty singed at that range.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Not as singed as they're going to get. Engage.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Fifty thousand meters and closing. Two thousand meters. Five hundred!

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Fire!

title: The Die Is Cast
line: The third Jem'Hadar fighter is still pursuing.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Aft torpedoes fire.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Direct hit on their port nacelle. They're losing speed. We're out of their weapons' range.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Any other signs of pursuit?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Negative. The other fighters are still concentrating on the remaining Romulan and Cardassian ships.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Let's not wait around for them to change their minds. Set course for the wormhole, Lieutenant. Warp eight.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: It's good to see you again, Constable.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Likewise, Major.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Course laid in.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Engage.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: There is still no indication that any Romulan or Cardassian vessels survived the attack.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Sounds like Wolf three five nine all over again.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I had the same thought.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: You may be interested to know I've decided not to file charges against anyone aboard the Defiant.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Thank you, sir.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: But if you pull a stunt like that again I'll court martial you or I'll promote you. Either way you'll be in a lot of trouble.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I'll keep that in mind, sir.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I just read the report that you wrote and I wanted to thank you.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Me? For what?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: For not mentioning my desire to return to my people.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I consider the entire conversation as something best forgotten.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: As do I. Quark has expressed an interest in renting this space if you're not going to be using it.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Oh?

title: The Die Is Cast
line: He mentioned something about an Argelian massage facility.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Unfortunately I don't think Commander Sisko will approve of such an interesting facility on the Promenade.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I tend to agree. But do I think he would approve of a tailor's shop.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Do you know what the sad part is, Odo? I'm a very good tailor.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Garak, I was thinking that you and I should have breakfast together sometime.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: Why, Constable, I thought you didn't eat.

title: The Die Is Cast
line: I don't.

title: Explorers
line: Excuse me. You're Doctor Bashir, aren't you?

title: Explorers
line: That's right.

title: Explorers
line: I'm Leeta. I've been meaning to come by the Infirmary to see you.

title: Explorers
line: Oh, dear. How long have you had that cough?

line: Julian!

title: The Adversary
line: You called me, Chief?

title: The Adversary
line: Why didn't you answer me?

title: The Adversary
line: I had this spanner in my mouth.

title: The Adversary
line: What are you doing here, anyway?

title: The Adversary
line: I was connecting my new diagnostic console to the medical bay's power grid.

title: The Adversary
line: I could have done that for you.

title: The Adversary
line: Oh, just putting my engineering extension courses to work. Besides, I know you have your hands full.

title: The Adversary
line: Oh. Where are you going now?

title: The Adversary
line: I'm done.

title: The Adversary
line: Not bad for an extension course.

title: The Adversary
line: You wanted to see me, sir?

title: The Adversary
line: Yes, Commander. It's about Ambassador Krajensky. Please. I know Starfleet doesn't intend for this to be a combat mission, but just in case the Tzenkethi have other ideas, I want to make sure the Ambassador is kept out of harm's way.

title: The Adversary
line: Yes, sir. I'll see to it that if hostilities do occur, the Ambassador is escorted off the bridge.

title: The Adversary
line: He won't like it.

title: The Adversary
line: I won't let that bother me.

title: The Adversary
line: Very good, Commander. That'll be all.

title: The Adversary
line: Captain, I just want to say that I agree with what Chief O'Brien said. About your promotion. It's about time.

title: The Adversary
line: I appreciate the sentiment, Commander, but it doesn't really change anything. I have the assignment I want, I have the crew that I want. The rank doesn't make much difference.

title: The Adversary
line: You'd be surprised. People don't enter Starfleet to become commanders, or admirals for that matter. It's the captain's chair that everyone has their eye on. That's what I wanted when I joined up, but you don't get to be a Captain wearing a gold uniform.

title: The Adversary
line: You could always transfer from Security to Command.

title: The Adversary
line: Then who would protect the Ambassador?

title: The Adversary
line: Dismissed, Mister Eddington.

title: The Adversary
line: Thank you, sir. Captain's log, stardate 48962.5. We are twelve hours from the border. I haven't been in this area since the last Federation-Tzenkethi war. Being here brings back a lot of memories, most of them bad.

title: The Adversary
line: Captain, we're receiving a priority one distress signal from Barisa Prime. Audio only.

title: The Adversary
line: Put it through.

title: The Adversary
line: under heavy fire from Tzenkethi warships. I don't know how much longer we can hold out. Can anyone hear me, This is

title: The Adversary
line: Constable?

title: The Adversary
line: We've lost contact.

title: The Adversary
line: Try to re-establish.

title: The Adversary
line: It's no use, Captain. They're gone. Captain's log, supplemental. We've been unable to re-establish contact with Barisa Prime. Therefore I've no choice but to assume we are at war with the Tzenkethi.

title: The Adversary
line: Lieutenant, set a course for Barisa Prime, maximum warp. I want continual scans for Tzenkethi ships. Constable, contact Starfleet Command. Let them know what happened.

title: The Adversary
line: Major, what other starships are in this sector?

title: The Adversary
line: The closest one is the Ulysses. They're studying protoplanetary masses in the Helaspont Nebula.

title: The Adversary
line: That puts them twenty hours away at maximum warp. Lieutenant, transmit a message to Captain Entebe on the Ulysses. Tell her

title: The Adversary
line: Captain. I'm having trouble getting through to Starfleet Command. There seems to be a power fluctuation in the communications system.

title: The Adversary
line: I can't get a message out either.

title: The Adversary
line: The console's functioning normally. The problem must be in the transceiver assembly.

title: The Adversary
line: I need that system back online, Chief.

title: The Adversary
line: I'll get on it right away. Lieutenant, I could use some help.

title: The Adversary
line: Major, take the helm.

title: The Adversary
line: Yes, sir.

title: The Adversary
line: What do you make of this, Lieutenant? I've never seen anything like it.

title: The Adversary
line: It's spreading through the system like some kind of parasite.

title: The Adversary
line: It seems to be linked to key points within the transceiver assembly. We'd better get it out of there.

title: The Adversary
line: Argh!

title: The Adversary
line: A forcefield.

title: The Adversary
line: Come on.

title: The Adversary
line: Where are we going?

title: The Adversary
line: I want to check the other command systems. I have a bad feeling about this.

title: The Adversary
line: You say these things are all over the ship?

title: The Adversary
line: They've attached themselves to the command and communication relays, the internal sensors, the transporter, the deflector shield grid, almost every critical system.

title: The Adversary
line: Is there any way to get past the forcefields?

title: The Adversary
line: None that we've found yet. We're still working on it.

title: The Adversary
line: Well I guess the question is, how did they get aboard? Or should I say, who placed them here?

title: The Adversary
line: I don't know who did it, but I know it definitely happened after we left the station. I ran a systems check before our departure. They weren't there then.

title: The Adversary
line: Which means someone aboard this ship is a saboteur.

title: The Adversary
line: We've got forty seven people on board. Theoretically, anyone of them could've planted those devices.

title: The Adversary
line: Chief?

title: The Adversary
line: It's nothing, sir. It's not even worth mentioning.

title: The Adversary
line: It doesn't sound like you're too sure about that.

title: The Adversary
line: Well, I did see someone crawling about in one of the Jefferies Tubes the other day.

title: The Adversary
line: Who?

title: The Adversary
line: It was Julian. He was connecting a medical console to the power grid.

title: The Adversary
line: Which is right next to the communications relay.

title: The Adversary
line: Are you accusing Julian of sabotage?

title: The Adversary
line: No one's accusing anyone of anything. But I want to talk to Julian.

title: The Adversary
line: Wait. I think I have a better idea.

title: The Adversary
line: This crew has been through a lot together. In fact I would trust any one of you with my life. But after looking at the evidence, there's only one conclusion I can draw. Someone on this ship is guilty of sabotage.

title: The Adversary
line: With your permission, Captain, the Constable and I can begin questioning the crew immediately.

title: The Adversary
line: That won't be necessary. Lieutenant.

title: The Adversary
line: We found one of the devices planted in the warp plasma conduit. Which means whoever put it there would've been exposed to trace amounts of tetryon particles.

title: The Adversary
line: And those particles would still be detectable on the saboteur?

title: The Adversary
line: Yes, but not for much longer. They dissipate quickly.

title: The Adversary
line: So you're going to scan all the members of the crew for tetryon particles?

title: The Adversary
line: Starting with the senior staff.

title: The Adversary
line: O'Brien and I already scanned positive, since we opened up the warp core controls during our investigation.

title: The Adversary
line: You realize, of course, that if no one else tests positive

title: The Adversary
line: We'll be the prime suspects. Yes, we know that.

title: The Adversary
line: We might as well get started.

title: The Adversary
line: You're clean.

title: The Adversary
line: I'm glad to hear it.

title: The Adversary
line: Might as well do me next.

title: The Adversary
line: You're okay, too. Julian.

title: The Adversary
line: Oh, of course.

title: The Adversary
line: Nothing.

title: The Adversary
line: You sound relieved.

title: The Adversary
line: Well I am. After all, you were in that conduit the other day.

title: The Adversary
line: I don't know what you're talking about.

title: The Adversary
line: Ambassador, if you please.

title: The Adversary
line: Certainly.

title: The Adversary
line: I was never in any conduit.

title: The Adversary
line: Of course you were. I saw you.

title: The Adversary
line: It's a changeling.

title: The Adversary
line: We've cloaked. Lieutenant, bring us out of warp. Full stop. Now. Constable, Commander, deploy security teams immediately. I want that changeling found before he can do any more damage.

title: The Adversary
line: Yes, sir.

title: The Adversary
line: Captain. The helm isn't responding. We're still at warp.

title: The Adversary
line: I can't deactivate the cloaking device.

title: The Adversary
line: The weapons array has activated. The phaser banks are charging and we've got photon torpedoes online and ready to launch.

title: The Adversary
line: The ship's no longer under our control.

title: The Adversary
line: Our security teams have gone over every centimeter of the ship, checked every piece of cargo, questioned every crewmember. We still haven't been able to find the changeling.

title: The Adversary
line: Is there any way he could've been transported off the ship?

title: The Adversary
line: At warp? It's unlikely. But with Dominion technology, I suppose it's possible.

title: The Adversary
line: He's still here. He won't leave until he's completed his mission.

title: The Adversary
line: Which is?

title: The Adversary
line: It looks like the Dominion is hoping to start a war between the Federation and the Tzenkethi.

title: The Adversary
line: If you ask me, the Tzenkethi are doing a pretty good job of that all by themselves.

title: The Adversary
line: Not necessarily. The transmission we received from Barisa Prime could've been faked using that device we found implanted in the communications relay. In fact, our entire mission could have been engineered by the Dominion. Think about it. We've been all over this ship, and we have not seen a trace of the real Ambassador Krajensky nor his remains.

title: The Adversary
line: Which means he was probably replaced before we left the station.

title: The Adversary
line: Maybe the real Ambassador never came to Deep Space Nine at all.

title: The Adversary
line: So anything Ambassador Krajensky told us could have been a lie. The Tzenkethi coup d'état, increased tension along the border, the threat of an attack.

title: The Adversary
line: And now here we are, cloaked, armed for battle, and headed into Tzenkethi space. If we can't stop this ship before we cross the border, we may wind up causing a war rather of preventing one.

title: The Adversary
line: Which is no doubt what my people are hoping for. A war between the Tzenkethi and the Federation would destabilize the Alpha Quadrant, making it that much easier for the Dominion to move in.

title: The Adversary
line: I wish the internal sensors were online. It'd make it a lot easier to track down the changeling.

title: The Adversary
line: I'm not sure the sensors would help. If you scan me when I'm a rock, you'd detect a rock. I may not be able to duplicate a humanoid perfectly, but I'm guessing he can.

title: The Adversary
line: We scanned Ambassador Krajensky for tetryon particles. He registered as human.

title: The Adversary
line: Well then right now the changeling could be anything or anyone on this ship.

title: The Adversary
line: Then we have to narrow his options. Confine all nonessential personnel to their quarters and seal them in with forcefields. Doctor, I want you to review those tricorder readings. See if you can find anything that will help us find the changeling. And take some security with you. From here on, no one is to be left alone.

title: The Adversary
line: We have seven hours before we enter Tzenkethi space. I want that changeling found before then.

title: The Adversary
line: That won't be easy. Let's face it, no matter how many precautions we take, he could replace any one of us and we won't know it until it's too late.

title: The Adversary
line: Thank you for your cooperation. Hopefully this will be over soon and you'll be able to return to duty.

title: The Adversary
line: All right, let's go.

title: The Adversary
line: This may take a while.

title: The Adversary
line: Keep your phasers on stun. And stay calm. I don't want anyone getting nervous and shooting one of us by mistake. You sure I can't interest you in one of these?

title: The Adversary
line: I don't use them. Besides, in the history of my people, no changeling has ever harmed another. I'd hate to be the first.

title: The Adversary
line: Apparently that changeling doesn't feel the same way. If we don't stop him, no one on board will escape unharmed. Including you.

title: The Adversary
line: You may be right. But I've been a security officer most of my humanoid existence. And in all that time, I've never found it necessary to fire a weapon or take a life. I don't intend to start now.

title: The Adversary
line: This is O'Brien. I need a security team in the engine room immediately.

title: The Adversary
line: It must've been the changeling. I went down the hall to get an interphasic compensator. I heard a noise and when I came back

title: The Adversary
line: She's got a severe concussion. Give me a hand. We've got to get her back to the medical bay immediately.

title: The Adversary
line: Stay here with the Chief.

title: The Adversary
line: Damage control team, report to the engine room.

title: The Adversary
line: Aye, sir.

title: The Adversary
line: Dax is still unconscious. I've given her cortical analeptics to stabilize her condition. She should be all right in a day or two, but until then

title: The Adversary
line: Is there any way to speed up the process?

title: The Adversary
line: I could use a neural stimulator but that might cause irreversible brain damage. I don't recommend it.

title: The Adversary
line: Then Chief O'Brien is going to have to regain control of the ship without her.

title: The Adversary
line: I'm afraid so. I should get back to my patient.

title: The Adversary
line: The changeling's very clever. Taking out Dax makes O'Brien's job a lot harder.

title: The Adversary
line: One thing's for sure, we're not going to start a war with the Tzenkethi. If O'Brien can't regain control before we cross the border I'll have no choice but to destroy the Defiant.

title: The Adversary
line: Our objective is simple. Find the changeling and stop him before he can do any more damage. We'll break into two-person teams. Each team will be armed with phaser rifles.

title: The Adversary
line: We've reconfigured the rifles to fire an expanding energy pulse.

title: The Adversary
line: Phasers have been set low enough to avoid damaging equipment, but high enough to affect the changeling.

title: The Adversary
line: The changeling could be hiding anywhere. He could look like anything. So we're going to have to systematically sweep the ship with phaser fire. Every conduit, every corridor. If he's out there, we'll find him. Any questions?

title: The Adversary
line: What if the changeling's not out there? What if he's one of us?

title: The Adversary
line: That's why everyone will be in teams. Keep your partner in sight at all times.

title: The Adversary
line: And if we see anyone without a partner?

title: The Adversary
line: Escort them to the brig. We don't want to take any chances. Let's go.

title: The Adversary
line: All right. Let's go.

title: The Adversary
line: After you.

title: The Adversary
line: Don't you trust me?

title: The Adversary
line: No, I don't.

title: The Adversary
line: I know exactly how you feel. Follow me.

title: The Adversary
line: Don't you ever sweat?

title: The Adversary
line: No, I don't. It's the modified phaser beam. It's heating up the air.

title: The Adversary
line: You know, this'd be a lot easier if we knew where he was hiding. Where would you be if you were him?

title: The Adversary
line: I wouldn't know. I'm not him.

title: The Adversary
line: He is one of your people. Can't you put yourself in his position, try to anticipate his next move?

title: The Adversary
line: I've thought about it, but the truth is I don't understand my people all that well.

title: The Adversary
line: That's too bad.

title: The Adversary
line: Yes, it is.

title: The Adversary
line: For all of us.

title: The Adversary
line: Watch my back.

title: The Adversary
line: Over there. On three. One, two

title: The Adversary
line: This is Sisko. The changeling is in Jefferies tube seven A heading to the lower deck. I'm in pursuit.

title: The Adversary
line: The changeling. He's right over there.

title: The Adversary
line: Put your phaser down. It's me, Kira. We were on our way to meet you and we got separated for a second. The next thing I know, he opens fire.

title: The Adversary
line: You can't fool me. You're the changeling. I saw you come out of that hatch and go around the corner.

title: The Adversary
line: I didn't see anyone. Maybe he morphed into the ventilation system. Or maybe he didn't. For all we know, you may be the changeling.

title: The Adversary
line: Keep back!

title: The Adversary
line: Both of you put your weapons down now.

title: The Adversary
line: I can't do that, Captain.

title: The Adversary
line: You heard him.

title: The Adversary
line: What happened?

title: The Adversary
line: How long have the two of you been apart?

title: The Adversary
line: At least a minute.

title: The Adversary
line: Then we've got a problem. Any of us could be the changeling. You, Kira, Eddington, even me.

title: The Adversary
line: Not you.

title: The Adversary
line: What do you mean?

title: The Adversary
line: You're bleeding.

title: The Adversary
line: I cut my hand when the changeling attacked me.

title: The Adversary
line: What are you getting at?

title: The Adversary
line: When blood leaves a humanoid body it's still blood. But when any part of me separates from my body

title: The Adversary
line: It reverts back to a gelatinous state.

title: The Adversary
line: Sisko to Bashir.

title: The Adversary
line: This is Bashir.

title: The Adversary
line: Doctor, meet us in the mess hall immediately.

title: The Adversary
line: This shouldn't take long.

title: The Adversary
line: Satisfied?

title: The Adversary
line: So far.

title: The Adversary
line: Who's next?

title: The Adversary
line: I'll go.

title: The Adversary
line: I'd say the Major is exactly who she appears to be.

title: The Adversary
line: Try not to look so surprised.

title: The Adversary
line: There doesn't seem to be any point obtaining a sample from the Constable. I guess that leaves the three of us.

title: The Adversary
line: Let's get this over with.

title: The Adversary
line: You'd better come with us.

title: The Adversary
line: This is ridiculous. I'm not the changeling. If I were, don't you think I'd put up a little more of a fight?

title: The Adversary
line: Inside.

title: The Adversary
line: You're making a mistake.

title: The Adversary
line: Do as he says.

title: The Adversary
line: Would someone please get me out of here?

title: The Adversary
line: Sisko here.

line: Sir, we're entering Tzenkethi space.

line: Any sign of Tzenkethi ships?

title: The Adversary
line: Sensors aren't picking up any warp signatures.

title: The Adversary
line: We've altered course. Our new heading is zero one five mark four seven. We're headed directly for the Tzenkethi settlement on M'kemas Three.

line: How long before we're in weapons range of the settlement?

line: Computer, this is Captain Benjamin Sisko. Initiate auto-destruct sequence. Authorisation Sisko alpha one alpha.

title: The Adversary
line: Set the countdown for ten minutes from my mark. Authorisation Sisko one five destruct. Mark.

title: The Adversary
