line: Sisko to O'Brien.

title: The Adversary
line: O'Brien here.

title: The Adversary
line: I could use some good news right now, Chief.

title: The Adversary
line: How about this?

title: The Adversary
line: I think I may be able to shut down the changeling's forcefields and gain access to the sabotaged systems. The only problem is we may lose our

title: The Adversary
line: Forcefields too.

title: The Adversary
line: Auto-destruct in seven minutes.

title: The Adversary
line: Just tell me how long it will take.

title: The Adversary
line: Well, I guess it'll have to be less than seven minutes, won't it.

title: The Adversary
line: That'd be my suggestion. Sisko out.

title: The Adversary
line: Doctor, how's Lieutenant Dax?

title: The Adversary
line: Still unconscious. The changeling gave her enough sedative to keep her under for days. I've managed to filter most of it out of her system, but she'll be out for another few hours. I wish I could do more.

title: The Adversary
line: You've done all you can, Doctor. Now it's up to Chief O'Brien.

title: The Adversary
line: Auto-destruct in six minutes.

title: The Adversary
line: All right, we're almost there. Look, when we set off this device there's a possibility we may lose the protective field around the warp core. title: The Adversary
line: Where's the changeling? I lost him in the conduits.

title: The Adversary
line: We haven't seen him.

line: You don't say.

line: Chief, remember the last time we went kayaking in the holosuites. You had lamb stew for lunch.

line: That's right.

line: But you forgot to bring a fork. Anyone could have gotten that information.

title: The Adversary
line: Auto-destruct in five minutes.

title: The Adversary
line: You'd better make a decision. We're running out of time.

line: I've got more important things to do than play choose the changeling. Keep the phaser on both of them.

title: The Adversary
line: Weapons are fully charged and ready to fire. Tactical systems are programming an attack run on the Tzenkethi settlement.

title: The Adversary
line: Chief, what are you doing?

title: The Adversary
line: Auto-destruct in four minutes.

title: The Adversary
line: You'll see. Now.

line: Warning. Warp core field breach. Engine room will be sealed in ten seconds. Evacuate immediately.

line: No!

line: Engine room sealed.

line: Why are you protecting these solids? You don't belong with them. You belong with us.

title: The Adversary
line: Auto-destruct in three minutes.

title: The Adversary
line: Let go. Don't you see? You've lost. It's too late for you to help them but it's not too late to help yourself. Link with me, Odo. We can escape together.

title: The Adversary
line: I don't think so.

title: The Adversary
line: Auto-destruct in two minutes.

title: The Adversary
line: You have to regain control of the ship.

title: The Adversary
line: Odo.

title: The Adversary
line: I never wanted to harm you.

title: The Adversary
line: O'Brien to Bridge.

line: Go ahead, Chief.

title: The Adversary
line: I've restored

line: Captain.

line: Hard aport, Major. Take us away from the settlement. Computer, end auto-destruct sequence. Authorisation Sisko omega one seven abort.

title: The Adversary
line: Take us home, Major. Captain's log, supplemental. We've returned to the station without further incident. However, I'm concerned about my Chief of Security, who hasn't said a word since we left Tzenkethi space.

line: The real Ambassador Krajensky was supposed to be on his way to Risa for an extended vacation, but he never arrived.

line: Not at all.

title: The Adversary

line: Go ahead.

line: We've swept all of level seventeen. No sign of the changeling.

line: Move down to eighteen. We'll meet you there after we finish checking the guest quarters.

line: Watch yourself, Chief. This changeling knows the station as well as we do. He could be anywhere or anything.

line: We've found him. He's headed to the Promenade.

line: Just there. All right, I want phaser sweeps of everything in the Promenade. He's here somewhere. Let's find him. On three. One, two

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: That's not good enough. If one of my people were loose on the station for that long, there's no telling how much damage they could do.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Schedule another surprise drill. If the Dominion tries to infiltrate the station, I want to be ready for them.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: And remind everyone that next time they'd better sweep everything. A changeling can be anything. A post, a pillar, even a patch of reflective surfacing.

line: Feel better? I take it your conversation with General Martok didn't go all that well.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: He was not forthcoming. And he is not the only one. I tried to contact Gowron, Emperor Kahless, even my brother who sits on the High Council. No one will speak with me.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Maybe you're going about this the wrong way. With so many Klingons around, there must be someone who owes your family a favor.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Ej IM-ta fey DE-ja i. Ejdahk-so-TAS ghos va Skral byteek. Empa jaj law-moch jaj-push. Jaj Kayless Molor migh hohk-chew koo.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Your father and I used to sing that song when you were just a small boy. Did I ever tell you how your father saved my family's honor during our bloodfeud with the House of Duras?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Many times.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: It is a good story!

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Yes, an you tell it well.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Your father was a great warrior. My family owes him everything we have. I wish there was some way I could repay him.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: There is. Tell me why the task force is here. The real reason, not the one Martok gave the Federation.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: The real reason? I suppose you have the right to know. You are a Klingon warrior and it would be wrong to keep you away from battle. And it's going to be a glorious battle!

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: It all seems simpler from up here, doesn't it?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: If you are looking to start a conversation, look somewhere else. I would prefer to be left alone.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: That may be, but you can't stay up here forever. Sooner or later you're going to have to talk to Captain Sisko. Whatever it is you've found out about the Klingons, he should be the first to know.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: You have been spying on me.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: As Chief of Security, it's my duty to observe the inhabitants of this station. Since your arrival, you've transmitted an average of five messages a day to the Klingon Homeworld, none of which has gotten a response. Then last night you met with a Klingon officer in your quarters. Since then, you haven't sent a single message. In fact, you've done nothing to further your investigation of the Klingon task force.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: None of which is your business.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: The security of this station is my business. Your behavior leads me to conclude that either you've given up your investigation, in which case it's my duty to take over, or you've found something. Something so disturbing that you're hesitant to inform Captain Sisko.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I am not interested in your conclusions.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Commander. I just wanted to say that I understand what you're going through. I've also had to choose between duty and loyalty to my people.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Yes, I have read your Starfleet security file.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Frankly, Mister Worf, I don't care which choice you make. But you owe it to Captain Sisko to let him know which side you're on, before it's too late. Enjoy the view.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Mister Worf, what can I do for you?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Where is Captain Sisko?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I think he's in a briefing session with

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I need to talk to him. Now.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Cardassia? Why would the Klingons want to invade Cardassia?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: According to my source, there has been an uprising on the Cardassian homeworld. The Central Command has been overthrown and power transferred to civilian authorities.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Even if your source is correct, what does that have to do with the Klingons?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Gowron and the High Council believe the coup was engineered by the Dominion.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Do they have any proof?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: None that I know of, but they are convinced that civilians could not have overthrown the Central Command without help.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: So, by attacking Cardassia they think they're protecting the Alpha Quadrant from the Dominion? Sisko to Dax. Contact General Martok. Tell him I need to meet with him immediately.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Yes, sir.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Mister Worf, I know this hasn't been an easy assignment for you.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: No, it has not. But I knew this day would come again when I'd be forced to choose between the Federation and the Klingon Empire.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Maybe you don't have to make that choice just yet. I don't think there's any need for you to be there when I meet with Martok.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I would prefer to be there. I cannot avoid responsibility for what I have done today.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I must compliment you on your intelligence network, Captain. One day you must tell me how you learned of our plans.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: General

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: How I got the information isn't important.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I think it is. And so will Gowron.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: General, I want you to call off this attack.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: And what do you propose we do instead? Stand by and let the Dominion take over the Alpha Quadrant?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: You have no proof that there are any Founders on Cardassia.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: The change in government is all the proof we need.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: And what if you are wrong?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: That would be unfortunate for the Cardassians.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: General, the Federation council has made it clear to me that they cannot support your plans to attack Cardassia.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Are you saying the Federation will sit back and do nothing while Klingon soldiers give their lives to protect the Alpha Quadrant?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Starfleet will not participate in an unprovoked invasion.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Then the victory will be ours alone.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: General, I would advise you to reconsider. The Federation Council has informed Gowron that if the attack goes forward, it will jeopardize our treaty with the Klingon Empire.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Believe me, Captain, we have no wish to antagonize your people.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Then call off the attack.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I will consult with Gowron. You will have his decision within the hour.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Captain, I think you'd better take a look at this.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Report.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: As soon as General Martok beamed back to his ship, he sent a message to the Klingon fleet. It was just one word. In'Cha.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Begin.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I'm picking up a huge distortion wave in subspace. The Klingon ships are going to warp.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Can you plot their course?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Judging from the vector of the subspace disturbance I'd say their heading is two six nine mark zero three two.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Straight to the Cardassian Empire.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: The Federation Council has been trying to contact Gowron. So far, they've had no response. So until they've had a chance to speak with him, we've been ordered not to get involved.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: The Bajoran government has agreed to abide by the decisions of the Federation Council.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: So that means we're not going to warn the Cardassians?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: The Klingons are still our allies. If we warn the Cardassians, we'd be betraying them.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Besides, what if the Klingons are right? What if the Dominion has taken over the Cardassian government?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: If my people wanted to seize control of Cardassia, that is how they would do it.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: The coup could have happened just as easily without the Founders. The Cardassian dissident movement has been gathering strength for years. With the Obsidian Order out of the way, they might have finally succeeded.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: The issue is not if there are any Founders on Cardassia. There are many Klingons who say we have been at peace too long, that the Empire must expand in order to survive. Fear of the Dominion has given my people an excuse to do what they were born to do. To fight and to conquer.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: If they're so eager to fight, who's to say they'll stop with the Cardassians.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Their next target could be anyone. Even the Federation.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: If I were you, I'd be more worried about Bajor. Think about it. What good would it do for the Klingons to defeat Cardassia, if they don't control the wormhole?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Agreed. If my people return to the old ways, no one will be safe.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Then we'll have to make sure that doesn't happen.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: But how? The way I see it, we only have got two choices, both of them bad. If we stand by and do nothing, we run the risk of being the Klingons' next target. But if we disobey Starfleet orders and warn the Cardassians, we may end up starting a war with the Klingons.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Which means we need a third option.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Trust me, you won't regret this. When it comes to keeping warm, nothing beats Vitarian wool undergarments. And in case you change your mind about the earmuffs, I'll keep them on hold for you.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Mister Garak, I'd like to see you in the wardroom immediately. Bring your tailor's kit.

line: Excuse me. I hope I'm not interrupting.

title: The Way of the Warrior

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Don't forget the waist. I think I've lost a little weight.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Thank you, Captain. I believe I have everything I need.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: The Klingons? Why would the Klingons invade us?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: According to my sources, the Klingon High Council believes that Cardassia has been taken over by the Founders.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: That's ridiculous.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Is it?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Garak, you have got to talk to Sisko. Tell him he has to find a way to stop the Klingons. Cardassia has enough problems right now.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: You're having trouble keeping the civilians in line?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: How do you know about that?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I'm afraid that since the fall of the Obsidian Order, Cardassian security isn't what it used to be.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Yes. Shame about the Order. I suppose there won't be much of a demand for your services anymore. Looks like you'll be hemming women's dresses for the rest of your life.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: We can stand here all day reminding ourselves just how much we hate each other, but you don't have the time. The Klingon fleet will reach Cardassian territory in less than one hour. I suggest you prepare for them.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Based on Klingon transmissions we've intercepted, the outlying Cardassian colonies were overrun almost immediately. But, now that the Cardassian fleet has mobilized, the Klingons are meeting stronger resistance.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: You'd almost think somebody warned the Cardassians they were coming.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Hopefully it'll make the Klingons think twice about what they're doing.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Unlikely, Major. Now that the battle has begun, Martok and his troops will settle for nothing less than victory.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Well, what did the Federation Council say?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: They've decided to condemn the Klingon invasion. In response, Gowron has expelled all Federation citizens from the Klingon Empire and recalled his ambassadors from the Federation.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: You're saying he cut off diplomatic relations?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: He's done more than that. The Klingons have withdrawn from the Khitomer Accords. The peace treaty between the Federation and the Klingon Empire has ended.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Captain, you're never going to believe this. A Klingon ship just decloaked off upper pylon three and is requesting permission to dock. They claim they have Chancellor Gowron on board and he is demanding to speak with Mister Worf, personally.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Chancellor Gowron. You wished to speak with me?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Worf. Worf! It is good to see you. I always said that uniform would get you into trouble one day.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: It seems you were right. But I do not apologize for my actions

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Yes, yes. I know. you did what you thought was right. And even though you may have made some enemies, I assure you I am not one of them.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I am glad. Your friendship means much to me.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: And yours to me. It has been too long since you last fought at my side. But now the time has come again. We will do great deeds in the coming days. Deeds worthy of song.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: You want me to go to Cardassia with you?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: What better way to redeem yourself in the eyes of your people. Come with me, Worf. Glory awaits you on Cardassia. Worf, why do you stand there like a mute d'blok. I have offered you a chance for glory. All you have to do is take it.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: If there's any glory to be won, Gowron, it'll have to be yours alone. I cannot come with you.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Of course you can. It is where you belong.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I cannot abandon my post.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: You no longer have a post. You have no place on that station, and no business wearing that uniform.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I have sworn an oath of allegiance.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: To the Federation.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: You would have me break my word?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Your word? What good is your word when you give it to people who care nothing for honor, who refuse to lift a finger while Klingon warriors shed blood for their protection. I tell you, they are without honor. You do not owe them anything.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: It is not what I owe them that matters. It is what I owe myself. Worf, son of Mogh, does not break his word.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: And what of your debt to me? Are you saying you owe me nothing? I gave you back your name, restored your house, gave your family a seat on the High Council. And this is how you repay me?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: It is true I owe you a great debt. I would give up my life for you. But invading Cardassia is wrong, and I cannot support it.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Worf, I have always considered you a friend and an ally. And because you are my friend, I am giving you this one last chance to redeem yourself. Come with me.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I cannot.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Think about what you are doing. If you turn your back on me now, for as long as I live, you will not be welcome anywhere in the Klingon Empire. Your family will be removed from the High Council, your lands seized, and your House stripped of its titles. You will have nothing.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Except my honor.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: So be it.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: You look like you could use some company.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Chief, do you remember the time we rescued Captain Picard from the Borg?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: How could I forget? It was touch and go there for a while. There were a couple of moments when I thought we were all going to wind up being assimilated.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I never doubted the outcome. We were like warriors from the ancient sagas. There was nothing we could not do.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Except keep the holodecks working right.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I have decided to resign from Starfleet.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Resign? What are you talking about?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I have made up my mind. It is for the best.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Look, I know how much you miss the Enterprise, but I'm sure they'll be building a new one soon.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: It will not be the same. The Enterprise I knew is gone. Those were good years, but now it is time for me to move on.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: And do what?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I do not know. I thought I would be returning to Boreth, but now that is impossible. I have made an enemy of Gowron, and every other Klingon in the Empire.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: All the more reason to stay in Starfleet.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: This uniform will only serve to remind me of how I have disgraced myself in the eyes of my people. I suppose I could get a berth on a Nyberrite Alliance Cruiser. They are always eager to hire experienced officers.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: The Nyberrite Alliance? That's a long way. What about your son?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Alexander is much happier living with his grandparents on Earth than he ever was staying with me. One thing is certain. The sooner I leave here, the better. My continued presence on Deep Space Nine would only be a liability to Captain Sisko in his dealings with the Klingons.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Do you hear that, Chief? Seventy two decibels. Music to my ears.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I think I liked it better when it was quiet.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: You want quiet, go to the Replimat. This is Quark's the way Quark's should be. The way it was meant to be. Am I glad we finally got rid of all those Klingons. Present company excepted, of course.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I got to hand it to you, Quark. You really know how to make your customers feel welcome.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: What do I care? All he ever drinks is prune juice.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I'm sorry, Mister Worf, but I can't accept your resignation at this time.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I do not understand. What further use could I be here?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I'm not sure yet. But as long as the fighting continues between the Klingons and the Cardassians, I need you here on the station.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: If you think that is wise.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I don't know if it's wise or not. But I do know that you're a good officer, and right now I need every good officer I can get.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Captain, we just got word from Bajoran Intelligence. The Klingons have broken through the Cardassian fleet.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: How long before they reach Cardassia Prime?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Fifty two hours.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: If the Klingon Empire has reverted to the old practices, they will occupy the Cardassian homeworld, execute all government officials, and install an imperial overseer to put down any further resistance.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I think it's about time we had a talk with the Cardassians.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Captain, I'm a little busy at the moment, so whatever you have to say, make it brief.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Dukat? I was trying to reach someone in the civilian government.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: And you have succeeded. You are speaking to the new Chief Military Advisor to the Detapa Council.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Does this mean you've turned your back on the Central Command?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: It means that as a loyal officer of the Cardassian Military, I am pledged to serve the legitimate ruling body of the Empire. Whoever that may be.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: In other words, you saw which way the wind was blowing and switched sides.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: It seemed like a good idea at the time.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Dukat, you have got to get those council members to safety before the Klingons reach Cardassia Prime.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I am open to suggestions, Captain.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: If you can get a ship and meet me at these coordinates, I'll do what I can to escort you out of the war zone.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: That is a very generous offer. I must say I am touched. By saving the members of the Detapa Council, you will be saving some very

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Forget the speech, Dukat. Just meet me at the rendezvous point.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: And if the Klingons try to stop us?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Then I'll be there to reason with them. I doubt the Klingons will fire on a Federation ship.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I'm not sure I share your optimism, but then I don't have much choice, do I? We'll meet you there.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Sir, if the Klingons are right, if the Cardassian government has been taken over by the Founders

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Then we'll be helping them to escape. That's the chance we'll have to take. I know you want to be out of that uniform but right now I need you with me.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I understand.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Make sure the chief double checks all our new systems. We may need them.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I'll tell him. But knowing the chief, he's probably doing it already.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Keep the station on yellow alert. And just to be on the safe side, I'd recommend that you send some of the civilian population down to Bajor.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I was planning to. I wish I was going with you.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: So do I, but I need you here.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Ben. I'm glad I caught you before you left.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: So am I. When'd you get back?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Less than an hour ago. Jake told me you were about to go off on some kind of mission.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: The Defiant leaves in a few minutes.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: And you can't tell me about it.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I'll be back in four or five days.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I'm leaving tomorrow.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I guess our timing hasn't been too good.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: No. No, it's been terrible. I'm not even sure when I'll be back.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Make it soon.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Don't get killed.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I'll do my best.

line: Activate the cloaking device.

line: Set a course for the rendezvous point. Maximum warp.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Aye, sir.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Something wrong, Mister Worf?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: No, sir. Yes, sir. It is just I have never been on a Federation ship that had a cloaking device. It is a little strange.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: You'll get used to it.

line: Sir, I hate to bring this up, but our agreement with the Romulans expressly prohibits use of the cloaking device in the Alpha Quadrant.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: You're right. It does. But there are hundreds of Klingon ships between us and Dukat, and I intend to make that rendezvous in one piece.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Well, I won't tell the Romulans if you don't.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I never thought I'd say this, but right now I'm glad the Dominion's around. Otherwise we never would've started these upgrades, let alone have them almost finished by now.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: There's something to be said for incentive.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: I just hope everything works okay.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: You're saying you're not sure?

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: The way I see it, there are two possibilities. Either everything'll be fine or

title: The Way of the Warrior

line: Or we'll end up blowing the station to pieces.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: Well that doesn't sound very honorable to me.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: In war, there is nothing more honorable than victory.

line: But sir, if there are survivors

line: I'm sorry, Doctor. We can't risk it. We have to reach Dukat.

title: The Way of the Warrior
line: And double check the secondary power grid. It's still not performing as well as it should.

title: The Way of the Warrior
