line: Thank you, Major. That's very helpful. And if we had an anodyne capacitor, we would use it. But we don't. Major, please forgive me. I do appreciate your suggestion. Any anger I may have expressed was due to my frustration over the complete inadequacy of this vessel. I hope you'll allow me to make it up to you.

title: Return To Grace
line: What did you have in mind?

title: Return To Grace
line: I was hoping we might have dinner together. After all, it is Cardassian tradition for the commanding officer of a ship to entertain his guests.

title: Return To Grace
line: Far be it from me to stand in the way of tradition.

title: Return To Grace
line: This is Bajoran Spring Wine.

title: Return To Grace
line: My last bottle. It's one of the things I miss most about Bajor.

title: Return To Grace
line: I talked to Ziyal. She's a lovely girl.

title: Return To Grace
line: I'm very glad that you convinced me not to kill her.

title: Return To Grace
line: Despite everything that's happened?

title: Return To Grace
line: You may not believe this, Major, but when it comes to Ziyal I regret nothing.

title: Return To Grace
line: It's good to hear that.

title: Return To Grace
line: By the way, Major. What is this I hear about you and Shakaar?

title: Return To Grace
line: I don't know what you've heard.

title: Return To Grace
line: First it was Vedek Bareil, and now it's the head of the Bajoran government. You do like powerful men, don't you?

title: Return To Grace
line: First of all, Shakaar's an old friend. Second of all, what business is it of yours?

title: Return To Grace
line: Let's just say it's further incentive for me to regain my former position.

title: Return To Grace
line: It's good to see you haven't lost your sense of humor.

title: Return To Grace
line: I must say, I've always admired Shakaar's success with women. The intelligence file I kept on him during the occupation is filled with reports of his conquests. In fact, if you remember correctly, you were the only female in his resistance cell that he didn't charm. At least until now.

title: Return To Grace
line: Is that what you kept track of during the occupation? No wonder you lost.

title: Return To Grace
line: More wine, Major?

title: Return To Grace
line: Another drill?

title: Return To Grace
line: I didn't schedule one.

title: Return To Grace
line: Sir, we're approaching the outpost on Korma, or what's left of it.

title: Return To Grace
line: What are you talking about?

title: Return To Grace
line: From what we can tell, it's been attacked. The planetary defense systems have been disabled. Every building has been destroyed.

title: Return To Grace
line: How many casualties?

title: Return To Grace
line: There are no life signs.

title: Return To Grace
line: Then we have to assume that everyone at the outpost, including the Cardassian and the Bajoran dignitaries, is dead.

title: Return To Grace
line: Sir, I'm reading a subspace distortion bearing zero zero one mark one five.

title: Return To Grace
line: On screen.

title: Return To Grace
line: Klingons.

title: Return To Grace
line: They're scanning us, sir.

title: Return To Grace
line: Full power to forward shields.

title: Return To Grace
line: At this distance your shields won't mean much.

title: Return To Grace
line: Sir, they've stopped scanning us.

title: Return To Grace
line: What are they doing?

title: Return To Grace
line: Nothing, sir. They don't seem to be in a hurry to do anything about us.

title: Return To Grace
line: They don't think we're a threat, Dukat.

title: Return To Grace
line: Then why were they cloaked when we arrived?

title: Return To Grace
line: They detected an incoming vessel, they didn't know what it was, so they hid. Now they know and they're unconcerned.

title: Return To Grace
line: The Klingon ship has lowered its shields. They're moving off at one quarter impulse.

title: Return To Grace
line: They'll pay for their arrogance. Charge phaser banks.

title: Return To Grace
line: What are you doing, Dukat? You can't go up against a bird of prey!

title: Return To Grace
line: Must I remind you, Major, they just murdered your people as well as mine?

title: Return To Grace
line: I know that, but getting all of us killed isn't going to change that.

title: Return To Grace
line: We're the only Cardassian ship in the area. I'm not going to let these Klingons escape unchallenged.

title: Return To Grace
line: You attack them and all you're going to do is give them a little target practice. They're going to blow us to pieces with their first shot.

title: Return To Grace
line: Phaser banks charged.

title: Return To Grace
line: Lock phasers on target.

title: Return To Grace
line: Phasers locked.

title: Return To Grace
line: Dukat! At least lock onto the underside of their hull. It's their weakest spot.

title: Return To Grace
line: You heard the Major.

title: Return To Grace
line: Target set.

title: Return To Grace
line: Fire!

title: Return To Grace
line: Their shields were down and we didn't penetrate their hull.

title: Return To Grace
line: Divert all power to forward shields.

title: Return To Grace
line: Aye, sir.

title: Return To Grace
line: They've gone to warp.

title: Return To Grace
line: Well, it would seem we're not worth destroying.

title: Return To Grace
line: Lucky for us.

title: Return To Grace
line: I suppose from their point of view, there's no honor in destroying a worthless freighter. I have to inform Central Command. These Klingons have been operating behind our lines with impunity. Somebody has got to stop them. Someone else.

title: Return To Grace
line: How close is the nearest Cardassian warship?

title: Return To Grace
line: Probably in the Dopa System somewhere.

title: Return To Grace
line: That's almost three days away. By the time they get here, the Klingons'll be long gone.

title: Return To Grace
line: That's true, but what can we do about it?

title: Return To Grace
line: We can go after the Klingons.

title: Return To Grace
line: A few moments ago, you were advising caution.

title: Return To Grace
line: That's because a moments ago we were in no position to fight back. I have no intention of letting them get away with what they did. Now, you said scanners showed that the outpost disruptors were disabled not destroyed, right?

title: Return To Grace
line: Correct.

title: Return To Grace
line: Dukat, do you think you'd be able to repair one of those disruptors?

title: Return To Grace
line: What would be the point? I doubt we can lure the Klingons back to the outpost.

title: Return To Grace
line: Maybe not. But there's no reason we can't make a few alterations to your ship.

title: Return To Grace
line: What kind of alterations?

title: Return To Grace
line: Here? In the cargo hold?

title: Return To Grace
line: Why not?

title: Return To Grace
line: Because the outpost's planetary defense weapons are system five disruptors. They were never designed to operate aboard a moving spacecraft, and this cargo bays were never designed to hold them.

title: Return To Grace
line: Dukat, you are going to have to stop thinking like a Cardassian military officer.

title: Return To Grace
line: And more like you?

title: Return To Grace
line: More like a resistance fighter. You have got to make use of what you have. If you need a hammer and you don't have one, use a pipe.

title: Return To Grace
line: And you really think we can make those weapons operational on this ship?

title: Return To Grace
line: It's worth a try.

title: Return To Grace
line: I suppose if we disable the tractor beam, we could reroute enough power to operate one of the disruptors. But those weapons are huge. What do we do with all this cargo?

title: Return To Grace
line: Get rid of it.

title: Return To Grace
line: All of it?

title: Return To Grace
line: I realize it's traditional for a Cardassian captain to take a percentage of the haul, but you are going to have to shed a lot of traditions if you are serious about fighting the Klingons.

title: Return To Grace
line: Some traditions are hard to break.

title: Return To Grace
line: You'll get used to it.

title: Return To Grace
line: You never cease to impress me, Major. I've got a lot to learn from you.

title: Return To Grace
line: Target at five hundred thousand kilometers.

title: Return To Grace
line: System five disruptor's online.

title: Return To Grace
line: Open the cargo bay doors.

title: Return To Grace
line: Doors opening.

title: Return To Grace
line: Telemetry lock confirmed.

title: Return To Grace
line: Are you ready? Diverting all power to your station.

title: Return To Grace
line: Two hundred thousand and closing.

title: Return To Grace
line: Fire!

title: Return To Grace
line: Very impressive, Major.

title: Return To Grace
line: Don't be too impressed yet, Dukat. We still have some problems. Firing the disruptor ruptured power relays and plasma circuits all over the ship.

title: Return To Grace
line: We have small plasma leaks on levels two, four and five.

title: Return To Grace
line: I want those leaks fixed immediately.

title: Return To Grace
line: Aye, sir.

title: Return To Grace
line: We're going to have to do something about that recoil.

title: Return To Grace
line: Major, I'm confident you'll have that disruptor running so smoothly it wouldn't wake a sleeping child.

title: Return To Grace
line: Why is it when you smile, I want to leave the room?

title: Return To Grace
line: I suppose it's because of my overwhelming charm. But you must admit it is rather amusing. When we do destroy that bird of prey, it will no doubt go a long way toward restoring my reputation. And I have you to thank for it.

title: Return To Grace
line: I'm trying not to think about that.

title: Return To Grace
line: Major, why are you so reluctant to face the obvious? We make an excellent team.

title: Return To Grace
line: We are not a team, Dukat, and we have nothing in common. The only reason I'm helping you is because those Klingons killed fifteen Bajoran diplomats.

title: Return To Grace
line: There were Cardassians at that outpost too.

title: Return To Grace
line: Maybe. But all you care about is redeeming yourself in the eyes of the Cardassian government. You have seen an opportunity for advancement and you are grabbing it.

title: Return To Grace
line: You judge me too harshly, Major. Maybe I am seeking to regain my former position. One which I earned through hard work, dedication and sacrifice. But redemption is not my sole motivation. I care about my people and I don't intend to allow the Klingons to get away with murdering them. I'm a much more complicated man than you give me credit for.

title: Return To Grace
line: If that's true, I suppose I prefer simpler men.

title: Return To Grace
line: Like Shakaar? It amazes me that a woman as intelligent and sophisticated as you could be attracted to such a lumbering, simplistic field hand. I mean, what could the two of you possibly talk about?

title: Return To Grace
line: That lumbering field hand is the First Minister of Bajor. And he knows more about how to talk to me than you ever will.

title: Return To Grace
line: How can you be so sure? After all, you don't know me well enough to make a comparison.

title: Return To Grace
line: I don't want to know you well enough. And if you want to keep working with me, I suggest you stick to business.

title: Return To Grace
line: I'm sorry, Major. I didn't mean any harm. I was only making conversation. Damar, set another target. We'll test our new weapon as soon as the Major's ready. Let's see if we can't work out our problems. At least the ones we're having with the disruptor.

title: Return To Grace
line: This is a standard issue, Cardassian phase-disruptor rifle. It has a four point seven megajoule power capacity, three millisecond recharge two beam settings.

title: Return To Grace
line: How do you know so much about Cardassian weapons?

title: Return To Grace
line: We captured a lot of them during the occupation. It's a good weapon, solid, simple. You can drag it through the mud and it'll still fire. Now this. This is an entirely different animal. Federation standard issue. It's a little less powerful, but it's got a more options. Sixteen beam settings. Fully autonomous recharge, multiple target acquisition, gyro stabilized, the works. It's a little more complicated, so it's not as good a field weapon. Too many things can go wrong with it.

title: Return To Grace
line: I can see why my father likes having you around.

title: Return To Grace
line: I think you should stick with the Cardassian rifle. It's smaller, easier to use, and if we get boarded I don't want you to have to think too much about the weapon you're using.

title: Return To Grace
line: You don't like my father much, do you?

title: Return To Grace
line: No. I don't.

title: Return To Grace
line: I understand. He did some very bad things during the occupation.

title: Return To Grace
line: Yes, he did.

title: Return To Grace
line: It bothers him, you know.

title: Return To Grace
line: Does it.

title: Return To Grace
line: Very much. He talks about it sometimes. He'd never admit it to anyone else, but he thinks the occupation was a mistake.

title: Return To Grace
line: Somehow I don't think he'd say that if the Cardassians had won.

title: Return To Grace
line: Maybe not. But maybe losing made him a better person.

title: Return To Grace
line: Then a lot of innocent people died for his education.

title: Return To Grace
line: I know. I think about that a lot. But when I look at my father, I have a hard time seeing a murderer.

title: Return To Grace
line: And when I look at him, I have a hard time seeing anything else. You're his daughter.

title: Return To Grace
line: My father says that the two of you have a lot in common. That you both did things during the war that you regret. That's why he cares so much about what you think of him.

title: Return To Grace
line: Ziyal, what your father wants from me is forgiveness. That's one thing I can never give him. Now, I think we should concentrate on getting you comfortable with this weapon.

title: Return To Grace
line: What about the Cardassian base on the fourth moon of Rakal?

title: Return To Grace
line: It's subterranean, much too fortified to be a viable target for a bird of prey. It would take a Vor'Cha class cruiser to do any real damage. How about the station on Amleth Prime?

title: Return To Grace
line: The Amleth system's located inside an emission nebula. The Klingon cloaking device would be useless.

title: Return To Grace
line: I know where they'll go next. Loval.

title: Return To Grace
line: That's on the other side of the sector.

title: Return To Grace
line: A long way from the Cardassian fleet.

title: Return To Grace
line: From what it says here, Loval is mainly a civilian outpost with a small subspace relay station. The Klingons have been going after a lot bigger prizes.

title: Return To Grace
line: What it says there is not exactly true. Loval is also a weapons research installation, which is supposed to be a closely guarded secret. Now considering the targets the Klingons have hit so far, I think we've underestimated their intelligence network.

title: Return To Grace
line: Sounds like a choice target.

title: Return To Grace
line: Loval it is. The question is, even if we're right, can we stop them?

title: Return To Grace
line: All we need is one good shot with the new disruptor.

title: Return To Grace
line: Which won't be easy to get considering they'll be cloaked.

title: Return To Grace
line: We don't have to find them. We have to make them come to us.

title: Return To Grace
line: Lure them in. Make them think that we're a helpless freighter.

title: Return To Grace
line: We have to make them think that we have valuable cargo aboard.

title: Return To Grace
line: How does refined dilithium crystal sound? I can get Damar to modify the subspace transceiver array to emit a false dilithium signal. Now if I know the Klingons, they'll lock their tractor beam on us and try to take our cargo.

title: Return To Grace
line: And we'll have a little surprise waiting for them.

title: Return To Grace
line: Yes.

title: Return To Grace
line: Not bad.

title: Return To Grace
line: I told you we make a good team, Major. You are as insightful a woman as you are intriguing.

title: Return To Grace
line: I thought we agreed to keep this strictly business.

title: Return To Grace
line: Major, is it my imagination, or do you have a hard time accepting compliments?

title: Return To Grace
line: I have a hard time accepting compliments from you.

title: Return To Grace
line: Well, I'll try to restrain my enthusiasm, but I can't make you any promises.

title: Return To Grace
line: We'd better get to Loval before the Klingons do.

title: Return To Grace
line: Damar.

title: Return To Grace
line: Sir?

title: Return To Grace
line: Set a course for Loval. Maximum warp.

title: Return To Grace
line: Aye, sir.

title: Return To Grace
line: Loval system within scanning range, sir.

title: Return To Grace
line: Any sign of them?

title: Return To Grace
line: No, sir.

title: Return To Grace
line: If they're not there now, they'll be there soon enough.

title: Return To Grace
line: Begin modifications to the subspace transceiver array.

title: Return To Grace
line: We soldiers spend a lot of time waiting, don't we, Major? It's not easy to keep your mind from drifting.

title: Return To Grace
line: I don't usually have any trouble concentrating, unless I'm being distracted.

title: Return To Grace
line: Lately, when my mind wanders, I find myself thinking more and more about Gul Marratt. Do you know him? Very dashing. One of Cardassia's rising stars. Graduate of the Cardassian Military Academy, smooth-talking junior member of the Detepa Council, and like your friend Shakaar, quite a lady's man. Especially with other officer's wives.

title: Return To Grace
line: Including yours?

title: Return To Grace
line: Mmm. A year ago he wouldn't have dared, but now? I think the first thing I do when I'm returned to power is to demote him. Assign him to the Cardassian Embassy on Breen. I hear it's bitter cold on Breen. And we Cardassians do despise the cold.

title: Return To Grace
line: Sir, I've got something.

title: Return To Grace
line: On screen.

title: Return To Grace
line: Well, Major, it seems fate has smiled on our little plan.

title: Return To Grace
line: They're scanning us.

title: Return To Grace
line: Good. Let's hope they take the bait.

title: Return To Grace
line: Sir, they've locked their disruptors on us.

title: Return To Grace
line: They haven't fired. Which means they could be interested in our cargo.

title: Return To Grace
line: They're hailing us, sir. Demanding our surrender.

title: Return To Grace
line: They're interested. Now let's see if you can make them bite.

title: Return To Grace
line: On screen.

title: Return To Grace
line: Identify yourself.

title: Return To Grace
line: I'm Gul Dukat, Commander of the Cardassian freighter Groumall. Who are you?

title: Return To Grace
line: What is your cargo and destination?

title: Return To Grace
line: We are carrying replicator and transporter parts to the Dopa System.

title: Return To Grace
line: You're lying!

title: Return To Grace
line: I assure you, Captain.

title: Return To Grace
line: I'm confiscating your ship and its cargo.

title: Return To Grace
line: On whose authority?

title: Return To Grace
line: On the authority of the Klingon Empire and the disruptors I have pointed at your vessel.

title: Return To Grace
line: Convincing, wasn't I?

title: Return To Grace
line: I'll let you know.

title: Return To Grace
line: They've locked their tractor beam on us.

title: Return To Grace
line: Wait for my signal. Wait. Open the cargo bay doors.

title: Return To Grace
line: Doors opening.

title: Return To Grace
line: Fire!

title: Return To Grace
line: We've breached their hull! Their impulse engines are down. They're adrift.

title: Return To Grace
line: Excellent.

title: Return To Grace
line: They're re-locking their disruptors on us.

title: Return To Grace
line: All power to forward shields.

title: Return To Grace
line: Damage?

title: Return To Grace
line: Both shields are down to twenty percent. We can't sustain another hit.

title: Return To Grace
line: I think it's time to improvise.

title: Return To Grace
line: I want all power to the disruptors now! You. Get down to the weapons room and find out what's taking them so long.

title: Return To Grace
line: Major!

title: Return To Grace
line: Just give me a minute.

title: Return To Grace
line: Hurry, Major.

title: Return To Grace
line: Quiet. I need to concentrate.

title: Return To Grace
line: Lock target. Prepare to fire.

title: Return To Grace
line: You are a magician, Major.

title: Return To Grace
line: There's nothing magical about it. Not when you know Klingon transporter codes.

title: Return To Grace
line: It worked. All our people are here and all thirty six Klingons are on the freighter. I can just imagine that Klingon Captain explaining this to his superiors.

title: Return To Grace
line: He won't get the opportunity.

title: Return To Grace
line: Was that necessary?

title: Return To Grace
line: You're the terrorist. You tell me.

title: Return To Grace
line: Weapons secured, sir.

title: Return To Grace
line: Excellent.

title: Return To Grace
line: So is Engineering.

title: Return To Grace
line: Well done. Well, Major, quite a prize we've taken. The first Klingon bird of prey ever to be captured by Cardassia.

title: Return To Grace
line: I think I just found a bigger prize. It looks like we've got the target priorities of all Klingon raiders in Cardassian space.

title: Return To Grace
line: I'll contact Central Command and inform them of our success. I think I'll request my Legate title be reinstated, effective immediately. Get me Central Command. No, on second thought, this is too important for them. I want to speak to the Chairman of the Detepa Council himself on a secure channel.

title: Return To Grace
line: I can't do that from here, sir. The communication terminals on the bridge are down but I could re-route it to the Captain's quarters.

title: Return To Grace
line: Good. Do so. Then make the repairs. I want this ship fully operational as soon as possible.

title: Return To Grace
line: Aye, sir.

title: Return To Grace
line: Ziyal, do you see the phase compensator in the backup plasma manifold?

title: Return To Grace
line: What's it look like?

title: Return To Grace
line: Perhaps I should go help her. Klingon technology is

title: Return To Grace
line: Odd. Good idea. Hang on, Ziyal. Help's on the way.

title: Return To Grace
line: Understood.

title: Return To Grace
line: You know something, Dukat? These computer logs are even more valuable than I thought. They contain status reports from Klingon ships and outposts throughout Cardassian space. With information like this, Cardassia could launch a major counterattack against the Klingons.

title: Return To Grace
line: They could, but they won't.

title: Return To Grace
line: Why not?

title: Return To Grace
line: The Detepa Council has something else in mind. They've ordered me not to engage the Klingons in any further conflict. The Council is looking for a diplomatic solution. They've ordered me to return to Cardassia Prime to resume my post as Military Advisor.

title: Return To Grace
line: I thought that's what you wanted.

title: Return To Grace
line: It was. But what is the point of being a Military Advisor to a government that won't fight.

title: Return To Grace
line: You can change their minds. Convince your fellow Cardassians to go on the offensive.

title: Return To Grace
line: No, I'd be wasting my breath. They wouldn't listen to me. No one wants to fight. There was a time when the mere mention of my race inspired fear. And now we're beaten people, afraid to fight back because we don't want to lose what little is left.

title: Return To Grace
line: That's not the Cardassians I know.

title: Return To Grace
line: What Cardassians? Don't you see, Major? They're paralyzed. They're beaten and defeated. I am the only Cardassian left. And if no one else will stand against the Klingons, I will.

title: Return To Grace
line: Look, Dukat, I know you're angry, but maybe you ought to think about what you're proposing. I mean, you can't go to war against the whole Klingon Empire with one bird of prey.

title: Return To Grace
line: Why not? Your people fought against us for fifty years with much less sophisticated weaponry than this. And you beat us.

title: Return To Grace
line: It's not the same. The Bajoran people were united. We were all fighting for the same goal. You and your crew would be out there alone.

title: Return To Grace
line: Maybe at first, but perhaps our actions would inspire others to join the struggle.

title: Return To Grace
line: It's not that easy, Dukat.

title: Return To Grace
line: I know. Which is why I need you.

title: Return To Grace
line: Me?

title: Return To Grace
line: Who else? You know how to organize a resistance cell. You're an expert in terrorist tactics. You have close ties with Bajoran and Federation officials. And besides all that, it would give you a chance to do what you were meant to do.

title: Return To Grace
line: No, thanks. I've already got a job.

title: Return To Grace
line: What do you mean? On that space station? We both know your talents are being wasted there. Coordinating docking assignments and leading training exercises. On Deep Space Nine, you're nothing but a bureaucrat, an administrator. If you come with me you can be a soldier again. Think about it, Major. The chance to fight against a superior foe in a righteous cause, to protect a defeated and broken people from a cruel aggressor. You know as well as I do that if Cardassia falls, Bajor is next. Help me stop the Klingons before you become their next target.

title: Return To Grace
line: You're really serious about this.

title: Return To Grace
line: Absolutely. Look, Major, I'm not asking you to like me or to be my friend. I'm asking you to join me. To fight at my side. You know what I'm doing is right, and it's what you want to do as well. I know that our past makes it difficult for you to accept me as an ally. I also know that every fiber of your being is telling you to say no, no, no, but somewhere I know there's a yes. You need to listen to that yes. Not for my sake, not for Cardassia's, not even for Bajor's, but for your sake.

title: Return To Grace
line: We've completed the repairs on the navigational system and the cloaking device.

title: Return To Grace
line: Good. We'll leave as soon as you have it online. Think about it, Major. Think about the possibilities.

title: Return To Grace
line: Nerys! I want to show you something.

title: Return To Grace
line: Go ahead, attack me.

title: Return To Grace
line: What are you talking about?

title: Return To Grace
line: It's okay. I know what I'm doing. Damar showed me a good trick. Try to stab me with the knife.

title: Return To Grace
line: I guess it wasn't such a good trick.

title: Return To Grace
line: The best way to survive a knife fight is to never get in one.

title: Return To Grace
line: If I'm going to help my father, I have to be prepared for anything. Show me what you did again. Please. I know I have a lot to learn. I've been practicing with the disruptor rifle but I need to know how to defend myself in hand-to-hand combat. I was lucky not to have to fight when we boarded this ship. I may not be so lucky next time.

title: Return To Grace
line: Chances are you won't be. Fighting the Klingons is going to take more than knowing how to fire a rifle or use a knife. You have to learn how to be ruthless. You have to learn to hate the Klingons even more than you hated the Breen.

title: Return To Grace
line: Whatever it takes, I will do it. But I'm going to need your help.

title: Return To Grace
line: You're right. You do need my help.

title: Return To Grace
line: I am disappointed, Major.

title: Return To Grace
line: But not surprised.

title: Return To Grace
line: Tell me, were you even tempted?

title: Return To Grace
line: Not really.

title: Return To Grace
line: I thought I was so eloquent.

title: Return To Grace
line: You had your moments. But the fact of the matter is I've already been where you're going. I've lived the life you're choosing. Fighting hit and run, always outgunned, living on hate and adrenaline. It's not much of a life, and it eats away at you so that every day a little bit of you dies.

title: Return To Grace
line: Very inspiring, Major. But I don't have any choice in this. No more than you had when you fought against us.

title: Return To Grace
line: No, I don't suppose you do.

title: Return To Grace
line: Well, all that's left is for you to wish me luck.

title: Return To Grace
line: That's not quite all. There's still Ziyal.

title: Return To Grace
line: What about her?

title: Return To Grace
line: The life you're choosing isn't for her. She deserves better.

title: Rules of Engagement
line: Admiral, if there are no facts in dispute, then this hearing would appear to be at an end.

title: Rules of Engagement
line: We Klingons are not concerned with matters of fact and circumstance. What matters to us is what was in Worf's heart when he gave the order to fire. title: Rules of Engagement
line: We can't put a man's heart on trial. It's a subjective issue that cannot be reasoned in a court of law. I ask that the advocate be limited to arguing the evidence in this case.

title: Rules of Engagement
line: Someone told me this was a search for the truth. Should we not follow that search wherever it takes us?

title: Rules of Engagement

title: Rules of Engagement

title: Rules of Engagement
line: Admiral, at this time I would like to enter into evidence files I obtained from the defendant's private database this morning.

line: Objection. There's been no search order issued for those files. This is a violation of Mister Worf's privacy.

title: Rules of Engagement

line: Ah. I see. Well, I obviously have no search order, so I'll ask you, Worf. May I enter this files into evidence? Or do you have something to hide?

title: Rules of Engagement

title: Rules of Engagement
line: Commander Dax, are you familiar with a holosuite program known as The Battle of Tong Vey?

line: Sompek.

line: Of course. The conqueror's role. One of our greatest heroes. Tell me, Commander, what was the final order Sompek gave to his men once they had conquered the city of Tong Vey?

line: Of course he does. Because he is a Klingon warrior. He doesn't have the same moral code as a Starfleet officer. He is one of us. A killer, a predator among sheep.

line: I only have one more question for this witness, Admiral. Commander Dax, when was the last time Worf used that program?

line: Captain, you ordered Worf to command the Defiant on the mission in question, did you not?

title: Rules of Engagement
line: An outbreak of Rudellian plague has struck the Cardassian colony on Pentath Three. The Cardassians are preparing several convoys of medical supplies and relief workers, but the Pentath system borders Klingon territory and the Cardassians are worried about raids.

title: Rules of Engagement
line: Well, Pentath is a strategically important system. The Klingons will try to stop them.

title: Rules of Engagement
line: Now the problem is the Cardassians don't have enough warships available to protect the relief convoy. There will be seven convoys headed for Pentath Three in the next week, each of them protected by a Federation starship. The Defiant has been assigned to escort convoy six, and I've chosen you to be in command.

title: Rules of Engagement
line: Why did you select Worf for this mission?

title: Rules of Engagement
line: I felt he was an experienced officer who was ready to take on greater responsibilities. He had a distinguished record and obviously understood the Klingons.

title: Rules of Engagement
line: Weren't you a little worried, Captain, that Worf, a famed Klingon Warrior, might jump at the chance for battle and forget about the plague victims?

title: Rules of Engagement
line: If I were, I wouldn't have given him the assignment.

title: Rules of Engagement
line: And you're sure you made your instructions perfectly clear? That Commander Worf knew he was on a humanitarian relief mission. That he was not being sent out to seek combat?

title: Rules of Engagement
line: Yes.

title: Rules of Engagement
line: Thank you, Captain. I have nothing further for you.

title: Rules of Engagement

line: Background on the Klingon transport captain. He'd never been in the military and he was known to his family and friends as a quiet, efficient man who was content in his position.

title: Rules of Engagement

title: Rules of Engagement

line: For the record, Chief O'Brien has been in two hundred and thirty five separate engagements and Starfleet has decorated him fifteen times. I would like to have him declared an expert in the area of starship combat.

line: No. But that's just my opinion now, after the fact. I wasn't in command that day. Things look a lot different when you're sitting in that chair.

line: Of course you are. Who wouldn't be? What happened affected your entire family. The House of Mogh was brought down. title: Rules of Engagement
line: No.

title: Rules of Engagement

title: Hard Time
line: Protect us from what?

title: Hard Time
line: From me. I'm not the man I used to be. I'm dangerous. I nearly hit Molly today. All she wanted was a little attention and I nearly hit her.

title: Hard Time
line: But you didn't. You're a good man, Miles Edward O'Brien. And whatever it is you think you've done wrong, you don't deserve to die.

title: Hard Time
line: You sound like Ee'Char.

title: Hard Time
line: Who's Ee'Char?

title: Hard Time
line: He's not real. He's just a memory, that's all.

title: Hard Time
line: A memory from Argratha? Who was he? Another prisoner? A guard?

title: Hard Time
line: He was my cell mate.

title: Hard Time
line: You told me you were alone in that cell. Twenty years with no one to talk to.

title: Hard Time
line: I was at the end. A week, two maybe. But the rest of the time there was Ee'char.

title: Hard Time
line: What happened to him?

title: Hard Time
line: Why did you do that?

title: Hard Time
line: It wasn't helping.

title: Hard Time
line: You need to concentrate more.

title: Hard Time
line: It doesn't matter how much I concentrate. I'm still starving.

title: Hard Time
line: So am I.

title: Hard Time
line: You're sure there's nothing left?

title: Hard Time
line: Not unless you have a hiding place I don't know about.

title: Hard Time
line: We ate the last of the food I put away a week ago. We should have stockpiled more. We should have planned for this.

title: Hard Time
line: They've never let us go this long without food before.

title: Hard Time
line: Maybe they've forgotten about us, or just decided to finally let us die.

title: Hard Time
line: Then we die.

title: Hard Time
line: All offenders prepare for dormancy period. Any offender still active during the dormancy period will be disciplined. Illumination will be suspended in twenty seconds.

title: Hard Time
line: What are you doing?

title: Hard Time
line: I'm going to sleep.

title: Hard Time
line: How can you sleep at a time like this?

title: Hard Time
line: Maybe I'll dream about food.

title: Hard Time
line: You're crazy.

title: Hard Time
line: No. Just hungry.

title: Hard Time
line: Dormancy period initiated.

title: Hard Time
line: You pretended to be my friend and all the time you were holding out on me.

title: Hard Time
line: Now who's acting crazy?

title: Hard Time
line: After all I've done for you. You ungrateful

title: Hard Time
line: You were saving it for both of us. Ee'char? Ee'char, wake up. Ee'char. Ee'char.

title: Hard Time
line: You killed him?

title: Hard Time
line: And the worst part of it was, the next day the guards began feeding me again. I'd killed him for nothing, for a scrap of bread he was going to share with me.

title: Hard Time
line: But it was a mistake. You didn't mean it.

title: Hard Time
line: I meant it. I wanted him to die. I keep telling myself it doesn't matter. It wasn't real. But that's a lie. If it had been real, if it had been you instead of him, it wouldn't have made any difference. He was my best friend and I murdered him. When we were growing up, they used to tell us humanity had evolved, that mankind had outgrown hate and rage. But when it came down to it, when I had the chance to show that no matter what anyone did to me, I was still an evolved human being, I failed. I repaid kindness with blood. I was no better than an animal.

title: Hard Time
line: No, no, no, no. An animal would've killed Ee'char and never had a second thought, never shed a tear. But not you. You hate yourself. You hate yourself so much you think you deserve to die. The Argrathi did everything they could to strip you of your humanity. And in the end, for one brief moment, they succeeded. But you can't let that brief moment define your entire life. If you do, if you pull that trigger, then the Argrathi will have won. They will have destroyed a good man. You cannot let that happen, my friend.

title: Hard Time
line: Miles. Be well, Miles.

line: Thirty milligrams twice a day. Take it religiously for a month, and if all goes well we'll experiment with a lower dosage.

title: Hard Time
line: You sure this'll work?

title: Hard Time
line: It's a treatment, not a cure. It'll prevent hallucinations, take the edge off the depression. But that's all it'll do. It won't take away the memories or the feelings.

line: Terok Nor in rebel hands. It just shows what people can do when their cause is just.

line: You've every right to be angry. We haven't exactly played fair with you.

line: You kidnapped my son.

line: Tell me, Captain. If we had come and asked for your help in fighting the Alliance, what would you have said?

line: Recognize her?

line: Wow. The Defiant.

line: During our last encounter, when I visited your station, I took a moment to download as many of your computer files as I could. I figured they'd come in handy some day. And they have. title: Shattered Mirror
line: These schematics look complete. Why do you need me? If you want to build another Defiant, why do you need my help?

line: We've already built it. The problem is, when we power up its engines, the whole ship damn near shakes itself apart.

line: We had the same trouble. It's a powerful ship.

line: Well, right now it's a little too powerful for its own good. How did you solve it?

line: We had to overhaul the structural integrity field grids.

line: We have four days.

line: I'm not sure that's enough time.

line: It'd better be. Otherwise the Defiant won't be ready, and you and your son will die along with the rest of us. title: Shattered Mirror
line: I want to see my son first.

line: You remember Captain Bashir.

line: Captain?

line: Captain Bashir, Captain O'Brien, Captain Sisko. We may not have enough troops or ships or weapons, but we have plenty of captains.

line: Is he going to help us or not?

title: Shattered Mirror
line: You must have missed that cheery face. Relax. The Captain has found it in his heart to aid us once again.

line: I owed you that. I let you hit me once because I thought you were our Captain Sisko. Now I know better.

line: We're even now.

line: You're too tall. I don't trust tall men. Tall women, that's a different story. Here. See for yourself.

line: Dad. I'm sorry, but I had to come. Somehow, talking to Jennifer, telling her all about the past nine years, about all the things that happened to me, what I've done, what I've been thinking about. It's like telling Mom.

line: This place is unbelievable. Chief O'Brien, Doctor Bashir, Dax, they're all here. I know, it's not really them but, look here's Nog. This is my father.

line: Sorry. Look, Jake-o, I have to talk to Jennifer alone for a minute.

line: It was mine. We needed you to help us complete the ship. Smiley told me all about you. About your wife's death, about your son. I knew that Jake would want to meet me, that I'd remind him of his mother.

title: The Quickening

title: The Quickening

title: The Quickening

The choice is ours. Heaven help us if we make the wrong one.

line: All right, I'll give you some time. But I want you back on the station by zero seven hundred hours tomorrow. You're to report to Doctor Bashir for a complete physical.

title: Rapture

line: His runabout only docked twenty five minutes ago, sir. I'm sure he's on his way.

title: Rapture
line: I examined him before he left for Bajor. He didn't complain of any new symptoms, but my scans still showed the same odd synaptic potentials. I was hoping the problem would have cured itself by now.

title: Rapture
line: But it hasn't. Isn't there something you can do to help?

title: Rapture
line: I could try neuro-polaric induction. But that's a very serious operation, and I'd rather not do it unless it were absolutely necessary.

title: Rapture
line: So in the meantime he's going to keep having visions. I knew we were headed for trouble the minute he allowed the Bajorans to call him Emissary.

title: Rapture
line: He didn't have much choice. The Bajorans are deeply committed to their spirituality, not to mention incredibly stubborn. They believe that Captain Sisko is the Emissary and nothing's going to change their minds.

title: Rapture
line: Here he comes!

title: Rapture
line: I told you held be here, sir.

title: Rapture
line: There's no need to worry. The katterpod harvest will be much better this year. You don't belong here. Go home.

line: That should do it. I'll have the test results in a few minutes.

title: Rapture
line: I was on Bajor. B'hala had been rebuilt. The people were in the streets, celebrating. But then a shadow covered the sun. We looked up and saw a cloud filling the sky. It was a swarm of locusts, billions of them. They hovered over the city, the noise was deafening, but just as quickly as they came, they moved on. Now I know where they were going. Cardassia.

title: Rapture
line: What do you think it means?

title: Rapture
line: I don't know.

title: Rapture
line: At least the swarm was moving away from Bajor. That's a good sign. Isn't it?

title: Rapture
line: But what do these locusts represent? And why Cardassia?

title: Rapture

title: Rapture

title: Rapture

title: Rapture
line: Well, if you'd stayed busy much longer you could have died. The area of unusual neural activity has increased another eight percent. As a result, your basal ganglia are starting to depolarize. I'm going to have to operate, try to repolarize your neural sheaths.

title: Rapture

title: Rapture

title: Rapture

title: Rapture

title: Rapture

title: Rapture

title: Rapture

title: Rapture

title: Rapture

title: Rapture

title: Rapture

title: Rapture

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: You were there, weren't you?

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Dukat told you.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: The Cardassian army burned Kiessa to the ground. Seventeen monks were killed.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: But they were hiding weapons for the Resistance. Weapons that were being used to kill my friends. It was war. It was easy to despise you. But you weren't the monsters, we were. I wish I'd never joined the military, never volunteered for duty on Bajor. But I did. And I can't change that, no matter how much I might want to.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: So instead you hid the truth from me.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: No, Nerys. I didn't want you to hate me.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: It's what you deserve.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Nerys!

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Dabo! That is dabo, isn't it?

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: I don't know why you insist on playing this ridiculous game.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: I like games.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Ah, Captain. Can I help you?

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: I thought we should talk. I realize I haven't been much of a host.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Here, have some kanar.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: No, thank you. I'm not particularly thirsty right now.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: I insist.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: I said no thank you. I never touch Kanar on an empty stomach, Captain. It's bad for the digestion.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: In this case, that's something of an understatement. Because in that bottle is enough voraxna poison to kill at least a dozen Cardassians. It was delivered to Tekeny Ghemor less than twenty minutes ago.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Fascinating.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: What's wrong, Dukat? Are you afraid Ghemor's going to say something that might undermine your cozy new position?

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Tread with care, Captain. You're coming dangerously close to accusing the head of the Cardassian government of attempted murder.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Is that what I'm doing?

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: How delightful. The mysterious plots, the subtle innuendos, the veiled threats. It's all so entertaining.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: What?

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Oh, my. That is quite toxic, isn't it?

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Are you insane?

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Vorta are immune to most forms of poison. Comes in handy when you're a diplomat.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Especially when you're working with the Cardassians. You can keep the kanar, Dukat. Ghemor won't be drinking it.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: It's a little late for services, Major.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: I needed a quiet place to think. If you've got something to say to me, Constable, say it.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: I understand you've stopped visiting Ghemor.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: He lied to me. I thought he was different, but he's just like the rest of them.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Is he? Really. I've seen his file, too, Major. He was nineteen when Kiessa was destroyed. He'd been in the military for less than a year and was only one of four hundred soldiers at the monastery. There's no way of knowing if he even fired a shot.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: He shouldn't have been there at all.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: This isn't about Ghemor's war record. If it really mattered, you wouldn't have waited for Dukat to hand it to you. You would have looked it up yourself.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: What are you trying to say? That I should go back down there?

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Ah. No, I wasn't saying that at all. Are you?

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Father? Father. Father, hold still. You'll tear your bandages.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: My garden. They burned my garden.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: I know. I know.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: I can hear the Prophets calling me, Nerys. I can feel my pagh slipping away.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Nerys. We found them. It's a Cardassian heavy weapons unit. Third assault group, ninth order.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Hold on. I'll be right back. How far?

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Just outside of Tempasa.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: I'll go with you.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Are you sure?

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: I know the area.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: So does Gantt.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: They didn't shoot Gantt's father. They shot mine.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: All right. Go.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: We found the soldiers that did this to you. I'm going to make them pay, just like I promised.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: The others. Let them. You don't have to go.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Yes, I do. Yes, I do. I won't be long. Let's go!

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Come in.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: I thought you should know that Ghemor's condition has deteriorated. He'll be dead within the hour.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Thank you for the information, Doctor.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Is that it? Thank you for the information? Ghemor is dying.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: I heard you.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Major, he wants to see you.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Well, I don't want to see him.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Major, please, it's almost over. There's no more questions to ask, no more work to be done. Just go to his quarters and sit with him.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: I said no. Don't ask me again.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Fine. You must do what you want. But I think you're making a mistake. Regardless of what Ghemor's done in the past, he doesn't deserve to die alone. Nobody does.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: All four mortar rounds right in the central compound. And the way they ran, it was like kicking over a mound of barrowbugs.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: What was the count?

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Five skimmers, and at least, at least fifteen Cardassian dead. Now that's not a bad day's work. We should celebrate.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Yeah. They kill us, we kill them. It's nothing worth celebrating.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Nerys. Your father.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: He died calling your name.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Get another raiding party together. I want to hit those Cardassians again as soon as we have a chance.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Would you like me to call everyone together? Have Prylar Quen say a few words?

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: There's nothing left to say.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: I didn't think you would come.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Well, for a while there, neither did I.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Cause of death was CNS failure brought on by Yarim Fel syndrome. One witness was present, a Major Kira Nerys of the Bajoran Militia. Witness's statement is attached. Major, we're done here.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: That's it? A quick postmortem, a statement from the witness and a little paperwork. It seems so straightforward.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: It never is.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: He got so quiet toward the end. I could hear him whispering things. His wife's name, Iliana's, even mine. Then the pain just got too much for him and he just lay there, breathing. And at the end of every exhale, there was this pause, and I thought that's it. It's over. Then he'd force another breath, and another. I started counting them. One hundred, two hundred, three hundred. He was fought for every last second. I don't even think he knew I was there.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: He knew. You gave him what he needed. He didn't die alone.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Maybe he gave me something I needed. I missed my father's death by less than an hour. Did you know that? Less than an hour. I always told myself that it was bad luck, bad timing, the will of the Prophets. But the truth is, I didn't have to go when I did. I could have stayed a while longer. I saw my chance to get out and I took it. I saw so much death during the occupation, I felt so much pain. But my father, he was my strength, and I couldn't stand to see that strength slipping away. So I ran.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Just like you tried to run from Ghemor.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: He reminded me so much of my father. Going through it again, I just couldn't face it.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: But in the end, you did. You were there for Ghemor.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: I owed it to him. I owed it to my father to get it right this time.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: You wanted to see me?

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Yes. I understand Legate Ghemor has passed away.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: You must be very relieved.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Oh Captain, such cynicism does not suit you. All of Cardassia will mourn the passing of Tekeny Ghemor. He was a great man.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: I'm surprised to hear you say that.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: Not at all. It takes a great man to admit he's wrong, and that's what Ghemor did. I'm speaking of his last minute change of heart. His deathbed decision to embrace the new Dominion government.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: That's very moving, except for one small problem. It never happened.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: As you said, it's a small problem.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: I would like his body transferred to my ship. We'll take him home and bury him with full state honors.

title: Ties of Blood and Water
line: I'm afraid that's going to be impossible. Legate Ghemor's funeral arrangements have already been taken care of.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Over this way.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Who's winning the war?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: It's too early to tell.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: It's been three days.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Don't remind me. They found a nest.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: That's good.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: It's not the main nest.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: That's not so good. I thought Chief O'Brien trapped the last vole on the station months ago.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Well, obviously he missed a couple. A married couple. They breed like tribbles.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: But they're not as cute.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: They're disgusting, hairy little creatures with ravenous appetites and I want them gone.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Oh, Quark.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I know, I know. This is just a temporary setback. The bar will open again and I can get back to my life.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I'm glad you realize that.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: The only trouble is, I hate my life.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Come in.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Hello, brother.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: What do you want?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: You have every right to be depressed, brother. Ever since you were blacklisted by the Ferengi Commerce Authority it's been one thing after another. But I have some news that's going to cheer you up.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I doubt it.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Trust me on this one, brother. I'm about to make you very, very happy.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Really?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Really. Come on in.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: What's she doing here?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: We're getting married.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Oh, I wish I was dead.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: He's been a little depressed lately.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I don't want to live.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I think you need someone to talk to, someone to pamper you.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I think I need to be alone.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: You know who I talk to when I'm feeling a little low?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Yeah, me.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Not when it's something really important.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Let me guess. Chief O'Brien?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: That's not a bad guess.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Rom, just tell me who it is, then you can leave and I can go back to my brooding.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: There's only one person in my life who's always there for me, who's never too busy to listen, who reassures me when I'm scared, comforts me when I'm sad, and who showers me with endless love without ever asking anything in return.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I'd like to meet this person.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: So would I.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: You already know her. And she'll always be there for you, brother, with open arms.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Quark?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Mother?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Moogie, hold me.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Of all the Bajoran Prophecies, I think my favorite is Horran's Seventh. The one that starts, He will come to the palace, carrying a chalice.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Bearing no malice.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Overflowing with sweet Spring wine.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Someone's been studying the Ancient Texts.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: It's important to Leeta. She wants a traditional Bajoran wedding.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: And you've agreed to it? Oh, that's very sweet, Rom.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Is she doing the same for you? I mean, learning to be a Ferengi woman? Memorizing the Rules of Acquisition and

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Not likely. Leeta's not the type of woman to quit her job, stop wearing clothes, and never go out in public again.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: That's okay. I just want her to be happy.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: That's a very enlightened attitude, Rom.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Rom is not your traditional Ferengi male.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I guess not.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: You're probably the least Ferengi-like Ferengi I've ever met.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I guess so.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Oh, that's not a bad thing, Rom. No traditional Ferengi male could ever marry a non-Ferengi and be happy. He could never trust her.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: So you see, Moogie, the voles aren't the real problem. They're just a symbol for everything that's gone wrong in my life.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: You've had a tough year, Quark.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: That's an understatement. I see all these great opportunities out there and I can't do anything about them. Without a Ferengi Business License it's like I don't exist.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I understand why you felt the need to escape for a while, but why come here?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I had no place else to go.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Are you sure about that? Oh, now don't give me that look. You and I both know we've never really gotten along. You disapprove of me, Quark. You always have. Moogie, stop wearing clothes. Moogie, stop earning profit.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: You have stopped, haven't you? I mean earning profit. Wearing clothes is bad enough, but profit.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: You see what I mean?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I know the two of us living under the same roof isn't going to be easy. But you're my mother and I love you.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: And I love you too, Quark. But when you say living together what are we talking about? A day? A week? Two weeks?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I don't know. I guess until I start feeling better. Unless, of course, you don't want me.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: You're my son. How could I refuse you?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Then you'll remove all that unnecessary clothing?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Don't push your luck. Where are you going?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: To my room. I'm exhausted.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: What you need is some of your mother's cooking. Some nice, juicy tube grubs.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I never liked your tube grubs.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I'll pre-chew them for you.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Maybe later.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Hello, room. Where's all my stuff? If she's thrown out my Marauder Mo action figures.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Grand Nagus?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Quark, what are you doing here?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I'm visiting my mother.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: That's no excuse. You've been banned by the FCA. You must leave Ferenginar at once.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Got to go. The Nagus, he knows I'm here. Wait a minute. What's the Nagus doing in my closet?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: The Nagus?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Moogie?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Zekkie! You might as well come out.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Zekkie? What's going on?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: The next time you visit, I'd really appreciate it if you called first.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: That doesn't answer my question.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Sometimes, the only thing more dangerous than a question is an answer.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Rule of Acquisition two oh eight. You're in trouble again, aren't you? What have you done now? Whatever it is, I had nothing to do with it. Tell him, Moogie. Tell him I'm innocent.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Relax, Quark. I'm not in any trouble.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: You're not?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Why would she be in trouble?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I don't know. I just thought since you were here. I don't know what I thought. I'm so confused.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: About what? It's all really quite simple. You see, Quark, your mother and I are in love.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: How did you two meet?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: We met at the Global Tongo Championships.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: That's right. I was playing in the Golden Masters Division.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: And I was tucked away in the sub-basement playing in the Female Division. Anyway, word leaked down to us that the Grand Nagus was having a little difficulty with his game.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: For some reason my purchases kept exceeding my sales.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: So I wrote him a note offering some helpful pointers on to firm up his play.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: And they worked! I made a spectacular comeback and won the tournament for the twenty seventh year in a row.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Zekkie sent me a very nice thank you note. Before I knew it, we were corresponding regularly.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Your mother's letters became the highlight of each day. It was clear we had to meet.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Imagine his surprise when he found out I was a female and your mother, no less.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I almost had a stroke. But I recovered.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: And we've been seeing each other ever since.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Does anybody know about this?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Of course no one knows. And you're going to keep it that way.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: My lips are sealed.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: They'd better be.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Jellied gree worms? Maihar'du, you are too good to me. He treats me like a queen.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: That's because you deserve no less.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Zekkie, they don't come sweeter than you.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I don't believe it.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: What's that, Quark?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Nothing. I've never seen you looking happier.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: That's because I've never felt happier. Well, my dear, time to get back to running the empire. Try not to miss me too much.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I miss you already.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: That's my girl.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Oh, Lobekins. Don't forget your appointment calendar.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Thank you, my prize. Your mother is a rare jewel, Quark. Worship her as I do.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Incredible.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Quark, if you're going to give me a hard time about this.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Give you a hard time? You and the Nagus? I couldn't be happier for all of us.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: No sign of a single vole. I think we got them all.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Chief, is it all right if I take a slightly longer lunch than usual? I need Leeta to sign this.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: The Waiver of Property and Profit?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Ferengi females aren't allowed to own property or earn profit. The WP and P states that in the event the marriage ends, the female gives up all claim to her husband's estate.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: And you expect Leeta to agree to this?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I agreed to wear the earring. So either Leeta signs this or the wedding's off. I may not be a traditional Ferengi but I'm still a Ferengi.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: It's your life, but I think you're making a big mistake.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I think I'd be making a bigger mistake if I didn't. Besides, Leeta loves me. You'll see, Chief. She'll sign it.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Are you crazy? I'm not going to sign this.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Why not?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Because a marriage is about sharing everything, including money.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Not on Ferenginar.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: We're not on Ferenginar.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: But I'm a Ferengi.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: And I'm not.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Females and finances don't mix. Rule of Acquisition ninety four.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: That's a stupid rule.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: It's true. You're just like her. You're after my money.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Like who?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: My first wife. Pretending that you care about me but all the time it's my profits that you really care about.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Rom, I love you, not your latinum.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Then prove it. Sign the WP and P.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Never.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Then the marriage is off.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: You bet it is.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: My dear, you reek of tube grubs.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: So do you, lobekins.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Are your ears tingling? Mine, too.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: So tell me, Nagus, how was your day?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Oh, you know how it is. Arcybite ore futures are continuing to increase, and the Bolians have finally agreed to allow the Ferengi Gaming Commission to take over their gambling emporiums, and er, er, oh, I have decided to allocate extra funds for research on a new breed of Hupyrian beetles. Those little fellows are going to revolutionize the entire beetle snuff industry.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Now that's what I call a busy and productive day.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: No wonder the Ferengi economy is growing at a record pace. Costs are down, profits are up.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: And opportunity is around every corner.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Zekkie, you've done quite a job.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: And your people love you for it. Your business acumen, your negotiating skills, your kindness and generosity.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Forget it, Quark. I'm not going to reverse the FCA's decision. They revoked your Business License and they're the one's who are going to have to reinstate it.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: But you're the most powerful man on Ferenginar. You can do whatever you want.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: True, but contracts are the very basis of our society and you broke a contract with another Ferengi. If I were to intervene on your behalf, I would be encouraging others to violate the law! And that, I will not do!

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Moogie, talk to him.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: He makes a very good point, Quark. What you did was wrong.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Thanks. I knew I could count on you.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: And I'd watch my tone of voice if I were you. Well, my dear, shall we take a stroll in your garden? Oh, and Quark, will you do me a favor? Help Maihar'du clear the table. He's not as young as he used to be.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Brunt, FCA.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: What are you doing in my closet?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Conducting official FCA business.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: In my closet?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I didn't want the happy couple to see me.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Happy couple?

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: Don't play innocent with me. I know all about their perverted little love affair.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: I had nothing to do with it. They met playing tongo. I only found out about it today.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: She's your mother, Quark, and that makes you responsible. And right now, she's endangering the very foundation of Ferengi society. I can see her, whispering in the Nagus' ear, contaminating his thoughts with her twisted, female philosophies. I'm telling you, Quark, if we don't put an end to their relationship, you're going to see clothed females walking down the streets of Ferenginar in broad daylight. If I had my way, I'd climb to the top of the Tower of Commerce and denounce your mother to the crowd below. But we must spare the Nagus even a hint of public disgrace. We've got to put an end to their relationship, but privately. Quietly.

title: Ferengi Love Songs
line: So what are you going to do?

For two centuries, I have watched it grow into something to be proud of. For generations these people have worked to make a life for themselves here. They deserve a chance to hang on to it.

title: Children of Time

And I will not ask Kira to sacrifice her life for eight thousand people, for eight million. No one has the right to ask that. I'm sorry, old man, but there is nothing I can do.

title: Children of Time

line: It is for the best. They are children. They would not understand.

line: I'm not sure I understand. Eight thousand people, Worf. They have to die because I have to go back to the station to be treated for some condition I can't even tell I have.

line: It would've been a good crop this year. Spring came so early.

line: It's nothing you need to worry about.

line: I understand. This is not a time for celebration.

title: Children of Time
line: Join me. There is something I wish to say. It is a great honor to know that my legacy has thrived on your world for so long. I can see the Klingon heart beats strong here.

line: You honor us with your words. We have tried to live as you taught us to.

line: Last year, I slew a yarbear three meters tall. Your mek'leth was my only weapon. The beast maimed me, and for a time it seemed I would die from my wounds. Now I wish I had. It would have been a warrior's death.

title: Children of Time
line: No. Ceasing to exist because my parents were never born? That is not a death worthy of Sto'Vo'Kor. Kill me, Worf. I have no enemies to fight, no glory to be won. Give me an honorable death.

line: I will come to you tomorrow and do what you ask.

line: That this is where I belong. The path the Prophets laid out for me ends here.

line: But not this time, Nerys. The Captain's taking you back to DS Nine.

title: Children of Time
line: I can't let him do that. Not if it's going to cost eight thousand lives. No, we have to let history take its course, even if it means I have to die here.

line: Kira, if we don't go back to the station you'll die within a few weeks. There's nothing I can do for you here.

line: I know that, Julian. I've accepted it. We've got to take the Defiant back in time, otherwise we're cheating fate.

title: Children of Time
line: I don't know those people. But I have a wife and kids back home who need me.

line: Your family will be fine, Miles. The Prophets will take care of them.

title: Children of Time
line: No offense, but I don't believe in your Prophets.

title: Children of Time
line: All Major Kira is saying is our families will survive no matter what we do. The colonists will not. If she is willing to sacrifice her life to save them, I am willing to remain here.

title: Children of Time
line: That's easy for you to say. You hardly see your son.

title: Children of Time
line: And you are afraid to face your destiny.

title: Children of Time
line: We can sit here arguing destiny until we're blue in the face, but the bottom line is, nobody has the right to tell me I can't go home to my family.

line: I want to go home as much as you do, Chief. I'm just listening to what everyone has to say.

line: Captain.

line: To the fields. It's time for planting.

line: Come on, Gabriel, there isn't much time. Put some of this on your face. The sun's strong today.

line: Planting day has always been important here. It brings everyone together. Somehow it feels right to see it through.

line: Thank you.

line: Thank you.

line: I'm busy.

line: You don't look busy.

line: She's an O'Brien, all right. Better get to it, Chief.

line: You said there was an enemy for us to fight.

line: They are attempting to plant their fields before the sun sets. Time is their enemy. We should help them defeat it.

line: Bring the others.

line: Ah, great. You know, I have a little girl named Molly, too.

line: We'll see.

line: By summer, this plant will be taller than you. After the harvested, I'll help my mother make gelm bread with it.

line: Molly?

line: Is something wrong?

line: We can't do it.

line: What?

line: We can't let these people die.

line: I don't know how to thank you for what you're doing.

line: We'd better go, Benjamin. There isn't much time.

line: You can't do this.

line: Please don't make it any harder than it already is.

line: You have to go home, Nerys. You have to.

line: This isn't about me. This is about the eight thousand people down on that planet, and their children and grandchildren.

line: They don't exist yet. These people do.

line: Nerys, just tell me one thing. If you'd known how I felt about you, if I'd said something years ago, do you think things might have been different?

line: Maybe.

line: So am I. I think we both need time. There's something else the other Odo wanted you to know. He was responsible for changing the Defiant's flight plan.

title: Blaze of Glory

line: Cadet, if there's a problem, I want to hear about it.

line: Well, sir, it's the Klingons, sir.

line: It's their attitude, sir. It's bad.

line: They're loud, obnoxious, and if I may say so, sir, generally intoxicated. They walk around the station like they own the place, and whenever a station security officer tries to talk to them, say to ask them to keep the noise level down on the Promenade, they ignore him.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You mean they ignore you.

line: They never look me in the eye when I try to talk to them, sir. They just stare over my head and pretend I'm not even there. I hate it when they do that.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I can see how that might be annoying.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Not as annoying as listening to him complain about it all the time.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Here is what I suggest, Cadet. The next time the Klingons refuse to acknowledge your presence, do what a Klingon would do. Confront them about it. If you stand up to them, you'll earn their respect.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Or get your butt kicked. One or the other.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Either way, they'll never ignore you again.

line: That does it.

line: But sir.

line: Captain, my crew and I were patrolling the Cardassian border. We intercepted a very disturbing message.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: This is a Maquis code.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I was as surprised as you. I thought the Maquis were wiped out by Cardassia and their new Dominion allies, but it would appear I was mistaken.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Were you able to decode it?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Michael, I hope you get this message. We've launched the missiles. They should reach Cardassia in thirteen days. It may not bring back our dead, but at least they'll have a lot of company.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Did you detect any missiles?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: No. But that proves nothing. A few months ago, the Klingon High Council decided to aid the Maquis in their fight against Cardassia. We provided them with thirty class four cloaking devices. It was our understanding they would use them on their ships.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: But they could have been mounted on the missiles instead.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You see the problem.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: The Maquis had access to tricobalt explosives, biogenic weapons, antimatter warheads.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: The death toll could be in the millions.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I knew the Maquis were desperate, but I didn't believe that they would resort to something like this.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: A saber bear is most deadly when it is trapped with no hope of escape.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Cardassia is under Dominion protection. If millions of their citizens are killed by human terrorists, they'll demand revenge.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: And their Dominion allies will see that they get it. They'll launch a counterstrike against the Federation, the Klingon Empire, and the entire Alpha Quadrant.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: And start a war that could destroy us all.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Report.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Do the words needle in a haystack mean anything to you?

line: We spent over fifty hours searching the Badlands for signs of the Maquis missiles, without success.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: We would have stayed longer, but we had a hard time avoiding the Jem'Hadar patrols.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Let me guess. They homed in on your plasma wake.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Even though we were cloaked, they were still able to track us.

line: The Defiant's warp engines are too powerful. They ionize the nebular gasses in the Badlands.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: It's like a Ligorian mastodon moving through the forest. You may not be able to see it, but it definitely makes the leaves rustle.

line: I need answers, people. If those missiles do exist, they're only eleven days from their target. I want to know where they are and how to stop them.

line: We need more information, a way to narrow our search.

line: Eddington, wake up.

line: I was wondering when you'd show up. I expected to see you here weeks ago.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I've been busy.

line: But now you're here. So enjoy yourself. Savor the moment. I know you've been wanting to gloat over my defeat for a long time.

line: I'm not here to gloat.

line: You deserve to. You won. I betrayed Starfleet by joining the Maquis. You swore you'd track me down and you did. You got your revenge.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Actually, that's what I'm here to talk to you about. Revenge.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: One of my favorite topics.

line: Michael, I hope you get this message. We've launched the missiles. They should reach Carda

line: Don't you want to hear the rest of it?
