line: Why should I? It has nothing to do with me. Michael is a very common name.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: True. But somehow I think you're the right one.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Guess again.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: If those missiles hit Cardassia, it could start a war. Billions of people will be killed.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: If you expect me to shed a tear, you're going to be disappointed. I used up all my tears when the Dominion slaughtered the Maquis. I sat here in this cell for three days and listened to the reports as they came in. In those three days, everyone and everything I cared about was wiped out.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I heard the same reports. It was a tragedy.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Your generosity of spirit touches me. But you don't give a damn about what happened to us, and I don't give a damn about what happens to you.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You may have taken off the uniform, but you're still a Starfleet officer. And you don't want a war between the Federation and the Dominion any more than I do.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: What you want and what I want doesn't really matter. There's nothing you can do to stop those missiles from hitting their targets. They're cloaked, highly maneuverable, programmed to change course at random. You'll never find them.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Maybe we can't locate the missiles, but that doesn't mean we can't stop them. You must have programmed in an abort code, some way to deactivate the missiles by remote.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Even if there was such a thing, you'd have to transmit it from the launch site. And I don't think you're going to find that either. No code, no launch site. I'm afraid you're out of luck, Captain. Looks like everyone's out of luck.

line: That's it? You're just going to lie there and do nothing.

line: That's what you do when you're in prison. Nothing. Just sit back and wait for the next counseling session, the next psychological evaluation, the next rehabilitation seminar.

line: What if I could get you out of here? Arrange a pardon in exchange for your helping me?

line: Anything you want.

line: What about bringing the Maquis back from the dead? Can I do that? Can you? Can anyone? No, I didn't think so. In that case, I'll tell you what I want. I want to lie here until the Jem'Hadar blow this place to pieces and me along with it.

line: I didn't really do anything. I was in the Bajoran shrine, meditating, and he burst in stark naked, and fell to his knees crying out to the Prophets for protection.

line: Morn, of all people. Who would have thought he'd just snap like that?

line: Why are you looking at me? I'm the victim here. He hit me with a barstool.

line: You're the one who set the ground rules when you came after me, Ben. You're the one who made it personal. You could've looked the other way. title: Blaze of Glory
line: He was a good man.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: He felt the same about you. He thought you were wrong about the Maquis, but he forgave you, which is ironic considering you never forgave him. You can't forgive any of us. And not because we betrayed Starfleet or the Federation, but because we betrayed you. That's what this is all about. Your ego. Where Benjamin Sisko leads, all must follow.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Is that what you really believe?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: It's the truth, isn't it? The Maquis were never much of a threat to the Federation, but we were a threat to you. We were a stain on your record and you couldn't have that. Not when you were so busy measuring yourself for an admiral's uniform.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You want to blame me for what happened to the Maquis? Fine. Go ahead, blame me. Blame Starfleet. Blame the Federation. Blame everyone except Michael Eddington.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: The Maquis won its greatest victories under my leadership.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Your leadership. Your shining moment of glory. Michael Eddington gets to take off his gold uniform and play hero. That's what you always wanted, to lead troops in a glorious cause. Well, you had your chance and look where you led them. Right into their graves.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: They died because I wasn't there when they needed me most. Because you put me in jail.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: They died because you filled their heads with false hopes. Sold them dreams of a military victory when what they needed was a negotiated peace.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: We had the Cardassians on the run.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: And they ran right into the arms of the Dominion. End of story.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Not quite the end.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: That's right. A few survivors of your noble crusade have decided to launch a pointless retaliatory strike against Cardassia.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: It's not so pointless. If you can't have victory, sometimes you just have to settle for revenge.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Is that what you want? To be remembered as the man who helped bring about the worst war in Federation history?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Not quite the legacy I had in mind, but I can live with it.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Can you?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: No, no, no. You can do better than that. You're barely making contact. Again! More wine!

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I don't care what anyone says. That's got to hurt.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: They're at sixty five decibels. Loud, but not loud enough.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: What are you talking about?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Five more decibels and they'll be legally disturbing the peace.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: And then what?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: And then I'm going to escort them to a holding cell.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You're going to arrest General Martok for disturbing the peace?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I am.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Aren't you going to at least call for backup?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Jake, you heard what your father said. They won't respect me until I stand up to them, alone.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Personally, I think respect is overrated.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: That's it. Seventy decibels. They're mine.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Whoaaa!

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You okay?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I'm fine. Just tell me when everyone leaves.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Why?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Because I'm not getting up until they do.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Eddington.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Are we there yet?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Where?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: That's the question, isn't it?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: There's something here I want you to see.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I'll pass, thanks.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Suit yourself. Maybe it's nothing. It is hard to get an accurate sensor reading in the Badlands. But unless I'm mistaken, two Jem'Hadar warships are headed our way.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Yeah, those are Jem'Hadar warships all right. You've got a problem.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: We both do. They're getting closer. One AU away. Point nine AU. You said you wanted to be blown to bits by the Jem'Hadar? Well, it looks like you're going to get your wish.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I have faith in you, Captain. You'll get us out of this.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Not me, Mister Eddington. I don't know the Badlands that well. But you do.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Where are you going?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: To get a raktajino.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Now?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Throat's a little dry. One raktajino.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You're crazy. They're almost on top of us.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: One thing I will say about these replicators. They sure know how to make Klingon coffee.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: They're scanning us.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: They should be in firing range any minute now.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Very clever, Captain, but it's not going to work. I am not going to take the helm.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Suit yourself.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: That is what you're trying to do, isn't it?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I'm trying to see how serious your death wish really is. I'm betting that it doesn't even exist. Just like I'm betting you won't be able to sit back and let your friends start a war that could destroy the Alpha Quadrant.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: That's an awfully big bet.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I don't think so. Point seven AU.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Can you lose them?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I plotted a spiral course around a plasma filament. It should dissipate our warp signature.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Very fancy.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You can take over now.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: No, I don't think so.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Let's get one thing straight, Captain. I'll get you to the launch site and I'll help you deactivate those missiles. But then you and I are going to have it out once and for all.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You want a fight, mister? I will give you one.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I don't intend to fight you, Captain. I intend to kill you.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Captain, when I joined the Maquis, I left some personal items behind on the station.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: As far as I know, all your things were put in storage.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You didn't happen to see an old Earth coin, about this big with a bird on the front?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: A bird?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: A loon, actually. My lucky looney. It's an old Canadian coin. Been in the family for over two hundred years.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: It's probably in some locker in the Assay Office, along with the rest of your things.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I hope so. I'd hate to think I'd lost it.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Speaking of things you thought you'd lost.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: There's no way those Jem'Hadar ships could have tracked us.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Obviously there is. Can we lose them again?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Dissipating our warp signature didn't work.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Don't tell me the Maquis didn't have plan B.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You're not going to like it.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Half an AU and closing. If you do have a plan, I guarantee I'll learn to love it.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: We're going to have to realign the impulse flow regulators.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You mean shut down the engines? They'd be on us in a second.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Who said anything about shutting down the engines?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You're thinking about realigning the emitter while the engines are engaged? One wrong move and the flow regulators will blow up in your face.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You mean, in your face. I'll be piloting the ship. When you finish, we can use the impulse exhaust to detonate the plasma field behind us. Even if the Jem'Hadar survive the blast, the shockwave should wipe out any trace of our ion wake. Point four AU and closing. You'd better get started.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: All right. But hold the ship steady. I don't want any accidents.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I'll do my best.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Hmm.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Warning. Attempting to access impulse flow regulators while engines are engaged is not recommended.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Tell me something I don't know. Disengage safeties. Authorisation Sisko A four seven one.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Acknowledged. Safeties disengaged.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Damn it, Eddington, I told you to hold this ship steady.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Sorry, captain. We ran into a pocket of boron gas.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Don't do it again.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You still there, Captain?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Disappointed?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Just checking. Captain, I hate to rush you

title: Blaze of Glory
line: But things are going to get very unpleasant if we don't get out of here soon.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I'm aware of the problem. Eddington!

title: Blaze of Glory
line: That wasn't me. They're firing at us.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: In that case, let her rip.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Well, that got the adrenaline pumping. No sign of the Jem'Hadar. Looks like we lost them, Captain. Captain? Computer, locate Captain Sisko.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Internal sensors are offline.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Of course they are.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I told you to keep the ship steady.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You're alive. What a pleasant surprise.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I'm sure. Now, get us to the launch site!

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I understand, but all I'm saying, Nog, is next time you know I have a girl over, just call me before you come home.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: The two of you were only talking.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Well, you never know.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Jake, I know your track record. You never get past talking.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Now that's a scurrilous lie.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Scurrilous? Is that worse than a regular lie?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Look, I don't know what the big deal is. Just check before you come home, okay?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Okay. And you do the same.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Nog, you haven't had a date since you left the Academy. Unless you're counting holosuites.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Now who's being scurrilous?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I don't believe this.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: What's wrong?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: They're loitering on the Promenade in our old spot.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I guess they know a good view when they see one.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Jake, don't you get it? They know I'm territorial about that spot. They're purposely doing this to insult me.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Nog, you are definitely getting stranger as you get older.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I can't let them do this to me. Stay back, Jake. This could get ugly.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: All right, it's time for you to move along.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: We will decide when it is time to move.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Station regulation eight two slash seven B clearly states that loitering on the Promenade is prohibited.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Is that so?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: It is. Now either move or I'm going to have to place you under arrest.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You are either very brave or very stupid, Ferengi.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Probably a little of both.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Indeed. Courage comes in all sizes. But don't tempt fate. Khi-gosH.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Nog, I'm impressed.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Klingons. You just have to know how to handle them.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Next stop Athos Four, a grim little fogbound piece of rock in the middle of nowhere.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: What better place to hide a missile launching site?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: We thought so.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: The sensors aren't detecting anything.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: That's the general idea. There's too much interference to detect anything, but it's there.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: We'll never get a transporter through all this static.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: We don't need to. There's a shuttle pad not far from the launch site.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Then take us down.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: How far?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: A few kilometers. This tunnel will take us most of the way.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: These tunnels are man-made.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I know. I helped dig them myself.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Now where?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Give me a minute to get my bearings. It's been a while.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You hear something?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: These barrels are made of duridium. That should hold them off for a while. I thought you said the Jem'Hadar would never find this place.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I didn't think they would. I was wrong. I say we rush them. In this fog, they'll have as much chance of hitting each other as hitting us.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Too risky.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You never would've made it in the Maquis with that kind of attitude.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: It's not me that I'm worried about, it's you. If you get killed, there'll be no way to stop those missiles.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Take this. I'll go around and try to draw their fire. You should be able to catch them off guard when they come after me.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I can barely see two meters in front of me. How will I know what I'm aiming at?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I'll be the one holding the pipe.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Attacking two Jem'Hadar soldiers with a pipe? That's a brilliant plan.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: It could be worse.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I know. It could be me holding the pipe.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Exactly.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You've got sharp eyes.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Not really. I just waited to see which of you was knocked down first, and then I shot the one still standing.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Thank you for your vote of confidence.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Now help me drag these bodies over to the well. Maybe that way the other Jem'Hadar will look for their friends and not us.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: In a couple of minutes this entire settlement is going to be crawling with Jem'Hadar. I suggest you get us to the launch site now.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: That way.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Are you sure?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Reasonably.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: We're close.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Then let's keep moving.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Wait.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Vance.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You knew him?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: He was a shuttle pilot, and a friend.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: There are more.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: This wasn't supposed to happen. We were winning. The Cardassian Empire was falling into chaos. The Maquis colonies were going to declare themselves an independent nation.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Eddington, listen to me. This is not the time.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: It's over.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: It's not over. We still have to stop those missiles.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: That's all you care about? The missiles?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: It's too late for us to help these people. But if we don't stop the missiles, this'll just be the beginning.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I was their leader. I was responsible for them and I failed. I failed them all.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Maybe we all failed them. Maybe we could've prevented this from happening. I don't know. It's going to take a long time and a lot of soul-searching before I find the answer, but right now we have a mission to complete.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I wish I knew for certain that killing you would make me feel better. But I suppose that can wait for another time.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: That's it.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You're sure.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You want to stand here and argue about it? Come on. It looks clear.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Wait.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I'm glad one of us remembered they can do that.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: No, wait. I don't want to damage any of the equipment. Let me try something.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Michael, I wondered when you'd get here.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I came as soon as I could. Captain Sisko, I'd like you to meet Rebecca Sullivan. My wife. All right, we're getting out of here. We've got a runabout hidden at the landing site. We can still access the tunnels through the old well. Stick together. Try not to lose each other in the fog.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Wait a minute. What about disarming the missiles?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Look around you, Ben. Does this look like a launch site?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Eddington, I want the truth. Now.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: There never were any missiles, no retaliatory strike against Cardassia. It was all a ploy, a way to let Michael know that we'd made it here.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: This was our fall back position. But I needed your help to evacuate these people.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: What would you have done if I hadn't forced you to come with me?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I would have volunteered. You should be smiling, Ben. That Dominion counterstrike you were so worried about, it's not going to happen.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Yes, you're right. That is good news. But I still don't like being lied to.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I hope you're ready to finish what you started.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Michael, we don't have time for this.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: We'll finish this later.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: All right, you heard what Michael said. Stick together.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You should've told me the truth. If I had known the Jem'Hadar were going to be here, I would have brought more men.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: The Jem'Hadar weren't supposed to be here. No one knew about this base but us.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: They landed three days ago. We tried to fight.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I know. I saw the bodies. I thought for a while there

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I didn't think I'd make it either, but they kept all the leaders alive. They were going to make a present of us to the Cardassian government. Now I guess we'll end up in a Federation prison.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: No, we're not going to prison. Not if I have anything to say about it.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Right now, I suggest you concentrate on getting off this planet. We can worry about the rest later.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: There's nothing to worry about. You're not going to put us in prison. Not this time.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Damn it, you never give up, do you, Mister Eddington?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Never.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Move!

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Go. Whatever happens, don't stop until you get to the runabout. You, too.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I'm staying with you.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I'll be right behind you. Now get going.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I didn't know you were married.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: We held the ceremony two weeks before you captured me.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Not much of a honeymoon. I suggest we fall back now.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: For once, you'll get no argument from me.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Go!

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You'd better get to the runabout.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: What about you?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I'd only slow you down. Just get Rebecca and the others to safety.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I'm not going to let you just

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Go!

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Mister Eddington, you are one stubborn, headstrong son

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I told you only one of us would be coming back from this mission.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Where's Michael?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: He's not coming.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: What do you mean, he's not coming?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Rebecca, we have to go. Now.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Okay, Crenshaw, Yuen, circle around to the left. Try to hit 'em from behind. Stiles, Dimitris, watch our right flank. Right. Seems like a perfect time for a song. Wish I could think of one. Does anyone know a good song? Something rousing? Too bad.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Rebecca.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Major.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: My earring clip. Where'd you find it?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: In maintenance conduit thirty three A. I guess it fell off when you were doing the deflector grid inspection.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You must've searched every crawlspace in the central core.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Just doing my job.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: And doing it with style.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Glad to be of help.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Cadet.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: General. Now that's better.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: What was that all about?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Respect.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: I'll say this for him, he was a complicated man. If you ask me, Eddington couldn't have picked a better way to go, at least from his point of view. He was a romantic, and what is more romantic than a glorious death in defense of a lost cause.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: He died fighting for what he believed in. I called him a traitor once, but in a way he was the most loyal man I ever met. He was a Maquis, right up to the bitter end.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Is that what this is? The end of the Maquis?

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Who knows? There could still be more of them out there, hiding from the Dominion, biding their time.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: You almost sound hopeful.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: There is something attractive about a lost cause.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Maybe you have more in common with Eddington than you want to admit.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Maybe.

title: Blaze of Glory
line: Good night, Benjamin. Get some rest.

title: Empok Nor
line: Welcome, welcome, welcome.

title: Empok Nor
line: It's a little quiet in here.

title: Empok Nor
line: Oh, you just beat the rush. Let me get your order before, er, before I get swamped.

title: Empok Nor
line: I'll have a Til'amin froth.

title: Empok Nor
line: And I'll have a

title: Empok Nor
line: What was that?

title: Empok Nor
line: What was what? Oh, that? It's just my nephew and Chief O'Brien repairing some conduit. You'll get used to it.

title: Empok Nor
line: The Klingon restaurant?

title: Empok Nor
line: It would be quieter.

title: Empok Nor
line: When are you two going to be done in there?

title: Empok Nor
line: When the conduit is repaired and brought back up to safety specs.

title: Empok Nor
line: Well, hurry up, before I lose all my customers.

title: Empok Nor
line: I need to get something.

title: Empok Nor
line: What?

title: Empok Nor
line: Two root beers?

title: Empok Nor
line: Hyper spanner.

title: Empok Nor
line: Optronic coupler.

title: Empok Nor
line: How did you know I was going to ask for a phase decompiler?

title: Empok Nor
line: I was paying attention, sir.

title: Empok Nor
line: That you were, Cadet.

title: Empok Nor
line: My father says that I can learn a lot from you. He says you can fix anything.

title: Empok Nor
line: I'm an Engineer. That's what we do. There. Good as new.

title: Empok Nor
line: Amazing.

title: Empok Nor
line: Damn!

title: Empok Nor
line: We repaired the leak right away. The problem is worse than I thought. The entire plasma distribution manifold is shot.

title: Empok Nor
line: Can you replicate a new one?

title: Empok Nor
line: No. Cardassian manifolds use a beta-matrix compositor which can't be replicated.

title: Empok Nor
line: I suppose we could contact Gul Dukat and ask if he has any spare manifold systems lying around.

title: Empok Nor
line: I'm sure he'd jump at the chance to help us. Any other ideas?

title: Empok Nor
line: We could send a salvage team to the abandoned Cardassian station in the Trivas System.

title: Empok Nor
line: Empok Nor?

title: Empok Nor
line: It's the same design as this station. The Cardassians pulled out about a year ago, but there's a good chance that the plasma manifold system is still operational.

title: Empok Nor
line: What about Dominion activity in the area?

title: Empok Nor
line: There hasn't been any for several months. Strategically, they seem to have lost interest in that sector.

title: Empok Nor
line: But there is one problem. It's standard Cardassian procedure to booby-trap a facility before abandoning it, and a lot of the surprises they leave behind are specifically keyed to attack non-Cardassians.

title: Empok Nor
line: Sounds like you should take a Cardassian along.

title: Empok Nor
line: So what did Captain Sisko do to persuade you to come along?

title: Empok Nor
line: How do you know I didn't volunteer?

title: Empok Nor
line: He threatened you, didn't he?

title: Empok Nor
line: Nothing so coarse. The Captain bribed me. He offered to help me procure a larger space for my workshop. The latest dressmaking equipment is surprisingly bulky.

I only wish I had a holo-imager so I could preserve this warm and wonderful moment of camaraderie. Something you could hang on the wall of your barracks. Have you tried the dabo tables? I'm sure one of my lovely hostesses would be happy to teach you the game. I know. A complimentary hour in one of our state-of-the-art holosuites? Whatever your desires, I'm sure we can satisfy them. Perhaps another time. Enjoy the evening.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Tough crowd.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I'm telling you, Odo, Dukat has only one thing on his mind, and that's revenge. He can't stand the thought that Bajor defeated Cardassia.

title: A Time To Stand
line: You think he wants to reopen the labor camps?

title: A Time To Stand
line: Eventually.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Well then, I suppose we should be grateful that he has Weyoun looking over his shoulder.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Maybe. Weyoun's a hard one to figure out. I don't really trust him but I trust him more than Dukat.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Weyoun knows that it's in the Dominion's best interest to honor its treaty with Bajor. They want to prove to the rest of the Alpha Quadrant that they're true to their word.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Weyoun asked me about you. He seemed very concerned about what you thought of him.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I try not to think of him.

title: A Time To Stand
line: He'd be hurt to hear you said that. I'll have to mention it to him.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I'm glad you can still smile.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Only when I'm with you.

title: A Time To Stand
line: That's kind of you to say.

title: A Time To Stand
line: No, it's true. When I talk to you, things don't seem as bad. When I think of Dukat in the Captain's office, or the fact that the Federation seems to be losing this war and we're here doing nothing.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I share your frustration, Major, but right now there's really nothing we can do but bide our time. It's like Captain Sisko said. Bajor must be kept out of the fighting.

title: A Time To Stand
line: And who am I to argue with the Emissary.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Thanks for waiting. Things have been a little busier than expected. This one's on the house.

title: A Time To Stand
line: What do you want, Quark?

title: A Time To Stand
line: The usual. Peace, love and understanding. Not to mention a generous profit margin, which I'm happy to say is looking more and more likely. You know, I never expected to say this, but as occupations go, this one's not so bad.

title: A Time To Stand
line: No, I suppose that's true if all you're worried about is a monthly balance sheet.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I'm not just concerned with profit, Major. Look around. Do you see any ghetto fences dividing the Promenade? Or exhausted Bajoran slave laborers sprawled on the ground after a grueling day in the Ore Processing Center? Do you hear the cries of starving children? I don't. Now don't get me wrong, I miss the Federation too. All I'm saying is, things could be a lot worse.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I hate to say this, but he's right. The Dominion seems determined to prove that it can be a friend to Bajor.

title: A Time To Stand
line: If it's such a good friend, why are no Bajoran security officers on the station?

title: A Time To Stand
line: I'm glad to see you made it back in one piece, Ben.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I was lucky. We lost a lot of good people.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Yes, we did. And we're going to lose a lot more before this is over. I hope you'll find this office satisfactory.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Office? I wasn't aware I'd be needing an office. I thought I was here for an assignment briefing.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I'm afraid you're going to be here longer than you think, Captain. As of right now, you're no longer in command of the Defiant.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Relieved of command? Why?

title: A Time To Stand
line: Admiral Ross didn't say. He did say we'll be getting our new assignment at sixteen hundred hours.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Well at least the crew's staying together. We are staying together, aren't we?

title: A Time To Stand
line: You can count on it.

title: A Time To Stand
line: So what do you plan on doing the next couple of hours?

title: A Time To Stand
line: I hadn't given it much thought.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Maybe now would be a good time to contact your father.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Maybe.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Benjamin, you haven't spoken to him for months. And Jake is his grandson.

title: A Time To Stand
line: How do I explain that I evacuated every Federation citizen off Deep Space Nine except his grandson.

title: A Time To Stand
line: You'll think of something. You always do.

title: A Time To Stand
line: You did what?

title: A Time To Stand
line: Dad, it's not quite as bad as it sounds.

title: A Time To Stand
line: You mean you didn't leave my grandson at the mercy of a vicious, bloodthirsty enemy?

title: A Time To Stand
line: Well, no, I did.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Then it's certainly just as bad as it sounds.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Dad, it was not my decision. It was Jake's choice to stay behind.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Oh, so now you're going to blame this on Jake.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I'm not blaming Jake. But he's not a child anymore. He's responsible for his own actions.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I don't care who's responsible. It's wrong and I want him back.

title: A Time To Stand
line: And so do I.

title: A Time To Stand
line: You think he's all right?

title: A Time To Stand
line: I hope so. I'll bring him back, Dad. I promise.

title: A Time To Stand
line: When?

title: A Time To Stand
line: That I don't know. It might be a while. I'm about to be given new orders, and I don't know where they're going to send me.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Tell them you want to go get your son.

title: A Time To Stand
line: It's wartime. It's not up to me. I go where I'm sent. How's the restaurant doing?

title: A Time To Stand
line: All right. It's been three weeks since I've poisoned anyone. Are things really as bad as the news service claims?

title: A Time To Stand
line: Maybe worse.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Well you certainly know how to comfort a frightened old man.

title: A Time To Stand
line: You didn't raise me to be a liar.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I raised you to be a chef, for all the good it did me. You know, there's something I just don't understand. You're always telling me that space is big, that it's an endless frontier filled with infinite wonders.

title: A Time To Stand
line: It's true.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Well if that's the case, you would think it would be more than enough room to allow people to leave each other alone.

title: A Time To Stand
line: It just doesn't work that way. It should, but it doesn't.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I'd better be going. The lunch crowd's coming in. You watch yourself, Ben. And bring me back my grandson.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I will.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I love you.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I love you too.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Hello.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Excuse me, Mister Weyoun.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Oh, please. I prefer just Weyoun.

title: A Time To Stand
line: That's the kind of detail people like to know. Would this be a good time?

title: A Time To Stand
line: For what?

title: A Time To Stand
line: For the interview we talked about. You know, for the Federation News Service.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Oh, I'm afraid that will be quite impossible.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Why?

title: A Time To Stand
line: Because I've read your previous articles and they left me with one inescapable conclusion. You are biased against the Dominion.

title: A Time To Stand
line: What gave you that idea?

title: A Time To Stand
line: You keep referring to us as the station's, quote, occupying force, unquote.

title: A Time To Stand
line: What's wrong with that?

title: A Time To Stand
line: It has a negative connotation. All your articles are filled with pejorative terminology, which is why I've been forced to withhold their transmission.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Are you telling me that no one in the Federation read my reports?

title: A Time To Stand
line: If I don't send them, they don't read them.

title: A Time To Stand
line: What about freedom of the press?

title: A Time To Stand
line: Please tell me you're not that naive.

title: A Time To Stand
line: The only reason I stayed here was to report on the occupation.

title: A Time To Stand
line: You see, there you go again. This is not an occupation. This is a Cardassian station, Jake, and I'm sure you're aware that there are no Dominion troops on Bajor. And why should there be? We have a treaty with them. They're our friends.

title: A Time To Stand
line: All right. I'm sorry. I didn't mean anything by it.

title: A Time To Stand
line: If you want me to send your articles to the Federation, you're going to have to provide a more balanced perspective.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I won't write Dominion propaganda.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I would never dream of asking you to. All I want is for you to keep an open mind.

title: A Time To Stand
line: All right, my mind is open. Now can we do the interview?

title: A Time To Stand
line: All in good time. You keep writing, I'll keep reading. Let's leave it at that for now. Good day, Jake.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Starfleet Intelligence has discovered what we believe to be their main storage facility for ketracel-white in the Alpha Quadrant. Right here.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Deep in Cardassian space. We need to destroy it.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Without the White to sustain them, the Jem'Hadar won't be able to function.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Without the White, the Jem'Hadar will die.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I won't shed any tears, not if it helps end this war.

title: A Time To Stand
line: It may be our only way we can end this war, short of surrendering.

title: A Time To Stand
line: How do you expect us to infiltrate Cardassian territory without the Defiant and its cloaking abilities?

title: A Time To Stand
line: I was wondering the same thing.

title: A Time To Stand
line: You won't need a cloaking device. We have something even better.

title: A Time To Stand
line: It's a Jem'Hadar attack ship.

title: A Time To Stand
line: It's the one you captured last year, Captain. Now you get a chance to see what it can do.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Do you even know how to fly that thing?

title: A Time To Stand
line: Not yet. But I intend to learn.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Guidance matrix, check. Aft parabolic thrusters, check. Sensor feed, check. Chief.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Reactor core, check. Induction stabilizers, check. Phaser coils, check.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Nog.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Resonance emitters, check. Subspace field grid, check. Signal subprocessors, check. I think.

title: A Time To Stand
line: You think? We've been training on this ship for two weeks now.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I would like to put a Jem'Hadar soldier on the Defiant and see how well he does after two weeks. These controls are very different. They take time to get used to.

title: A Time To Stand
line: We don't have any more time. We're about to take this ship into enemy territory. We don't want any slipups.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I don't intend to make any, Chief.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Good.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I still don't see why we couldn't install a few chairs on the bridge.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Because this ship wasn't designed for chairs.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Well, my feet aren't designed to stand for long periods of time. They get tired.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Maybe we should leave you behind.

title: A Time To Stand
line: My feet might like that, but I wouldn't.

title: A Time To Stand
line: It's not your feet that you need to worry about, it's your stomach. Have you noticed? There isn't a single food replicator anywhere on this ship.

title: A Time To Stand
line: That shouldn't be a problem. Captain Sisko says there'll be plenty of field rations.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Try eating nothing but field rations for three weeks and then tell me it isn't a problem.

title: A Time To Stand
line: You want to know what is a problem? No viewscreen. Who builds a bridge without a window?

title: A Time To Stand
line: The same people who build a ship without an Infirmary. Here's a list of all the medical supplies I brought on board. They're in my quarters, for want of a better place.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Don't worry, we'll try not to have any medical emergencies while you're sleeping.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I'm so glad that you find the lack of proper medical facilities amusing. But if trouble breaks out, it's not a viewscreen or a chair or even a sandwich you'll be wanting. It's a bio-bed with a surgical tissue regenerator.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Maybe. But right now I would settle for a viewscreen.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Or a chair.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Or a sandwich.

title: A Time To Stand
line: All right, people. Prepare for departure.

title: A Time To Stand
line: All systems ready, sir.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Garak, come to see us off?

title: A Time To Stand
line: Not quite.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I invited Mister Garak to join us. Considering we're heading into Cardassian territory, I thought he might prove useful.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Well, it's been known to happen.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Pull up a chair.

title: A Time To Stand
line: We're cleared for departure, sir.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Take us out, old man.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Aye, Captain. Aft thrusters at one half.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Bring us about.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Just wanted to make sure everyone was awake.

title: A Time To Stand
line: We are now. Just take it nice and easy, all right?

title: A Time To Stand
line: I can try.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Set a course for the Cardassian border, heading zero five four mark zero nine three. Warp six.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Yes, sir.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Come in.

title: A Time To Stand
line: You wanted to see me?

title: A Time To Stand
line: I always want to see you, Major. And therein lies the problem. It's been three months since my return to this station and you and I have barely spent any time with one another. Oh, I know you can point out the various meetings we've attended together, but they never seem to offer us the opportunity to venture beyond station business.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I don't have time for this.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Major! I haven't dismissed you yet.

title: A Time To Stand
line: What do you want from me, Dukat?

title: A Time To Stand
line: Come now, Major. Have the last three months been that bad?

title: A Time To Stand
line: Is that what you want? Is that why I'm here? To flatter you? To tell you know what a good job you've doing and how happy we all are to have you back?

title: A Time To Stand
line: Sarcasm doesn't become you, Major. It's your directness that I've always found most appealing.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Dukat, I've got better things to do than to stand here and help you play out one of your little fantasies.

title: A Time To Stand
line: You feel I've betrayed you.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Not just me, everyone. Even your own people.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Cardassia was on the edge of an abyss, Major. The war with the Klingons left us into a third-rate power. My people had lost their way. I've made them strong again.

title: A Time To Stand
line: At what price? You sold Cardassia to the Dominion.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Yes, a high price, to be sure. But look what we're getting in return. The Alpha Quadrant itself.

title: A Time To Stand
line: We'll see about that.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Yes, we will. Oh, I could make things very pleasant for you here, Kira.

title: A Time To Stand
line: You could start by doing something about your breath.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I'm a patient man. I can wait.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Wait for what? What do you think is going to happen here, Dukat? That you're going to wear me down with your charming personality? That I'm going to be swept off my feet by that insincere smile? Are you really so deluded that you actually believe that we're going to have some kind of intimate relationship?

title: A Time To Stand
line: Oh, we already do. Good day, Major. I have work to do.

title: A Time To Stand
line: There. I wish I had had more time to study the side effects of wearing that headset.

title: A Time To Stand
line: At least we know one side effect. Headaches.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Well, the headsets were designed to be worn by the Vorta and the Jem'Hadar, not humans.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Captain, may I make a suggestion?

title: A Time To Stand
line: Only if you talk softly.

title: A Time To Stand
line: We saw Dukat wearing one of these headsets during the attack on Deep Space Nine. Perhaps Cardassian physiology is more compatible.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Are you volunteering?

title: A Time To Stand
line: I suppose I am. This ship is equipped with two of them. If I wore one, then you wouldn't have to. At least, not all the time.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I agree with Garak, Captain. The less you wear it, the better.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Garak.

title: A Time To Stand
line: It's like having a viewscreen inside your brain.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Sir, there's a Federation ship off our starboard bow, bearing one five seven mark zero nine five. It's the USS Centaur.

title: A Time To Stand
line: That's Charlie Reynolds' ship.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I see it.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Cadet, open a channel to the Centaur.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I can't. Our comm. system's down.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Perhaps we should consider returning fire.

title: A Time To Stand
line: We can't do that. They're Starfleet.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Well, you tell them, not us.

title: A Time To Stand
line: We better do something.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Dax, get us across the border, maximum warp. I hope Charlie Reynolds knows better than to follow us into Dominion territory.

title: A Time To Stand
line: How long before we cross the border?

title: A Time To Stand
line: We just did.

title: A Time To Stand
line: The Centaur's still with us.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Charlie never did know when to quit.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I hope he knows what he's doing.

title: A Time To Stand
line: The question is, do we know what we're doing?

title: A Time To Stand
line: Captain, that last hit damaged one of our guidance thrusters.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Drop us out of warp. Come about. Prepare to return fire.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Yes, sir.

title: A Time To Stand
line: The Centaur has followed us out of warp.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Target their weapons array. Avoid their engines. I don't want to leave Charlie out here stranded on the wrong side of the border.

title: A Time To Stand
line: We're coming about for another pass.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Charlie likes to swing for the fences so stay in tight. Attack pattern Omega.

title: A Time To Stand
line: The Centaur is going to warp. It's heading back to Federation space.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Yes!

title: A Time To Stand
line: Nice work, Chief.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I didn't know I'd scored a direct hit.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Maybe you didn't. I'm picking up three Jem'Hadar ships headed this way.

title: A Time To Stand
line: He must have seen them.

title: A Time To Stand
line: They went right by us.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Without even bothering to say hello.

title: A Time To Stand
line: They're too busy chasing the Centaur.

title: A Time To Stand
line: You think Reynolds will outrun them?

title: A Time To Stand
line: Charlie's been in tight spots before. He'll make it.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I wish we could help.

title: A Time To Stand
line: We can't. Chief, get our comm. system back online. Return to course. Warp seven.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Yes, sir.

title: A Time To Stand
line: You should have seen the arrogant, smug look on his face. He was in control and there was nothing that I could do about it. The war isn't over yet, but as far as Dukat is concerned, he's already won. I'd love to show him he's wrong.

title: A Time To Stand
line: For the moment at least, I'm afraid he has won. Look at me. I don't know why I bother to sit here every day. I don't even have a security force to patrol the Promenade.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Then ask for one. Demand that they reinstate your Bajoran deputies.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Dukat will never agree to that.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Forget about Dukat. Go to Weyoun. He'll listen to you. As far as he's concerned you're a god, and that gives you power. But what good is power if you're not willing to use it?

title: A Time To Stand
line: We pledge our loyalty to the Founders from now until death.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Then receive this reward from the Founders. May it keep you strong.

title: A Time To Stand
line: You enjoy that, don't you? That constant reminder that you're their master.

title: A Time To Stand
line: The Founders are the masters. I am merely their servant, as are the Jem'Hadar. And you.

title: A Time To Stand
line: That may be. But even amongst servants, someone has to be in charge.

title: A Time To Stand
line: That is exactly the kind of observation I've come to expect from you, Dukat. Interesting, yet somewhat petty.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Forgive the interruption, but he insisted on seeing you immediately.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Founder, I'm honored by your visit. Is there someway I can be of service?

title: A Time To Stand
line: I want my Bajoran security officers reinstated.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Consider it done.

title: A Time To Stand
line: From now on, they'll be responsible for security on the Promenade.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I don't see any problem with that.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I do.

title: A Time To Stand
line: This is between me and Odo. I'll thank you to keep out of it.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I'll have my officers report to the armory within the hour.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Now that I've done something for you, perhaps there's something you'd consent to do for me.

title: A Time To Stand
line: A member of the station's Ruling Council. You?

title: A Time To Stand
line: Along with Weyoun and Dukat. Now I'll have a voice in station policy.

title: A Time To Stand
line: You're sure this is a good idea?

title: A Time To Stand
line: Dukat thought it was a terrible idea. You should have seen his face when Weyoun offered me the position.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Don't you see that Weyoun's using you? Your presence on the Council validates the Dominion control of the station.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I thought we were using him. I know the danger, Major. I've had to walk this line before during the Cardassian occupation. I can do it again, but this time I won't be alone. I'll have you to help me.

title: A Time To Stand
line: That's right, you will.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Then this is a victory after all.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I suppose it is. But for some reason, it just doesn't feel like one.

title: A Time To Stand
line: The ship ahead just transmitted a message to the asteroid storage facility. They're requesting to be resupplied with ketracel-white.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Looks like we've come to the right place.

title: A Time To Stand
line: The ship beamed down a hundred and ten empty canisters. Mow the storage facility is beaming up a hundred and ten full ones.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Everything ready, Chief?

title: A Time To Stand
line: I've got eighty three empty canisters standing by, and one not so empty.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Ninety isotons of enriched ultritium should take out the entire storage facility and everything else within eight hundred kilometers.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Which means we have to be nine hundred kilometers away before the bomb goes off.

title: A Time To Stand
line: The other ship is leaving orbit.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Dax?

title: A Time To Stand
line: The entire exchange took ninety two point three seconds.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I've asked for eighty four canisters of ketracel-white. Excellent. They're acknowledging my request.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Chief, set the detonator for three minutes.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Detonator set.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Three minutes? If it takes us ninety two point three seconds to make the exchange that doesn't give us much time, sir.

title: A Time To Stand
line: That doesn't give the Jem'Hadar much time to detect the explosive either. Commander, beam down the canisters.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Canisters away.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I hope whoever's in charge down there hasn't taken a lunch break.

title: A Time To Stand
line: The Jem'Hadar don't eat, Nog.

title: A Time To Stand
line: That's good. How do we know they're Jem'Hadar?

title: A Time To Stand
line: Relax, Cadet, everything's on schedule. They've just beamed eighty four canisters of White into our cargo hold.

title: A Time To Stand
line: I've acknowledged receipt and requested clearance for departure.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Good. Prepare to go to warp.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Standing by.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Captain, I think we have a problem. They've just raised the security net.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Repeat our request for clearance.

title: A Time To Stand
line: They're not responding.

title: A Time To Stand
line: If they don't drop the net before the bomb goes off, we don't stand a chance.

title: A Time To Stand
line: One minute and thirty seconds to detonation.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Do you think they found the bomb?

title: A Time To Stand
line: I doubt it. Not this fast.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Then why aren't they letting us go?

title: A Time To Stand
line: That's a good question.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Captain, they're responding. They're ordering us to stand by.

title: A Time To Stand
line: For what?

title: A Time To Stand
line: They're not saying.

title: A Time To Stand
line: One minute fifteen seconds.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Chief, can we punch a hole in the security net?

title: A Time To Stand
line: Sure. It'll take a couple of minutes.

title: A Time To Stand
line: We don't have a couple of minutes. What if we disable the net's power generator?

title: A Time To Stand
line: The explosion will do that.

title: A Time To Stand
line: Well that won't do us much good.

title: A Time To Stand
line: One minute.

title: A Time To Stand
