title: Favor The Bold
line: Besides, you think your big brother will let anything happen to you?

title: Favor The Bold
line: What can you do?

title: Favor The Bold
line: I'm not sure. But I'll think of something. No matter what it takes, no matter what I have to do, I'm going to get you out of here.

title: Favor The Bold
line: You do that and I'll work your dabo tables for free.

title: Favor The Bold
line: For how long?

title: Favor The Bold
line: An entire year.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Make it two.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Brother!

title: Favor The Bold
line: Shh. Isn't your life worth two years? Now, sit tight and trust your older brother.

title: Favor The Bold
line: But I don't want you to try to save me.

title: Favor The Bold
line: What are you talking about? They must have done something to his mind.

title: Favor The Bold
line: What mind?

title: Favor The Bold
line: I'm serious. Brother, you have more important things to worry about.

title: Favor The Bold
line: The bar's doing fine, but thanks for caring.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I'm not talking about the bar.

title: Favor The Bold
line: What could be more important than your life?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Destroying the anti-graviton beam to prevent the Dominion from taking down the minefield. You've got to finish what I started. The fate of the entire Alpha Quadrant rests in your hands. Billions and billions of people are counting on you.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Boy, are they going to be disappointed.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Brother, you can do this. You have to do this. You will do this.

title: Favor The Bold
line: What happens if I get caught?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Then we'll die together. Side by side, heads held high, knowing we did our best.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Oh, Rom.

title: Favor The Bold
line: But I don't want to die.

title: Favor The Bold
line: If that's what's written, then that's what's written. Now get going, brother. You have a lot of work to do.

title: Favor The Bold
line: So, tell me, Leeta what else is new? Have they fixed the sonic shower in our quarters yet?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Ziyal.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Nerys. I haven't seen you in weeks.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Do you have a minute?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Sit down.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I need you to talk to your father for me.

title: Favor The Bold
line: About what?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Rom.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Father.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Ah.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I need to talk to you.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Is something wrong, my dear?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Nothing that you can't fix.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Name it.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I want you to free Rom.

title: Favor The Bold
line: You're joking.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Not at all.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I can't free Rom, Ziyal. He's been sentenced to death by the Dominion.

title: Favor The Bold
line: You can pardon him. Don't you see, Father, this is your chance to show the Bajoran people, to show Major Kira who you really are. A forgiving, compassionate man. A great man.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Tell me something, Ziyal. Were you involved in any way with the plans to sabotage this station?

title: Favor The Bold
line: No, I wasn't involved.

title: Favor The Bold
line: You're sure of that? I can't help you unless you tell me the truth.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I am telling you the truth. The question is, have you been telling me the truth.

title: Favor The Bold
line: About what?

title: Favor The Bold
line: That the Bajorans are wrong about you. That you regret the horrible things you had to do during the occupation.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I do regret them, Ziyal. Deeply.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Then this is your chance to prove it to everyone, including me. Show us that you're capable of mercy.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Rom is an enemy of the state, and enemies of the state do not deserve mercy.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Spoken like a true Cardassian.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I am a Cardassian. And so are you.

title: Favor The Bold
line: No, I'm not! I could never be like you.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Ziyal.

title: Favor The Bold
line: You can't trust them.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I trust latinum, and so do they. Five bars will buy me five Nausicaans, a fast ship and very few questions. Breaking Rom out of the holding cell will be child's play compared to the things they're used to doing.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Forget about it, Quark. Freeing your brother's going to take careful, precise planning. It's not the Nausicaan way. They're thugs. They'll come strutting onto the station, look at a Jem'Hadar the wrong way and before you know it there's blood on the Promenade.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Think I can get my money back?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Major, a freighter loaded with Tammeron grain is due within the hour. See to it that Cargo bay five is ready to receive it.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I'll take care of it. I'll have a

title: Favor The Bold
line: Yes, you will. Now. That attitude of yours, Major, it won't be tolerated forever.

title: Favor The Bold
line: You don't like my attitude, Damar? You're welcome to try to change it.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I don't know what Dukat sees in that woman.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Then you need to get your eyes examined. One kanar. Want me to leave the bottle?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Maybe I should have you taste it first. Make sure it isn't poisoned.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Poisoning customers is bad for business.

title: Favor The Bold
line: True. But some people may place a brother's revenge above business.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Not this Ferengi.

title: Favor The Bold
line: You're a credit to your race, Quark. Unlike your brother, you've chosen to back the winning side.

title: Favor The Bold
line: All right, are you going to tell me or do you want me to guess?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Tell you what?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Oh, don't be coy with me. Either someone you don't like has died or your promotion came through.

title: Favor The Bold
line: It's better than that.

title: Favor The Bold
line: It's about the minefield.

title: Favor The Bold
line: What about it?

title: Favor The Bold
line: It's coming down.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Oh, I've heard that before.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Remember those field tests I was telling you about? They were successful. We've begun to deactivate the mines.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Well, you've got your work cut out for you. What's it going to take a couple of months? A year?

title: Favor The Bold
line: One week.

title: Favor The Bold
line: A week?

title: Favor The Bold
line: That's right. One week, and the Alpha Quadrant is ours.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Gentlemen, this mission cannot succeed without the involvement of the Klingon Defense Forces.

title: Favor The Bold
line: We agree, Captain. Chancellor Gowron does not.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Then you will have to change his mind.

title: Favor The Bold
line: The Chancellor is reluctant to commit such a large fleet to a single engagement.

title: Favor The Bold
line: He believes it would leave the Empire vulnerable.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Starfleet Command had the same concerns about Earth. But after careful consideration, they decided it was worth the risk.

title: Favor The Bold
line: General, perhaps you should return to Kronos and make your plea in person. The Chancellor has great respect for you. If you cannot persuade him, no one can.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I will go see Gowron and you will come with me.

title: Favor The Bold
line: No. The Chancellor no longer considers me a friend.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I know. But what could be better? An ally and an enemy both telling him the same thing. He'll have no other choice but to agree.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Gentlemen, I need those ships.

title: Favor The Bold
line: And you shall have them.

title: Favor The Bold
line: A week? Are you sure about that?

title: Favor The Bold
line: That's what he said. Believe me, this was no idle boast.

title: Favor The Bold
line: We have to stop them.

title: Favor The Bold
line: And end up in a holding cell with my brother? No, thanks. If we could only get to Odo, make him see what's going on. Then maybe he could help us.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Forget about Odo. First, we can't get to him. Second, even if we did he wouldn't help us.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Then what we have to do is warn Starfleet.

title: Favor The Bold
line: And how do you suggest we get a message to them?

title: Favor The Bold
line: You're asking me? You're the terrorist, I'm just a bartender.

title: Favor The Bold
line: There you are. From the look on your faces I can see you haven't had much luck getting Rom out of jail.

title: Favor The Bold
line: And the news just keeps getting worse.

title: Favor The Bold
line: It's not all bad.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Trust us, Jake, it is.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Not for me. I'm getting a message out to my Dad.

title: Favor The Bold
line: How?

title: Favor The Bold
line: I'm a reporter. I have my ways.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Come on, Jake, this is no time for games.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Morn?

title: Favor The Bold
line: He's going home for his mother's birthday or something. He has an encrypted message for my Dad in one of her presents.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Are you sure this is reliable?

title: Favor The Bold
line: I've known the courier for five years. I trust him.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Then we have a problem. According to this, the minefield's coming down in three days. The Ninth Fleet won't be here for at least four.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Then I suggest we go without them.

title: Favor The Bold
line: What about the Klingons?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Looks like we go without them too. We've run out of time, Admiral.

title: Favor The Bold
line: If those Dominion reinforcements come through the wormhole we'll have lost everything.

title: Favor The Bold
line: We take the ships we have, fight our way to Deep Space Nine and destroy that anti-graviton emitter. It's our only hope.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Do it.

title: Favor The Bold
line: There.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Where?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Over there. That flash of light was the anti-graviton beam hitting a mine.

title: Favor The Bold
line: And disabling its replication unit.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Exactly. Didn't you see it?

title: Favor The Bold
line: I'm afraid not.

title: Favor The Bold
line: For months you've been demanding that I take down those mines and now that it's finally happening, you can't even see it?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Weak eyes.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Excuse me?

title: Favor The Bold
line: My people have poor eyesight. It's something we've learned to live with. Jem'Hadar, on the other hand, excellent vision. I suppose they need it more than we do.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Ah, there's another one.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I'll have to take your word for it.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Once we disable the replication units in all the mines, we can detonate the entire minefield. And I guarantee you, weak eyes or not, that explosion you will see.

title: Favor The Bold
line: When will you be ready to proceed?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Approximately seventy eight hours. Three more days and we can start to bring the Jem'Hadar reinforcements through the wormhole.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Excellent. I knew you could do it, Dukat.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Did you?

title: Favor The Bold
line: I never doubted you for a moment.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Sir, I have new information on enemy fleet movements.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Go ahead.

title: Favor The Bold
line: The Second Fleet has fallen back past the Kotanka System, while the Fifth Fleet has pulled out of the fighting along the Vulcan border. Both fleets have converged here, Starbase three seven five.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Isn't that where Captain Sisko is stationed?

title: Favor The Bold
line: He's been made an adjutant to Admiral Ross.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Good for him. Now why have those fleets gathered there?

title: Favor The Bold
line: I'm not sure.

title: Favor The Bold
line: You're not sure? Two large enemy fleets break off from the front lines and rendezvous at a starbase and you have no idea why?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Well, we'll have to find out, won't we?

title: Favor The Bold
line: See that you do.

title: Favor The Bold
line: He should speak to you with greater respect.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Some day, I'll let you teach him that lesson. But right now, there's something more pressing I need you to do. It's of a personal nature, a matter of some delicacy. It's about my daughter.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Ziyal?

title: Favor The Bold
line: We've had a misunderstanding. I want you to go and convince her to speak with me.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Sir, I really feel I would be more valuable tracking the enemy fleet.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I've given you an order, Damar. We're on the verge of a great victory, and when it comes I want my daughter at my side. Is that understood?

title: Favor The Bold
line: I really believed my father had changed. That he wanted to be a man of peace.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I think he believes that too, when it suits his purpose.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Everything he's ever said to me has been a lie

title: Favor The Bold
line: Not everything. He really does care about you.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I don't care. I am not going back to him. You don't believe me, do you?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Right now you're angry and hurt, but that's going to pass. And then you'll have to decide what to do.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Ziyal, I need to speak to you.

title: Favor The Bold
line: You and I have nothing to talk about.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Maybe not, but you and your father do. He wants to see you.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Well I don't want to see him.

title: Favor The Bold
line: You heard her.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Stay out of this, Major. Ziyal, listen. Your father is a great man, a man of destiny, but he also carries great burdens. He knows our alliance with the Dominion is a dangerous one. If we show any sign of weakness, our allies will turn on us. That's why we must all help him remain strong. So I ask you to be a true daughter of Cardassia and stand beside him.

title: Favor The Bold
line: It should be obvious, even to you, Damar, that I am not a true daughter of Cardassia.

title: Favor The Bold
line: What's obvious to me is that your father should have left you to rot in that Breen prison camp. But he didn't. He took pity on you and it's your duty to repay him. Now come with me.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Let her go.

title: Favor The Bold
line: And if I don't, what happens then?

title: Favor The Bold
line: I was hoping you'd ask.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Did you kill him?

title: Favor The Bold
line: No, but I thought about it.

title: Favor The Bold
line: What are you going to do when he wakes up?

title: Favor The Bold
line: That's up to him.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I just came to wish you luck.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Thank you. My father says you can never have too much good luck.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Your father sounds like a wise man.

title: Favor The Bold
line: And he makes a fierce jambalaya.

title: Favor The Bold
line: What's this?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Ancient Bajoran texts.

title: Favor The Bold
line: The Emissary looks for guidance on the eve of battle.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Guidance, insights, loopholes. I'll take anything I can get.

title: Favor The Bold
line: And what do the Prophets tell you?

title: Favor The Bold
line: That I have a long way to go before I can make any sense of their prophecies.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Maybe when this war is over you can look at them closer.

title: Favor The Bold
line: That would be a change. Spend a week or two down on Bajor. Visit the Dakeen Monastery.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I've never been on Bajor. I hear it's quite nice.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Nice? That hardly describes it at all. There are parts of the Eastern Province that are like Eden itself. Lush green valleys covered in wild flowers that seem to spring up overnight. Hundreds of small, crystal clear ponds interconnected by waterfalls.

title: Favor The Bold
line: All right, all right, I'm convinced. I'm already planning my next R and R down there. You know, it sounds like when your assignment on Deep Space Nine is over and Bajor is welcomed into the Federation, you're going to have a tough time saying goodbye.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I don't plan to say goodbye. I plan to build a house on Bajor.

title: Favor The Bold
line: And what if Starfleet assigns you to a different sector?

title: Favor The Bold
line: I will go wherever they send me, but when I go home, it will be to Bajor.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Chief, I was just coming to see you. Can you believe it? They made me an Ensign.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I hadn't realized things were going so bad.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Scary, isn't it? If my classmates at the Academy could only see me now.

title: Favor The Bold
line: They'd be surprised, would they?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Amazed is more like it.

title: Favor The Bold
line: What do they know.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Anyway, I just want to say thanks for all your help.

title: Favor The Bold
line: My help?

title: Favor The Bold
line: I've learned a lot from you and not just about engineering. You've shown me what it takes to be a good soldier.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Don't let that uniform go to your head. You've got a lot to learn yet. And you will. Congratulations, Ensign. Wear it with pride.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I intend to, Chief.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Captain on the Bridge.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I've kept it warm for you, Ben.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Ensign, alert all ships. We're moving out.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Aye, sir.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Our initial intelligence reports have been verified. The Federation fleet is on the move.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Do we know their destination?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Yes. It appears they're headed here.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Here? Oh. He knows we're taking down the minefield. Someone must've got a message out.

title: Favor The Bold
line: So it would seem.

title: Favor The Bold
line: No matter. We'll crush them.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Yes. Yes, we will. But in order to do that, I'm going to have to pull a significant number of our ships off the front lines.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Do it.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Come in.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Once the minefield comes down we'll have more than enough ships to take their place.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I understand. One moment, please.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I want your permission to arrest Major Kira.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Kira? What about Ziyal? Did you talk to her?

title: Favor The Bold
line: She doesn't want to see you. When I insisted, the Major objected.

title: Favor The Bold
line: What did you do to Ziyal?

title: Favor The Bold
line: I did nothing to her.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Then why did the Major attack you? You must have done something, threatened my daughter in some way. Damar, I told you to be tactful.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Excuse me. Don't you think resolving family squabbles can wait until after we've won this war? Weak eyes, good ears.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Yes, of course. You're quite right.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Then you're clear on what must be done.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I'm going to call back enough ships to destroy the Federation fleet and hold this station.

title: Favor The Bold
line: The Federation is moving against us?

title: Favor The Bold
line: That's right. Now I want to know exactly what went on between you and Ziyal.

title: Favor The Bold
line: It's odd. I've stood here countless times, and yet somehow it all looks different.

title: Favor The Bold
line: It's the solids. They look small, don't they? Insignificant.

title: Favor The Bold
line: It's not their fault.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I'm not placing blame.

title: Favor The Bold
line: They're trapped.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Confined to a single shape.

title: Favor The Bold
line: A single perspective.

title: Favor The Bold
line: It's so limiting.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I feel sorry for them.

title: Favor The Bold
line: They need our guidance, Odo, not our pity.

title: Favor The Bold
line: They cherish their freedom.

title: Favor The Bold
line: We'll have to break them of that.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Break them?

title: Favor The Bold
line: In a manner of speaking. Oh, this language of the solids. It's so imprecise.

title: Favor The Bold
line: What exactly do you plan to do?

title: Favor The Bold
line: The solids are no longer your concern, Odo. What must be done, will be done. It's as simple as that.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Forgive me for intruding but I have important news about the war.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Why don't you return to your quarters, Odo. I'll join you there shortly. Don't worry. Everything will be fine. I promise.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I must say, you're doing a wonderful job with Odo.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Meaning what?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Meaning that he's always posed a potential threat to our plans, but you seem to have neutralized him quite nicely.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Neutralize Odo? Is that why you think I'm here? Odo is a changeling. Bringing him home, returning him to the Great Link, means more to us than the Alpha Quadrant itself. Is that clear?

title: Favor The Bold
line: I meant no disrespect.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Well of course you didn't. You are what you are, a loyal subject of the Dominion. Come, walk with me. You said you had important news.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Major!

title: Favor The Bold
line: Kira. Kira, wait, please.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I have nothing to say to you.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I understand that you're angry.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Oh, you bet I am angry. Do you have any idea what's going on?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Yes, somewhat. I've been occupied.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Dukat is bringing down the minefield, the Federation is about to be overrun by Dominion reinforcements and Weyoun has ordered Rom's execution and you have been occupied.

title: Favor The Bold
line: This is so difficult to explain.

title: Favor The Bold
line: If you're going to talk me about the Link, don't bother. I'm a solid, remember? I won't understand.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Nerys. I'm sorry.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Sorry? That's what you wanted to tell me? You're sorry?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Yes.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Well let me tell you something, Odo. We are way, way past sorry.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Sir, incoming message from the Cortez. They're still having trouble stabilizing the guidance thrusters on their port nacelle.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Tell them to drop back and make repairs. Bring up the Sarek to take its place.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Will do.

title: Favor The Bold
line: That's the eleventh ship to fall out of formation.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Nice of you to keep track, Garak.

title: Favor The Bold
line: He can't help being negative. It's in his nature.

title: Favor The Bold
line: On the contrary. I always hope for the best. Experience, unfortunately, has taught me to expect the worst.

title: Favor The Bold
line: I'm picking something up. It's a large Dominion fleet bearing zero zero four mark zero zero nine.

title: Favor The Bold
line: How large?

title: Favor The Bold
line: Twelve hundred and fifty four ships.

title: Favor The Bold
line: They outnumber us two to one.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Now who's being negative.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Ensign, on screen. Maximum magnification.

title: Favor The Bold
line: Aye, sir.

title: Favor The Bold
line: To all ships, this is Captain Sisko. Assume attack formation Delta two. There's an old saying, fortune favors the bold. Well, I guess we're about to find out. To Be Continued...

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: The Dominion won't attack Earth.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: How can you be sure?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Because Earth isn't the key to the Alpha Quadrant. The wormhole is. And whoever controls Deep Space Nine controls the wormhole.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Target locked.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Fire.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Execute Rom?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: He committed an act of terrorism against the Dominion.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You've got to finish what I started. The fate of the entire Alpha Quadrant rests in your hands.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: What happens if I get caught?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: If those Dominion reinforcements come through the wormhole we'll have lost everything.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: We take the ships we have, fight our way to Deep Space Nine and destroy that anti-graviton emitter. It's our only hope.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Dukat is bringing down the minefield, the Federation is about to be overrun by Dominion reinforcements and Weyoun has ordered Rom's execution.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I'm sorry.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: We are way, way past sorry.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: It's a large Dominion fleet. Twelve hundred and fifty four ships.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: They outnumber us two to one.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: There's an old saying, fortune favors the bold. Well, I guess we're about to find out. And now the conclusion.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Sisko to all ships. Cruiser and Galaxy wings, drop to half impulse. You too, Commander.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Half impulse.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I feel sorry for the Klingons. They're going to miss a very interesting fight.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I have a feeling we're going to miss having them.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Forget the Klingons. Our job is to get to Deep Space Nine and prevent the Dominion reinforcements from coming through the wormhole, and that's what we're going to do. Attack fighters, tactical pattern Theta. Concentrate your fire on the Cardassian ships, and then split off into squadrons and run like hell.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Why is he only targeting the Cardassian ships?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: He's hoping to get them to break formation and so they'll after the Federation fighters. He knows the Jem'Hadar will stand their ground, but the Cardassians just might get angry enough to take the bait.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Which would open a hole we can punch through.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You're getting quite an education.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Attack fighters in Theta formation. Cruiser and Galaxy wings at half impulse.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Sisko to attack fighters. Prepare to engage on my command.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Aye, sir.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Cannon to the right of them, cannon to the left of them, cannon in front of them, volley'd and thunder'd.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Storm'd at with shot and shell, Boldly they rode and well into the jaws of death. Into the mouth of hell rode the six hundred.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Whatever it is you two are reciting, I wish you'd stop.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Steady, Ensign. It's just a poem.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: It's not the poem that's bothering me.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Stop worrying about those ships. Focus on your work. That's what I do.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You should listen to him, Ensign. He's a professional.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Attack fighters full impulse. Fire at will.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: They're not taking the bait.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Ensign, send in the second wave. Tell them to keep targeting the Cardassians.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Aye, sir. Second wave on its way. Third and fourth waves on hot standby.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Mister O'Brien, have Destroyer units two and six move in closer. They need more cover fire. And tell Captains Diego and Reynolds to stay alert. They may try to outflank us.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: It's very clever strategy. But I'd expect nothing less from Captain Sisko.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: The Captain is a very clever man.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You do see it, don't you?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Of course I do.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Well then, perhaps you'd like to explain Captain Sisko's strategy to the Founder yourself.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I could never hope to match your eloquence.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: True. Sisko is trying to provoke us into opening a hole in our lines. He's determined to get here and stop us from taking down this minefield. Now I plan to give Sisko his opening and then close it on him.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: What about the minefield? Are we still on schedule?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: We should be able to detonate the mines in eight hours.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Good.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Eight hours. I'll hold you to that, Dukat.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I'd like to toss that smug little Vorta out the nearest airlock. And his Founder with him.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Now, now, Damar, that's no way to talk about our valued allies. Not until this war is over, anyway.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Sir, there is one other thing.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Make it brief.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I'm concerned about further attempts to sabotage this station. The enemy knows if they don't act soon, it'll be too late.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: By enemy, I assume you're referring to Rom's associates?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I doubt he was working alone when he tried to sabotage the station. He must've had help. His wife Leeta, Jake Sisko, Major Kira.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: What are you proposing?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: That we arrest them. Keep them in custody, at least until the wormhole is reopened.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: It's a wise precaution. But our Bajoran allies might object to an arrest without cause. If anyone asks, we're merely holding them for questioning. And Damar, make sure they're not harmed in any way. Major Kira is important to my daughter. And to me.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Sir, about your daughter. Perhaps it would be better, for her own sake, if Ziyal were confined to quarters.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: For what reason?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: To be perfectly honest, sir, I don't completely trust her. And neither should you.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Are you accusing my daughter of being a saboteur?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I'm not accusing her of anything. But she is quite friendly with Major Kira.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: That will be all, Damar.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: She doesn't appreciate what it means to be Cardassian or to be your daughter.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: But she is my daughter. That may mean nothing to you, but it means everything to me.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I heard the Federation fleet has been ambushed.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I heard two Cardassian soldiers saying the fleet was completely destroyed.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Don't believe everything you hear.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Jake's right. Sisko'll get here. The question is, will he get here soon enough?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: He's only got seven hours before they detonate the minefield and start bringing the reinforcements through the wormhole.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: We've got to stop them.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: How?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: What if we cut off the power supply to the main computer? Shut down the whole station.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Oh great. That would put me out of business altogether.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: It would also keep them from detonating the mines.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Okay, so we shut down the main computer. How?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: A bomb.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: A bomb? What kind of bomb?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Leave that to me. It'll be crude, but effective.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: The main computer is in the central core. It's too heavily guarded. You'll never be able to smuggle a bomb into there.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I'll plant the bomb. All we need to do is distract the guards.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: In here. Secure the doors.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Ah, Major, here you are. How nice of you to gather your friends for us.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I'm off duty, Damar. What do you want?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I want you to come with us. All three of you.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Where?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: To the security office. We have to ask you a few questions.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: What kind of questions?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You'll find out when we get there. Go ahead, Major, try something. Nothing would make me happier.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Don't worry. It'll be all right.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Of course it will. You have nothing to hide, do you? You certainly don't.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I'll say this for Captain Sisko, he is persistent. That's the ninth wave of Federation fighters he's sent against us.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Well, his persistence is about to pay off. Let's give him his reward, shall we? Have a half dozen squadrons break formation and go after those fighters.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Yes, sir.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Captain, two squadrons of Cardassian attack ships are breaking formation. They're going after our fighters.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: They're taking the bait. We've opened a hole in their lines.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Have we?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Sir, do you see those Galor class destroyers?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I see them.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: It's a trap.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: It is also an opportunity and we may not get another one. Ensign, have Galaxy wings nine one and nine three engage those destroyers. All other ships, head for that opening. Anyone who gets through doesn't stop until they reach Deep Space Nine.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Congratulations, Captain. You wanted them angry, they're angry.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: The Magellan and the Venture are supposed to be protecting our starboard flanks. They're in too tight. Ensign, tell fighter squadrons six, seven and eight to

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Sir, I can't get through to anybody. Communications are down.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: They're jamming our signals by generating a rotating EM pulse.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Can you clear it?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I'm trying.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: War is such thirsty work. Don't you agree?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Perhaps if you didn't talk so much, your throat wouldn't get so dry.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Cardassians do like to talk. I suppose it can be a failing at times.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: No.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: To the conquerors of the Federation.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Aren't you being a bit premature?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I don't think so. Not with twenty eight hundred Dominion ships waiting to come through that wormhole.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Those ships aren't going to be here for another five hours, and need I remind you a lot can happen in that amount of time.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Tell me, Weyoun, have you ever been diagnosed as anhedonic?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You think I'm incapable of experiencing joy just because I'm cautious?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: We didn't defeat the Federation by being cautious.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: We haven't defeated it yet. And even if we do, it's only the beginning. Holding on to a prize as vast as the Federation isn't going to be easy. It's going to require an enormous number of ships, a massive occupation army and constant vigilance.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I look forward to it.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I'm sure you also looked forward to occupying Bajor and we all know what a disappointment that was.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: On Bajor I merely implemented policy, I didn't make it. If I had, things would have turned out quite differently.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: If you ask me, the key to holding the Federation is Earth. If there's going to be an organized resistance against us, its birthplace will be there.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You could be right.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Then our first step is be to eradicate its population. It's the only way.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You can't do that.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Why not?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Because! A true victory is to make your enemy see they were wrong to oppose you in the first place. To force them to acknowledge your greatness.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Then you kill them?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Only if it's necessary.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I had no idea.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Perhaps the biggest disappointment in my life is that the Bajoran people still refuse to appreciate how lucky they were to have me as their liberator. I protected them in so many ways, cared for them as if they were my own children. But to this day, is there a single statue of me on Bajor?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I would guess not.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: And you'd be right. Take Captain Sisko, an otherwise intelligent, perceptive man. Even he refuses to grant me the respect I deserve.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You find that amusing?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Not at all. I find it fascinating.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Laugh all you want. History will prove me right.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I have news, Odo. Our battle with the Federation fleet is going well.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: There are people out there fighting, dying. People who used to be my friends.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: They're solids, Odo. You must remember that.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I know, but they still mean something to me.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: The Link means more.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: That's what I keep telling myself, but somehow I can't quite believe it.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You asked me for clarity, Odo. I gave it to you. Now you must accept it. It's Major Kira, isn't it? You still have strong feelings for her. She doesn't deserve your loyalty, Odo. You cannot allow a solid to deny you your rightful place in the Great Link. I couldn't permit it.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: What are you saying?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: The Major has been arrested.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: On what charge?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: That hardly matters. What matters is she will be found guilty and sentenced to death.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: No!

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Her death is be your salvation. Link with me. Embrace the clarity. It is the only thing that will give you peace.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: No.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You cannot help her, Odo. You cannot help any of the solids, no matter how much you may want to. It's too late for them.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Sir, we've just lost the Sitak and the Majestic. We're on our own, Ben.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Comm's back online.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Four enemy ships directly ahead.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Evasive maneuvers, pattern Omega. We're going through.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: That's one down.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Can you shake the other three?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I'm trying.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: We've lost aft shields. Forward shields are down to fifteen percent.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Wouldn't this be a good time to cloak?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: The cloaking system's fried.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Auxiliary power to weapons. We're going to fight our way out of this.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: It's the Klingons, sir. They're here. We're being hailed by Commander Worf.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: On screen.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Captain, I am sorry we were late. It was not easy to convince Chancellor Gowron to spare us any ships.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I'm just glad you could join us, Commander.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Captain, the Klingons have broken a hole in the Dominion lines.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Dax, can you get us through?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I'd love to try.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Any other ships make it?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: No, sir.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: We only have three hours before the minefields are detonated. Set a course for Deep Space Nine. Maximum warp.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: The Defiant has broken through all our lines. It's on its way here. Shall I order a pursuit?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: At once.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: The Defiant is no match for this station. If Sisko wants to commit suicide, I say we let him.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Don't scream. I won't going to hurt you.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I just have one question.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: What's that?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Do you know how to make hasperat soufflé?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Lunch for Major Kira.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Major Kira has already been fed.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: And I can only imagine the slop you served her. What I have here is hasperat soufflé, just the way the Major likes it.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: This is a jail, not a hotel. The Major will eat what the other prisoners eat.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Do you know who I am?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Gul Dukat's daughter.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: That's right. Now I suggest you allow us to deliver this food.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I can't do that. However, I will take the tray to her. After I examine it.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Er, is that really necessary?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Lift the lid.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: If you insist. You see? Hasperat soufflé, just as I said. Stop poking it. It's very delicate.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Now you've ruined it.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: How much longer before they detonate the minefield?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I wish you'd stop asking that.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Sorry.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I'd say about ninety minutes.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: My time grows short.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Don't say that.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: The only reason they haven't killed me yet is that I'm part of their victory celebration. Seven o'clock, Dukat makes a speech. Eight thirty, cake and raktajino. Eight forty five, execute the Ferengi.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: All right, no one move!

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Brother! I knew you would come.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: It's a surprise to me. Now, just keep calm and stay where you are. Understand? Don't move. You, open the holding cells. I said, open the holding cells.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You just told them not to move.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Right. Nobody moves except you. Now open the cells.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Quark.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Yes?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Take down the forcefields.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Forcefields?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I'd kiss you, Quark, but there isn't time. We have to find a way to shut down the power to the main computer.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I can do that.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Oh, Rom.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: That is, if we can make it to the central computer core without being killed.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Right, Rom, you're with me. The rest of you, find someplace to stay out of sight.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Will do.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I know you're confused, Odo, but you don't have to be. All the answers you seek are in the Link.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Come in.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Forgive the intrusion, but Major Kira, the Ferengi saboteur and the rest of their terrorist group have escaped from the holding cells. For your own protection, I must ask you to come with me.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I want them caught.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: They will be. But in the meantime, you'd both be safer in Ops.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Very well. Odo?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I'll be fine here.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You're sure?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Yes.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Get out of here.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Do you hear that? That's Bajoran phaser fire.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Why would Dominion troops be using Bajoran weapons?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Never underestimate the element of surprise.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You have less than forty minutes to shut down the main computer.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I hope that's enough time.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: It'll have to be. Can you keep the Dominion patrols off our backs?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I'll head down to Security, create enough false alarms to keep them occupied. Any questions?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I could ask why.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I don't think there's time to explain it. Besides, I think you know the answer.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: What about the Link?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: The Link was paradise. But it appears I'm not ready for paradise. Good luck.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You too.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Dax, what's our ETA?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Eleven minutes.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: That's cutting it close.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: How's it going, Rom?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I wish you'd stop asking that.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Sorry, sorry.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I'm not going to make it.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: All right then, concentrate on cutting off the power to the station's weapons array. Without weapons they won't be able to detonate the minefield.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Not for a while anyway.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Sir, the Klingons have outflanked us. Our lines are beginning to crumble.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: There's nothing to worry about. In exactly four minutes, thousands of Dominion ships will come pouring through that wormhole. I just hope the Defiant gets here in time for Sisko to see it.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Ben, if I were you, I'd start coming up with a plan B.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Almost there. I just need to decouple the ODN relays.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: The last mines have been neutralized. We're ready to detonate the minefield, sir.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Fire.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Done.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Uh-oh.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: What is it?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: We were too late.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: What do we do now, Captain?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Take us into the wormhole.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: What the hell. We're only going to meet a couple of thousand Dominion ships.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: One ship against an entire fleet? That's a hell of a plan B.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Chief, how does that poem end?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You don't want to know.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Send a message to our listening posts in the Gamma Quadrant. Tell the reinforcements that the Alpha Quadrant awaits them.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Sir, the Defiant. It's heading for the wormhole.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Destroy it.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: What's wrong, Damar?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Our weapons, they're offline. They've been sabotaged.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: How can that be?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Major Kira.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Full stop. Chief, divert all power to forward shields and weapons.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Captain, I'm reading multiple warp signatures ahead.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: On screen. Maximum magnification.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Lock phasers. Prepare to launch quantum torpedoes.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Why have you brought me here? Show yourselves. What do you want?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: The Sisko has returned to us.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: He arrives with questions.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: There are always questions.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I didn't ask to come here.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You desire to end the game.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: What game? I don't understand.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You seek to shed your corporeal existence.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: That cannot be allowed.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: The game must not end.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: The game? You mean my life? Is that what this is about? You don't want me to die?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: The game must continue.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You are the Sisko.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Believe me, I don't want to die, but I have to do everything I can to prevent the Dominion from conquering the Alpha Quadrant. If that means sacrificing my life and the life of my crew, so be it.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: We do not agree.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: We find your reasoning flawed.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Insufficient.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I'm flattered you feel that way, but it doesn't change anything. Now send me back to my ship.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: This isn't what I meant. I want to return to my reality.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You are the Sisko.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I am also a Starfleet captain. I have a job to do and I intend to do it.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: The Sisko is belligerent.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Aggressive.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Adversarial.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: You're damn right I'm adversarial. You have no right to interfere with my life.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: We have every right.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Fine. You want to interfere, then interfere. Do something about those Dominion reinforcements.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: That is a corporeal matter.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Corporeal matters do not concern us.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: The hell they don't. What about Bajor? You can't tell me Bajor doesn't concern you. You've sent the Bajorans orbs and Emissaries. You've even encouraged them to create an entire religion around you. You even told me once that you were of Bajor. So don't you tell me you're not concerned with corporeal matters. I don't want to see Bajor destroyed. Neither do you. But we all know that's exactly what's going to happen if the Dominion takes over the Alpha Quadrant. You say you don't want me to sacrifice my life? Well, fine, neither do I. You want to be gods, then be gods. I need a miracle. Bajor needs a miracle. Stop those ships.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: We are of Bajor.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: But what of the Sisko?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: He is intrusive.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: He tries to control the game.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: A penance must be exacted.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: It is agreed.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: The Sisko is of Bajor, but he will find no rest there.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: His pagh will follow another path.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: What path is that?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Phaser banks fully charged.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Forward shields at a hundred percent.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Torpedoes ready. Targets locked.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Here they come.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Fire on my command.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: There must be thousands of them.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: And half of them have locked targets on us.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Steady, people. Make every shot count.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Benjamin.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: They've cloaked.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I'm not picking up any neutrino emissions.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Then where did they go?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Wherever they went, I don't think they're coming back.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Sir, the wormhole is opening.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: The Defiant.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: Our reinforcements must be right behind.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: No, sir. There's no sign of them.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: That's impossible. Check our listening posts in the Gamma Quadrant.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: They're not there either.

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: But they entered the wormhole. Where are they?

title: Sacrifice of Angels
line: I don't know.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Not closed! We're going through with this.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: I'm not going to be a party to treason.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Call it what you want, but I am willing to do it if it means saving billions of lives. So are you with us?

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: No. Haven't you been listening?

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Fine.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: So how do we contact the Dominion?

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Still at it, I see.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: I've been looking over Sisko's latest counter-proposal. We don't seem to be getting anywhere with him.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Not very encouraging, is it?

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: I don't know why you had me call for peace talks in the first place.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: My, my, how quickly you've taken to your new role. And to think only a short time ago you were nothing more than Gul Dukat's adjutant.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: I appreciate the faith you've shown in me.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Then show some faith in me. Don't be like your predecessor, second guessing my every move. It should be clear to you by now that no one is irreplaceable. Now, I just received a very interesting message from an unidentified party claiming to have some information that could be very beneficial to us.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: What sort of information?

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: I don't know but we're going to find out.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Computer. Computer, respond.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Sarina, where is everyone? Did they arrange a meeting with the Dominion? Listen, we have to stop them before it's too late. Untie me. Please, Sarina. You don't want the deaths of so many people on your hands. It's Jack, isn't it? Are you worried what he'll think? I've seen the way you look at him when you think no one's watching. I know how much you care, but if you don't let me stop them, you know what's going to happen? They're going to be arrested and charged with treason and you're never going to see any of them again. You're never going to see Jack again.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: I'm Patrick.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Patrick! Come on.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Hello, everyone.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: He's not supposed to be here.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: No, no, no he's not. I don't understand.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Well, why don't we all go back to your quarters and I will explain it to you.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: No, we've got to do this. Lives are at stake.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Don't interfere, Julian.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: You have no right.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: You're in enough trouble already, Jack. Don't make it any worse. Now we can do this the easy way or the hard way. It's up to you.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Where are they?

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: They'll be here.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: This is ridiculous. Sneaking into a storage bay for a secret meeting. I'm not some agent of the Obsidian Order, I'm the leader of the Cardassian Empire.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Don't let it go to your head. You serve only at the Dominion's pleasure. Besides, I think it's exciting.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: They're here. Odo?

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Yes, I know. I honor you with my presence.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: We seem to have gotten ourselves lost.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: They're not coming.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Who's not coming?

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: I had a feeling you were going to say that. Shall I escort you to your quarters?

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Captain Sisko has decided not to press charges. You won't be going to prison.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: What are they going to do to us?

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Nothing bad. You'll be going back to the Institute together.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: It doesn't matter what happens to us. Don't you realize what you've done?

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: I kept you from committing treason.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Are we supposed to thank you? Nine hundred billion people are going to die.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: We don't know that.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Didn't you sit here and go through the projections with us? Didn't you?

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: He was here, Jack. I remember.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Maybe our projections were wrong.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: How can you say that? We factored in every contingency, every variable. The equations don't lie. You. You ruined everything.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: What do you make of that, Jack? Why didn't you anticipate that? Why didn't you factor her into your equation? Because you thought you knew everything, but you didn't even know what was going to happen in this room. One person derailed your plans. One person changed the course of history. Now, I don't know about you, but that makes me think that maybe, just maybe, things may not turn out the way we thought.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: I heard what happened. It was a pretty close call.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Yeah. Luckily I managed to intercept them in time.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: No, that's not what I meant. I was talking about when you had to decide whether or not to meet with the Dominion. Can't have been easy for you. I know you wanted to try to save as many lives as possible. It's probably what makes you such a good doctor.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Fortunately this doctor is also a Starfleet Officer. We thought we were so smart. We thought we could predict the future. It's my fault, not theirs. I should never have let things go so far. If I hadn't been so bent on trying to prove to the world that they had something to contribute.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: They did contribute. It seems to me we've become far too complacent about the Dominion. We may have driven them back into Cardassian space, but we've haven't beaten them yet.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: We can only hope.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Well, the odds are stacked against us. All we can do is give it our best shot.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: You're not going to cause any more trouble, are you?

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Not this time. I'll double down.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Risky.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Maybe there's a better bet, but sometimes when the odds are so stacked against you, you've just got to take a chance.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: I admire your courage.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Dabo!

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Well, what do you know. We have a winner.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: O'Brien to Bashir.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Go ahead.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: You wanted to know when a certain transport was leaving.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Oh, thanks.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: There is one problem, though. We've got some passengers that are refusing to board unless you come see them.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: I didn't think you'd want to see me again.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Believe me, I wouldn't mind if our predictions turned out to be wrong. Jack's still furious, but I didn't want to leave without saying goodbye.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Will you come visit us?

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: What? Oh, yes, I'd like that. You did the right thing, you know. One of these day he'll understand that. So, you ready to go?

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Not so fast. There's one thing I need to know, Doctor. If we can come up with a way to beat the Dominion, will you listen?

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: I can't think of anything I'd like better.

title: Statistical Probabilities
line: Good, good, good. Let's go then. Let's go.
