line: Bashir to O'Brien. Four to beam out.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Just set them on the bar. Morn, no touching. You know what this is? Three cases of syrup of squill.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I love syrup of squill on my groatcakes, but I haven't seen a jar in over a year.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: No one has.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Does that mean the drought on Balancar is over?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: There never was a drought on Balancar. It was all a ploy by their Agricultural Consortium. They've been stockpiling squill so they could drive the price up.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: That's dishonest.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I couldn't agree more. You see, I once did business with the nephew of the cousin of the stepsister of a friend of the secretary to the Consortium's chief accountant. Nephew, cousin, stepsister, friend. Yeah, that's right. And he told me, in passing, that the accountant had bought himself a very nice pair of Ferengi rain slippers.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: And if there was a drought, he wouldn't need rain slippers.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: My thoughts exactly. So I set up a meeting with this accountant and I told him that he either provide me with a shipment of syrup, or I would expose their deception to the entire quadrant. Tomorrow morning, we are having a special on groatcakes, topped with syrup of squill. That is, for everyone who can afford it. What are you standing around for? Get these crates in the storeroom. This stuff is worth its weight in latinum. Which reminds me of another little economic episode of mine. It happened, say, oh, eleven or twelve years ago, shortly before I came on the station

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Dax, Julian! You're back! I was so worried.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I told you we'd be okay.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Then why all the secrecy about your mission?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: We weren't supposed to talk about it.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: But now it's okay. The mission's over, we've been debriefed. We took the Defiant behind enemy lines.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: We're the first reconnaissance mission into Cardassian space since the Dominion's retreat. The first one to make it back, anyway.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: And if that isn't reason to celebrate, I don't know what is.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Three synthales.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Coming right up.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Something wrong, Quark?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Yes, something's wrong. A bunch of self-satisfied Starfleet officers just stole my audience.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: They're not just Starfleet officers, they're heroes. Let's face it, Quark, there's nothing heroic about earning profit.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: There is on Ferenginar.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: We're not on Ferenginar.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: The Nagus calling me now? He must have found out about the squill. I have to send him a jar. No, better make it a dozen. He loves squill.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Oh, there you are. I've been looking all over the station for you.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Well, you found me. Now you go hide and I'll search for you.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Rom, brace yourself. I have bad news. Our mother's been taken prisoner by the Dominion.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Moogie? A prisoner?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: It gets worse. The Nagus wants me to rescue her.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You? Rescue Moogie? From the Dominion?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Yeah.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Uh oh.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Uh oh is right.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: So, how do you plan on rescuing Moogie?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You mean, how do we plan on rescuing Moogie.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I don't recall you saying the Nagus wanted me to go along.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Maybe he doesn't, but I do. Besides, Ishka's your mother too.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: And I love her. But I can't go with you. I'm a married man. I have responsibilities. And my responsibilities don't want me to die.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I don't want to die either. So let's just concentrate on the reward the Nagus is offering.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Reward?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Fifty bars of gold pressed latinum.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Fifty bars! Ow.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Which I'm willing to share with you.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: An even split?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Absolutely. Thirty bars for me and twenty for you.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: That's not even.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: It is when you include my finder's fee.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Right.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: There's one thing I still don't understand. How did the Dominion get a hold of Moogie?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: They captured the transport ship she was on.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: But she's a female. They're forbidden to travel off of Ferenginar.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Moogie's an exception. The Nagus gave her special dispensation to travel to Vulcan for her operation.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: What operation?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: She wanted to have her ears raised.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I had no idea.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: That she was so vain?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: That the Nagus could be so generous.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: He certainly is.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: But why is he being so good to Moogie?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Brother, there's something I need to tell you

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You mean that ten bars of latinum is an overly generous finder's fee? I already know that.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: It's about the Nagus and Moogie.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: What about them?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: They're lovers.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: No.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: It's been going on for over a year.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: No.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: She's his secret financial advisor. She helps him run the entire Ferengi Alliance.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: No!

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Would you stop saying that.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: May I help you, gentlemen?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I was following you.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: We must have taken a wrong turn.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: It looks that way.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Much better.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You know, brother I've been thinking. We can't rescue Moogie from a Dominion internment center. Not alone, anyway.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You're right. We're going to need help.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: We could put together a commando team. Gather the toughest mercenaries we can find. Nausicaans, Breen, Klingons.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Shh. We don't need Nausicaans, Breen or Klingon.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Humans?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: We'll just use Ferengi.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Then we'll all die.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: No, we won't. Ferengi can be just as tough as Klingons.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: They can?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Of course they can. They just need the opportunity, the training, and a couple of bars of latinum as incentive.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Coming out of my share, I suppose.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: No, we'll split the reward with whoever joins us. All twenty bars of it.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: But the Nagus offered fifty.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: As far as anyone else is concerned, he said twenty.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Twenty it is then.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Now the only question is, who's our first recruit?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Not me.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: But Nog, Moogie needs you!

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Not to mention your Nagus.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: They need you, we need you. Say you'll join us. Please.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I'm a Starfleet officer. I can't go running off with you on some half baked rescue mission. I have duties to perform.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: But you know how to fire a phaser.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Forget it, Rom. Don't beg. Too bad, though. We were going to make you Strategic Operations officer.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You mean like Commander Worf?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Exactly like Commander Worf. Think of it, Nog. You'll devise the tactics, come up with a plan of action.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You can be the team's drill instructor. Put us through our paces. Prepare us for combat.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Turn us into soldiers.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: That's a big job.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: That's why we need you.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: How big is the team?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Right now?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Now remember, Leck is not your typical Ferengi. His priorities are different than ours.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I understand, brother.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: No you don't, but you will.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I hope this is a secure channel.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I followed your instructions to the letter.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Very good. Who do you want eliminated?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: It's not that kind of job.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Then why call an eliminator?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: What's an eliminator?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Shh. I'm putting together a little rescue mission and I'd like you to be part of my team.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I work alone.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You'll be paid in latinum.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I don't care about latinum.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You're right. His priorities are different.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: All right, forget the latinum. I've been told you like the opportunity to test your abilities.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I enjoy a challenge.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Then you should know this. that the person we're going to rescue is being held by the Dominion.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: The Dominion?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Should be quite a challenge.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: How the mighty have fallen.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Cousin Quark.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I hear you were arrested on Thalos Six for vagrancy.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: And it's all your fault. I was a thriving weapons merchant until I went into business with you. You ruined me. If I ever get out of here, cousin, I'll make you pay for what you did to me.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Lower the forcefield. Now what exactly is it you're going to do to me?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I don't understand.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Quark paid your fine. You're a free man.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: What do I have to do in return?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Earn some latinum.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Tell me more.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: On the bar, you will find a PADD with a schematic of a Dominion internment center. You may now examine the schematic.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: How can we be sure these schematics are accurate?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Sir.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: No need to stand on formality here. Just call me Leck.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: No, I meant you should call me sir.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Don't be ridiculous.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You mean, don't be ridiculous, sir.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Gentleman, please. Let's not squabble. We're a team, Nog.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: We're a team, sir.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Stay out of this. Listen to me, Nog.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: That's it, I quit.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You can't quit. This is not a game.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: How are we supposed to get to this internment center anyway?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: By ship.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Do we have a ship?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: We'll get one.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: We don't have a ship?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I said we'll get one.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: How?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: We'll find one.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Where?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I don't know. Think of it as a challenge.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Liquidator Brunt.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: That's ex-liquidator Brunt. Thanks to your brother, I'm no longer with the Ferengi Commerce Authority. A child, a moron, a failure and a psychopath. Quite a little team you've put together.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: What do you want, Brunt?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I'm here to sign up. I'm going to help you rescue your mother.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: What?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: How did you know about Moogie?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I know a lot of things.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You think if you help save my mother, the Nagus will give you your old job back.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: When do we leave?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: We're not leaving. Not with you.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: That's one thing we can all agree on.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: No one likes Liquidators.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Or even ex-liquidators.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: The team has spoken.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Besides, there's a twenty bar reward to consider.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Better to split it five ways than six.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Fine. I'll just get in my ship and leave.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Did you say ship?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: That's right. Why?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Now we are six.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Don't move! You're surrounded.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Don't shoot! I surrender!

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: No, no, no! Computer, freeze program. Reset Jem'Hadar.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I think we're getting better.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: No, you're not. This is the eighth run through and you haven't been able to hit a single Jem'Hadar. And you shot Moogie.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I saw we weren't going to rescue her so I put her out of her misery.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Who invited him along?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Maybe we should start off with something easier.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Like what?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Like ambushing a couple of Bolians.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You couldn't ambush a Bolian if he was blindfolded and tied to a tree.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: That's enough! Get out of here, all of you. You heard me. Go.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: But, Brother, don't you want to keep practicing?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: We're wasting our time, Rom. We couldn't get anywhere near Moogie, let alone rescue her.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I guess we're not cut out to be heroes after all.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: And to think, just a few short days ago I was sitting on top of the world. The king of squill. You should've been there, brother. It was a very delicate negotiation. It could've gone either way. But I took my time, picked my moment, then went in for the kill. It was beautiful to behold.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Brother, I think we've been going about this the wrong way. We're not commandos, we're negotiators. We make deals. That's what we're good at. The Dominion has something we want, so we need to find something they want.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: And then we make a trade. That way, everyone goes home happy.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Happy and alive. Now, what do we have to trade?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Captain, I can't thank you enough for all your help.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Don't thank me, thank Major Kira. She's the one that convinced me to talk to Starfleet on your behalf.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Consider it payback, Quark, for rescuing me from the Dominion.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Breaking you out of the station's holding cell is one thing. What you're planning to do is considerably more dangerous.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Every negotiation has its share of danger, Captain.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: If you say so.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I guess it's time for me to pick up my prisoner.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Just be careful you don't turn your back on him, Quark. He's not to be trusted.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Neither am I.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Excuse me.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Sorry.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: This isn't a ship, it's a closet.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You don't like it here, leave.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I'll go. That way there'll be more room for the rest of you. Besides, this isn't a rescue mission anymore, it's a simple prisoner exchange. I don't know why Quark needs any of us.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Because he doesn't trust the Dominion. And neither do I.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Why would the Dominion pick a deserted Cardassian space station to make the trade?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: They didn't pick it, Quark did. I've been there. It's the same design as Deep Space Nine, so we know the layout.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Well, you have nothing to worry about. You'll have plenty of places to run and hide.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Everyone, this is Keevan. We're going to trade him for Ishka.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Hi. I'm Rom. This is Nog, that's Brunt.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Rom, he doesn't care.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Truer words have never been spoken. I'll advise you all to send final messages to your loved ones and make sure your wills are in order.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Why?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Because the moment we leave this station, you'll have signed your death warrants. Now, if you don't mind, I'm going to take a nap.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: All clear!

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Are you sure?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Tricorder indicates no other lifeforms on the station.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: All right, let's head for base camp.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Base camp?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: He means the Infirmary. It's right over there.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Come on, let's move it. On the double. Well, what are you waiting for?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Two slips of latinum for the first man who makes it to the Infirmary. I mean base camp.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You don't pay your soldiers to do their duty.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You do if they're Ferengi.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Great, another closet.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: We've chosen this spot for a reason. For one thing, it's a confined area with only two ways in or out. This one, and the one in there. Secondly, it's near the airlock which gives us access to our ship. And third, it's on the Promenade where the prisoner exchange will take place. Don't touch that.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Some of this medical equipment is still functioning.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Anything for an upset stomach?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: What you need is a new backbone.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Hey, I'm a weapons dealer, not a soldier.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Cousin!

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Sir, may I suggest we set up our defense perimeter?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Good idea. How much is this going to cost me?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Don't worry, no charge.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Starfleet has really corrupted you, hasn't it? You could start by getting the external sensors back online. I want to know the minute a Dominion ship gets within ten million kilometers of this station.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I'll set up a transport jamming signal. That way, the Dominion won't be able to beam our prisoner away without our say so.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: We certainly wouldn't want that to happen, would we?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You don't seem to be too happy at the prospect of being rejoining your people.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Believe me when I tell you I have nothing to be happy about. Vorta are supposed to commit suicide when they're captured. I failed to follow that rather harsh policy.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: They're going to execute you?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: After what is surely going to be a most unpleasant debriefing.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I'm sorry to hear about that, but it's not my problem. All I want is my Moogie back.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: By the time the Dominion is done with you, all you'll want is a quick death.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Take him in the next room and see that he stays there.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: We'll post a guard on him at all times. Four hour shifts.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You heard him, move. Perhaps you can help me clarify something. What's the most vulnerable part of a Jem'Hadar's body?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: All right, you have your orders. Let's get to work.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: My son the soldier.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: They've ruined him.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: What was that?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Who's screaming?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: It's Gaila!

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: The Vorta, where is he?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I don't know.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: What do you mean, you don't know?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You were guarding him.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: He must've slipped away while I was sleeping.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Sleeping? Who said you could sleep?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I couldn't help it. I was tired. I couldn't get any rest on the ship.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: The ship!

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: If Keevan gets away, we're finished.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Going someplace?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Apparently not. I couldn't get the impulse engines online.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: That's because I had Rom disengage the induction matrix.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Then why did you bother chasing me?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Because sometimes my brother gets things wrong.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: All right, everyone relax. No harm done. We still have our prisoner.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: What's that?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: It's the alarm I set up. It means a Dominion ship is approaching.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: To the Infirmary!

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Let's go!

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Now what?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Someone turned the alarm off.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Maybe it went off by itself.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Do you hear something?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Someone's out there.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: One of us should go check to make sure. I nominate Quark.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Me?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I'll go.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Firing line, take aim.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Anybody there?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You could say that.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I wonder what they're doing out there.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Shh.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I don't hear anything.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Quiet.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Why are we hiding?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: There are Jem'Hadar out there.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Of course they're out there. We asked them to come.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: He's right. Everything's going according to plan. Now all you have to do, Quark, is negotiate the prisoner exchange. Remember, be firm, strong.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: But don't get them angry.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Good luck, brother. Say, hi to Moogie for me.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: What if it's a trap?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Of course it's a trap. They're not here to negotiate. They're here to kill us all.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You think?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Don't listen to him. He's just trying to save his own neck.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I'm trying to save all our necks.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Ferengi. Show yourself. We're here to trade.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Don't go out there. We must get back to the ship. Our only hope is to escape.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: We're not going anywhere, not without Moogie. Right, uncle?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Right.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Ferengi, I don't like to be kept waiting.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I'm coming. I'm coming! And you two are coming with me.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I was afraid he was going to say that.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Rom.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Moogie!

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: My boys. I knew you'd come.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You look beautiful.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: My lobes haven't been this firm in over a century.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I guess that makes this all worthwhile.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Don't you start with me, Quark.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: What a touching and heartfelt reunion. I'm glad I was here to witness it. Now, where's Keevan? I wish to conclude this transaction.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: All in good time. But first, I need some assurances.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: What kind of assurances?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Well, for one thing, I don't want any Jem'Hadar soldiers on this station.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: That would leave me in a very vulnerable position. One Vorta against six Ferengi.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: If it makes you feel better, these two can stay.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I feel safer already. Now where's Keevan?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Hold on, I'm not done yet. Then you're going to tell your helmsman to head back to Dominion territory, warp nine.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: That would leave me stranded here.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: For a few days.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I see. And by the time they return, you'll be long gone.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: That's the idea.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: On the other hand, I could have my Jem'Hadar storm the Infirmary and kill you all.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I like our plan better.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You attack the Infirmary and Keevan will be the first to die.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Keevan's fate has already been sealed.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Maybe. But before he dies, I'll bet you'll want to know what Dominion secrets he's revealed to the Federation.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: He's got you there, Yelgrun.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Your people have a reputation for cunning. I see that it's well earned. Perhaps one day the Ferengi will take their place as valued members of the Dominion.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Anything's possible.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I will begin to evacuate the Jem'Hadar at once.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: We can exchange the prisoners in let's say, half an hour?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: We'll be waiting.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: One more thing. How do we know that's really Moogie and not a changeling?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I think that uniform is too tight on you, Nog. It's cutting off circulation to your brain.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Sounds like Moogie.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Only one way to find out.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Wait. This should be interesting.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Oww!

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Yeah, that's blood all right.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I knew it was Moogie.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Now let's see if you're a changeling.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Oww!

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: That's no way to tell if he's a changeling.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You're right. Give me that knife.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I don't think so. Family. You understand.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Not really. I was cloned.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: No parents? That explains a lot.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: No parents, no sweetheart, no investment portfolio.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: And no patience. We'll meet back here in one half hour. Don't be late.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You heard him, Quark. Rom, I'm counting on you. Remember, Moogie loves you.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You should've seen my brother. He was brilliant!

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: In a half hour we'll have Moogie back and we can all go home.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Home to the torrential rains of Ferenginar.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You know what I miss most? The rotting vegetation.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Yep.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: And the dampness.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Oh, to stand once more in those rivers of muck.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I only wish I could be there with you.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I can't believe it. We're actually going to get the reward money. Fifty bars of gold pressed latinum.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Fifty bars? You said the reward was twenty.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: That's what Rom said, twenty.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: He said fifty.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I thought you said you didn't care about latinum?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I don't. I just don't to be cheated.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Everyone calm down.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Calm down? When my dear cousin is trying to cheat me?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I'm not trying to cheat anyone.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Then what about the other thirty bars?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: There are no other thirty bars. Are there?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I, I, no, not really.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: He's lying. They're in it together.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You're not going to get away with this, Quark.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I come here, risk my life and for what? You've had this coming for a long time, cousin.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: No!

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Look out!

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I hate Ferengi.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You idiot.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: What are we going to do? We can't have a prisoner exchange without a prisoner.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: If they find out Keevan's dead they're going to kill us.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Will you stop saying that.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Maybe if we surrender, they won't hurt us.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I have a better idea. Let's sneak back to my ship and try to escape.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: It's a big station, easy to get lost in. If we hide, maybe they won't find us.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: No one's hiding and no one's escaping, and no one's surrendering. What's wrong with you people? Have you forgotten the Battle of Prexnak?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Who could forget the most important battle in Ferengi history?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Ten Ferengi stood alone against two hundred and seventy three Lytasians.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: As I recall, all ten Ferengi were slaughtered.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: The point is, we Ferengi are just as tough as anybody in the galaxy. And this is our chance to prove it once and for all.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Quark's right. Let's do it for Ishka. Let's do it for the Grand Nagus. Let's do it for Ferengis everywhere.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Let's do it for equal shares of fifty bars of gold pressed latinum.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: It always comes down to profit with you people, doesn't it.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: We're Ferengi.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: And that's why I love you. Fifty bars it is, minus my usual finder's fee.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Well, there's no doubt about it. According to these readings, this man is dead.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Thank you, Doctor Nog.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I just wanted to be sure. I thought maybe we could revive him but I guess not.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: He's alive!

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: No, he isn't. It's just the neural stimulator. It caused a reflexive impulse in his cerebellum.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I never knew you studied medicine at the Academy.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I didn't, but if you think about it, medicine isn't that different from engineering. It's all about keeping things running, fixing broken parts.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Are you thinking what I'm thinking?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Find me more neural stimulators.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: It's time, Ferengi. Bring out your prisoner.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Stall them, Uncle.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I'll try.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I've done as you asked. The Jem'Hadar are on their way back to Dominion territory. We are alone on the station.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Wonderful.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Now bring out Keevan and we can conclude our business.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Keevan. Right. Absolutely.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I'm waiting.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: He'll be right out. But first my brother has to run some sensor scans to make sure the Jem'Hadar have really left.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: That is unnecessary. The Jem'Hadar are gone. Now bring me Keevan.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I will, in a few minutes.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: No, not in a few minutes, now! Or maybe you've changed your mind and you don't want your mother back. Kill her.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: No!

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Give them what they want, Quark.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I intend to.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Excellent.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: As soon as my brother completes his sensor scans.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: And I thought the Breen were annoying. Very well, five minutes. But I will not tolerate any more delays.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Neither will I.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: That goes for me, too. You see, we're all in agreement. One more thing.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Why am I not surprised?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: The prisoner exchange. I'd like for it to take place outside airlock three.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: What's wrong with the Promenade?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Nothing, except my ship is docked at airlock three. You understand.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Only too well. But I must say your lack of trust saddens me.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Ah, well, a sign of the times.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Nog, you've got five minutes.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: All right, here we go.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Seventy five hundred lots of hipicate futures?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: The hipicate root is very versatile. It's used in certain medicines, defractive optics, and even some beauty supplies. Here, feel how smooth my head is. Cream of hipicate. I apply it twice a day. You see, a diversified financial portfolio can mean greater profits and healthier looking skin.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Fascinating. I'd love to hear more, but if your son doesn't show up soon I'm afraid I'm going to have to kill you.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Yelgrun, you ready?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I've been ready for hours.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: On a count of three, we release our prisoners. Agreed?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Agreed.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: One, two three.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: What have they done to him?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Straighten him out, straighten him out.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I'm trying.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Stop them! A bulkhead opens and Leck downs a Jem'Hadar with a thrown knife. Yelgrun drops to his knees, Rom shoots the other Jem'Hadar and Keevan keeps bumping.)

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Would you please turn him off?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I can't. The transceiver is jammed.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Oh Quark, the Grand Nagus is going to be so proud of you. I know I am.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Moogie.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: What do we do with this one?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: We'll take him with us. He'll be our gift to Starfleet. They gave us a Vorta, we'll give them one.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: Ferengi.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: I know, I know. You hate us.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: All right you, get moving.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: This is the sloppiest, most amateurish operation I've ever seen. If you ever do something like this again, count me in.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You'll be the first one I call. If I even think about doing something like this again, shoot me.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: So, Brother, how does it feel to be a hero?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You tell me.

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: It feels good?

title: The Magnificent Ferengi
line: You bet it does.

title: Waltz
line: I heard you were aboard. I was wondering if you'd make an appearance.

title: Waltz
line: How are you?

title: Waltz
line: Better. The doctors tell me I've made a remarkable recovery.

title: Waltz
line: They told me the same thing.

title: Waltz
line: Good. I'd hate to think they were patronizing me. So I'm a war criminal.

title: Waltz
line: In the Federation, you're innocent till proven guilty.

title: Waltz
line: So I'm told. Do you believe I'm guilty, Benjamin?

title: Waltz
line: I haven't seen all the charges.

title: Waltz
line: It's not like you to equivocate.

title: Waltz
line: I'm trying to be fair. You won't be tried until the war is over. Your appearance before the special jury is just a formality.

title: Waltz
line: And you'll be testifying for the prosecution.

title: Waltz
line: I will tell them what I know.

title: Waltz
line: Care to elaborate?

title: Waltz
line: Not really.

title: Waltz
line: I see.

title: Waltz
line: I never got a chance to tell you how sorry I am about Ziyal.

title: Waltz
line: Do I detect the fine hand of Doctor Cox at work once again?

title: Waltz
line: I told him I wanted to offer my condolences.

title: Waltz
line: I'm sorry. The good doctor encourages me to talk about Ziyal whenever possible, since it was her death that brought on my momentary instability. I shouldn't be so suspicious.

title: Waltz
line: It's all right. Well, we should be arriving at Starbase six two one by noon tomorrow. I'll see you at the arraignment.

title: Waltz
line: Benjamin. About my daughter. You and Major Kira took care of her for almost a year. I wanted to thank you for that. It was very generous.

title: Waltz
line: Ziyal was a very special young woman. It was a pleasure to have her with us, even if it was only a short time.

title: Waltz
line: A short time is all she ever had.

title: Waltz
line: Is there anything I can get for you?

title: Waltz
line: A bottle of kanar and an Orion slave girl would be nice.

title: Waltz
line: I'll see what I can do.

title: Waltz
line: Battle stations! Damage control teams report to level five J.

title: Waltz
line: It's confirmed. USS Honshu was destroyed this morning at ten thirty hours by an attack wing of Cardassian destroyers. Starfleet has picked up the distress beacons from three escape pods and one shuttlecraft, so there are survivors.

title: Waltz
line: The signals are coming from this area. The last reported position of the Honshu was here, which means there could be survivors in any of these adjacent star systems.

title: Waltz
line: That's a pretty large area. How many ships are in the search party?

title: Waltz
line: Two. The Constellation and the Defiant.

title: Waltz
line: Two? It could take days.

title: Waltz
line: With all the Dominion activity along the border, it's all Starfleet can spare at the moment. And the Defiant has another appointment. In fifty two hours you need to be at this rendezvous point outside the Badlands. You are the escort for a Federation troop convoy.

title: Waltz
line: It will take twelve hours just to arrive at the coordinates where the Honshu was destroyed.

title: Waltz
line: And twelve more to reach the Badlands, I know. But this convoy is completely unprotected. They've been using the plasma fields in the Badlands to hide their movements, and when they emerge they're helpless without the Defiant.

title: Waltz
line: Can't they delay the convoy? I mean, if Captain Sisko is still alive, we have to give him every chance to

title: Waltz
line: I raised the same objection myself and the orders still stand. Now, every minute spent arguing here is one less minute spent searching for the captain.

title: Waltz
line: Prepare for immediate departure.

title: Waltz
line: Worf, there are over thirty thousand Federation troops in that convoy. You have fifty two hours, not one second longer. Understood?

title: Waltz
line: Understood. Defiant.

title: Waltz
line: Benjamin, can you hear me?

title: Waltz
line: Dukat?

title: Waltz
line: Yes. Everything's all right, but don't try to move too quickly. The left side of your body is covered with plasma burns.

title: Waltz
line: We were in the brig and the ship went to Red Alert.

title: Waltz
line: We were attacked by a wing of Cardassian ships, ironically.

title: Waltz
line: I was heading to Engineering.

title: Waltz
line: You didn't get very far. A plasma conduit exploded before you got fifteen meters down the corridor. That's where Lieutenant McConnell and I found you when the order came to abandon ship.

title: Waltz
line: Where's McConnell?

title: Waltz
line: Dead. A piece of shrapnel hit him in the head just as we were carrying you into the shuttle.

title: Waltz
line: Any other survivors?

title: Waltz
line: I saw a few escape pods leaving the ship just before it exploded, but I had my hands full just trying to keep us in one piece. The engines were damaged from the shockwaves and I set us down here, wherever here is. But that shuttle's never going to reach orbit again. The shuttle's distress beacon was damaged, but I think I managed to repair it.

title: Waltz
line: So now we have to do is wait for someone to pick up our signal.

title: Waltz
line: Whose signal are you transmitting? Starfleet or the Dominion?

title: Waltz
line: It's a general distress call, Benjamin. Whoever gets here first will find one comrade in arms and one prisoner. That's fair, isn't it?

title: Waltz
line: Fair enough. Did you do this?

title: Waltz
line: You shattered most of the bones in your arm. There was a bone regenerator in the medkit, but I'm afraid I'm not much of a doctor, so I just put on the cast.

title: Waltz
line: You did plenty. Thank you.

title: Waltz
line: We have enough field rations to last us a few weeks, but I'd feel better if I could locate another source of food and water. The surface is inhospitable to say the least, but I did manage to find some firewood and kindling, so there's a good chance there's edible vegetation out there. I just have to find it.

title: Waltz
line: You could have left me behind. Why didn't you?

title: Waltz
line: I didn't want to. I'll be back within the hour.

title: Waltz
line: What are you planning to do with him?

title: Waltz
line: The Captain and I have a lot to talk about.

title: Waltz
line: Such as?

title: Waltz
line: It's of a personal nature.

title: Waltz
line: I see. You're going to share your feelings of loneliness and sorrow with your longtime adversary. Doctor Cox'd be so proud.

title: Waltz
line: Go away.

title: Waltz
line: You should kill him now, while you still can.

title: Waltz
line: That won't be necessary. He's in no condition to challenge me. I can afford to be patient.

title: Waltz
line: You should kill him.

title: Waltz
line: I don't care for your tone.

title: Waltz
line: Spare me your endless posturing. You're lucky I speak to you at all after that pathetic display back at the hospital.

title: Waltz
line: That's enough.

title: Waltz
line: Oh, I see. It's a sensitive topic. I wonder what Captain Sisko would think if he'd seen you curled up in a ball, crying yourself to sleep every night?

title: Waltz
line: Stop it!

title: Waltz
line: I doubt held still have the same respect for you if he'd heard you screaming and screaming and screaming like a madman till the nurses came and the doctors had to sedate you!

title: Waltz
line: No!

title: Waltz
line: Is that breakfast?

title: Waltz
line: Possibly. Good morning.

title: Waltz
line: Morning. What's it like outside?

title: Waltz
line: The wind has died down and the temperature's gone up twenty degrees. I rather like it, but I think you'll be more comfortable in here where it's cooler.

title: Waltz
line: Too much.

title: Waltz
line: I'm doing the cooking here, thank you.

title: Waltz
line: Pardon me.

title: Waltz
line: You're not the only officer who learned how to cook. How are you feeling?

title: Waltz
line: A little better.

title: Waltz
line: Good. After last night, I was beginning to get worried.

title: Waltz
line: Last night?

title: Waltz
line: You don't remember?

title: Waltz
line: Now that you mention it I remember waking up and I was feeling a little dizzy.

title: Waltz
line: You had a bout of nausea. Not exactly a little bout.

title: Waltz
line: Oh, I'm sorry.

title: Waltz
line: That's all right. I've had to clean up a lot worse in my time. Once, when I was a newly minted glinn on the Kornaire, I had to help clean up a compartment where three men had gone through an explosive decompression. I didn't sleep for a week after that.

title: Waltz
line: Let's change the subject.

title: Waltz
line: The Emissary has spoken. Oh, come on, Benjamin. Have a sense of humor about all this.

title: Waltz
line: I'm not in much of a joking mood.

title: Waltz
line: Well that's a shame, because there's so much to laugh about. You don't see it, do you? Benjamin, just a few hours ago I was a prisoner on my way to trial and you were my old friend come to visit me in my cell. Now look at us. I'm free and you're a prisoner of your own battered body, and there's a good chance we'll be rescued by the Dominion. You've got to laugh at a universe that allows such radical shifts in fortune, Benjamin.

title: Waltz
line: I will laugh when a Federation starship arrives and puts you back in a cell.

title: Waltz
line: Whatever you say.

title: Waltz
line: What?

title: Waltz
line: Nothing. it's probably just the wind.

title: Waltz
line: How is it?

title: Waltz
line: Needs salt. There's probably some in one of the ration packs.

title: Waltz
line: You know, we didn't get much of a chance to catch up before the attack. How is everyone on what I'm sure you're once again calling Deep Space Nine? Odo, Kira, Quark?

title: Waltz
line: They're all fine. And no, they don't miss you.

title: Waltz
line: Perhaps not. They never really did give me much of a chance. They were too busy plotting my downfall.

title: Waltz
line: Pepper. If you only want me to tell you what you want to hear, just say so.

title: Waltz
line: Well I hope they at least told you that my policies toward the Bajorans were most generous this time.

title: Waltz
line: They told me Weyoun didn't give you much of a choice.

title: Waltz
line: Major Kira knows full well I made every effort to heal the wounds between Cardassia and Bajor. Since the very beginning it was my intention to rectify the mistakes of the past and begin a new chapter in our relations.

title: Waltz
line: Are you going to put that in my soup?

title: Waltz
line: Well?

title: Waltz
line: Better.

title: Waltz
line: You're not going to give me the benefit of the doubt, are you, Benjamin?

title: Waltz
line: Do you really care what I think?

title: Waltz
line: Don't you care what your old friends think of you?

title: Waltz
line: Dukat, we're not old friends. You saved my life and I'm grateful, but that's as far as it goes.

title: Waltz
line: You keep hearing something. Are you sure there's nothing out there?

title: Waltz
line: It's just the wind, I'm certain, but I'm going to double check just to make sure.

title: Waltz
line: No. I won't do it. Not yet.

title: Waltz
line: You're wasting time.

title: Waltz
line: It's my time to waste, Damar. Remember your place.

title: Waltz
line: I mean no disrespect, you know that. But without you the war will be lost and Cardassia will lie in ruins. Don't let this one man stand in the way of your final triumph.

title: Waltz
line: I have to know that he respects me. I think I've earned it.

title: Waltz
line: Of course you have. He's just trying to deny you the satisfaction of hearing him say it. You know in your heart he secretly admires you. Isn't that enough? Kill him and be done with it.

title: Waltz
line: Think of it. The leader of Cardassia bringing the dead body of the Emissary back to the Bajoran people. They'll take it as a sign that the Prophets have abandoned them. The Shakaar government will be overthrown and the Federation position on Terok Nor will become untenable.

title: Waltz
line: Very tempting thought.

title: Waltz
line: You've make some good points, Damar, but there will be time for all of that later. It's all right. I know you have my best interests at heart.

title: Waltz
line: I wanted to get some water out of the kit.

title: Waltz
line: Ah. Here.

title: Waltz
line: Thanks. Anything out there?

title: Waltz
line: Hmm? No, no. Some rocks slid down the cliff.

title: Waltz
line: I think something's wrong with the comm. system.

title: Waltz
line: Oh?

title: Waltz
line: It was beeping a second ago. It might need recalibrating.

title: Waltz
line: I'll check. Everything's fine. The unit's still online.

title: Waltz
line: If you open up the casing, you'll be able to run a full diagnostic. Better safe than sorry.

title: Waltz
line: You're right.

title: Waltz
line: Nothing to worry about. It's working fine.

title: Waltz
line: That's all I wanted to know. Ship's log, supplemental. We have picked up a total of twelve Honshu survivors so far, but there is still no sign of Captain Sisko. We have less than twelve hours before we must abandon the search.

title: Waltz
line: Damn.

title: Waltz
line: Commander, I'm picking up a distress signal.

title: Waltz
line: Good evening. Pleasant dreams, I hope.

title: Waltz
line: I don't remember. Is it still dark out?

title: Waltz
line: I do apologize for bringing you to such a gloomy latitude. The nights seem to last eighteen hours, the days less than five. Sit up.

title: Waltz
line: Looks like you're planning on a long stay.

title: Waltz
line: No, not at all. Someone's bound to pick up our signal any time now. But I see no reason why we shouldn't be comfortable in the meantime. How's that?

title: Waltz
line: Just fine, thank you.

title: Waltz
line: Good. Ah, much better. You know, when I was out there in the shuttle just now, it occurred to me that the Bajorans would be very confused if they could see us here, sharing the same food, the same hardships. What do you think they would say if they knew the Emissary of the Prophets and the evil Gul Dukat were sitting here together, getting along like the two old friends that they really are? Oh, I forgot. You don't think of me as your old friend, do you, Benjamin. It's all right. There's no one here. Just the two of us. No one to impress, no one to judge what you say. We can be honest with one another. So tell me. What you really think of me?

title: Waltz
line: I'll tell you what I think. You're an evil, sadistic man who should've been tried as a war criminal years ago, put up against a wall and shot.

title: Waltz
line: You probably agree with Major Kira, don't you, Benjamin? I am the former Prefect of Bajor. An evil man who sent thousands of Bajorans to their deaths to satisfy his own sadistic desires.

title: Waltz
line: Of course he agrees with me. And it was millions.

title: Waltz
line: I don't think there's any point in discussing this.

title: Waltz
line: I do. My name and reputation have been slandered and twisted ever since the end of the occupation of Bajor. I have been vilified by ignorant, small minded people throughout the quadrant for the past six years. I just want to know if you're one of them, Benjamin.

title: Waltz
line: I wasn't there during the occupation. I didn't see all the things you had to struggle with day after day. I don't think I can pass judgment.

title: Waltz
line: He's just doesn't want to anger you. He really thinks you're a vicious, cold blooded killer, Dukat, and so do I.

title: Waltz
line: I don't care what you think so I suggest you keep your opinions to yourself. I don't think you're being entirely honest with me, Benjamin. You're not a man who hesitates to make snap judgments when the situation calls for it. It's one of the signs of a good commander. Now I'm asking for your opinion of me and I find it hard to believe you don't have one.

title: Waltz
line: All right. I think you're right. You have been judged unfairly. I've judged you unfairly. But I think you probably had good reasons for everything you did on Bajor.

title: Waltz
line: Yes. Yes, that's it exactly. I had good reasons. Some of the harsher actions I took were forced on me by Central Command. I wanted to use entirely different tactics with the Bajorans. I wanted to rule with a softer hand, but my superiors didn't see it that way.

title: Waltz
line: You were a soldier and you had to carry out your orders.

title: Waltz
line: Precisely.

title: Waltz
line: You are such a fool.

title: Waltz
line: Leave us alone! This doesn't concern you!

title: Waltz
line: He's patronizing you. You were a soldier and you had to carry out your orders. He doesn't believe that lame excuse any more than I do.

title: Waltz
line: This is growing tiresome.

title: Waltz
line: Dukat. Dukat! I thought you wanted to talk to me.

title: Waltz
line: Yes, but Nerys won't leave well enough alone. She's always interfering, always trying to upset me.

title: Waltz
line: Maybe we should just ignore her. Let's pretend that the Major's not even here.

title: Waltz
line: I'm picking up two humanoid lifeforms on the surface.

title: Waltz
line: Bridge to transporter room.

title: Waltz
line: There's no reason to get upset. We're just talking. Two old soldiers talking around a campfire.

title: Waltz
line: I'm going to enjoy watching this. He's going to beat you, Dukat. He's going to escape and go back to DS Nine and his friends and we're all going to have a good, long laugh at your expense.

title: Waltz
line: Enough!

title: Waltz
line: I've locked onto them.

title: Waltz
line: Transporter room to bridge. We have the survivors on board. Two women.

title: Waltz
line: An Ensign and a Lieutenant. Doctor Bashir is checking them now.

title: Waltz
line: That must have been very uncomfortable, Benjamin. Look at that. One of the tines is missing. Now did that happened? Did you break it off? But why would you want a small thin piece of metal? Unless you needed a tool.

title: Waltz
line: I see you've been busy. A little repair work while I was gone. Very thoughtful.

title: Waltz
line: Worf.

title: Waltz
line: What is it?

title: Waltz
line: I thought I picked up another distress signal but now it's gone.

title: Waltz
line: You know, Benjamin, I thought we had established a level of trust between us, but I was wrong. If there's one thing I can't abide, it's betrayal.

title: Waltz
line: Our rescue effort has been delayed. If we could just have a few more hours?

title: Waltz
line: The troop convoy will be completely unprotected when they emerge from the plasma fields. They're under strict radio silence. No way they can acknowledge our signal even if. Sorry, Worf, but you're going to have to

title: Waltz
line: I'm sorry, Captain. There's some kind of subspace interference between us and the station. I'll keep trying.

title: Waltz
line: I couldn't understand a word Kira said. Too much interference. Looks to me like we're on our own.

title: Waltz
line: I could understood what she was trying to say.

title: Waltz
line: What about you, Chief? Did you understand?

title: Waltz
line: No, I couldn't understand a word.

title: Waltz
line: Well it doesn't really matter what we think. Commander Worf is captain here.

title: Waltz
line: We all know what Major Kira's orders were. It would be dishonorable to ignore them.

title: Waltz
line: You will forgive me if I don't consider your honor to be worth Captain Sisko's life.

title: Waltz
line: You may leave the bridge, Doctor.

title: Waltz
line: Helm, lay in a course for the third planet.

title: Waltz
line: Aye, Captain.

title: Waltz
line: You brought it on yourself, you know.

title: Waltz
line: Just like all your victims.

title: Waltz
line: All my victims. It always comes back to that, doesn't it? All my crimes. I'm such a monster, such an evil man. Behold Benjamin Sisko, supreme arbiter of right and wrong in the universe. A man of such high moral caliber that he can sit in judgment on all the rest of us.

title: Waltz
line: What the hell do you want from me? My approval? Is that what this is all about? You want me to give you my permission to cause more suffering and death? Well, if that's what you're after, you might as well pull out that phaser and end this right now because I will never give it to you!

title: Waltz
line: Good! Good, I like this. No more pretense, no games. Just you, me and the truth.

title: Waltz
line: What do you know about the truth? You bend the truth into whatever shape suits you.

title: Waltz
line: Judge Sisko hands down another ruling. But where's his evidence?

title: Waltz
line: All right. You really want to do this? Here? Now?

title: Waltz
line: Yes.

title: Waltz
line: Okay. Okay, let's do it. You were Prefect of Bajor during the occupation. True or false?

title: Waltz
line: True.

title: Waltz
line: And you were responsible for everything that happened under your command. True or false?

title: Waltz
line: True.

title: Waltz
line: So that means that you are responsible for the murder of over five million Bajorans on your watch. True or false!

title: Waltz
line: False. I tried to save lives during my administration.

title: Waltz
line: Evidence?

title: Waltz
line: Evidence? He wants evidence. By the time I became Prefect, the occupation had been going on for almost forty years, but the planet still wasn't ready for full scale colonization. Central Command wanted the situation resolved and they didn't care how it was done. I was convinced that a gentler hand was required to deal with the Bajorans.

title: Waltz
line: It was a noble, if misguided, vision.

title: Waltz
line: So in my first official act as Prefect, I ordered all labor camp commanders to reduce their output quotas by fifty percent fifty percent. Then I reorganized the camps themselves. Child labor was abolished. Medical care was improved. Food rations were increased. At the end of one month of my administration, the death rate had dropped by twenty percent. Now how did the Bajorans react to all this? On my one month anniversary they blew up an orbital dry-dock, killing over two hundred Cardassian soldiers and workers.

title: Waltz
line: We didn't want a reconciliation. We wanted to destroy you.

title: Waltz
line: So I had to order a response. But even then it was a carefully tempered one. I ordered two hundred suspected members of the Resistance rounded up and executed. Two hundred lives for two hundred lives. That's justice, not malevolence. Justice.

title: Waltz
line: The Dominion would never have been so generous.

title: Waltz
line: But did I give up my efforts to reach out to the Bajorans? No. I tried again. And what did I get for my troubles? An assassination attempt on my own space station! Another round of executions followed once again, courtesy of the Bajoran resistance.

title: Waltz
line: We never wanted peace. We hated you. We hated all of you.

title: Waltz
line: On and on it went, year after blood-soaked year. Time and again I would reach out with the open hand of friendship, and time and again they would slap it away.

title: Waltz
line: The Bajorans understand a clenched fist, not an open hand.

title: Waltz
line: Being reasonable only made us bolder.

title: Waltz
line: The Dominion would have killed every man, woman and child on Bajor long ago.

title: Waltz
line: I hope you're listening to all this.

title: Waltz
line: Oh believe me, you have my undivided attention. Now let me get this straight. You're not responsible for what happened during the occupation, the Bajorans are.

title: Waltz
line: Yes, yes, exactly.

title: Waltz
line: So, why do you think they didn't appreciate this rare opportunity you were offering them?

title: Waltz
line: Because they were blind, ignorant fools. If only they had cooperated with us, we could have turned their world into a paradise. From the moment we arrived on Bajor, it was clear that we were the superior race. But they couldn't accept that. They wanted to be treated as equals when they most certainly were not. Militarily, technologically, culturally, we were almost a century ahead of them in every way. We did not choose to be the superior race. Fate handed us our role. And it would've been so much easier on everyone if the Bajorans had simply accepted their role. But no, day after day they clustered in their temples and prayed for deliverance, and night after night they planted bombs outside of our homes. Pride. Stubborn, unyielding pride. From the servant girl that cleaned my quarters to the condemned man toiling in a labor camp to the terrorist skulking through the hills of Dahkur Province. They all wore their pride like some twisted badge of honor.

title: Waltz
line: And you hated them for it.

title: Waltz
line: Of course I hated them! I hated everything about them! Their superstitions and their cries for sympathy, their treachery and their lies, their smug superiority and their stiff necked obstinacy, their earrings and their broken wrinkled noses.

title: Waltz
line: You should have killed them all.

title: Waltz
line: Yes! Yes! That's right, isn't it? I knew it! I've always known it! I should have killed every last one of them. I should have turned their planet into a graveyard the likes of which the galaxy had never seen! I should have killed them all.

title: Waltz
line: And that is why you're not an evil man.

title: Waltz
line: Do it!

title: Waltz
line: I'm so glad we had this time together, Benjamin, because we won't be seeing each other for a while. I have unfinished business on Bajor. They thought I was their enemy? They don't know what it is to be my enemy, but they will. From this day forward, Bajor is dead. All of Bajor. And this time, even their Emissary won't be able to save them.

title: Waltz
line: It's time.

title: Waltz
line: Plot a course out of the system, full impulse. Once we've cleared the outer planets, head for the rendezvous coordinates, maximum warp.

title: Waltz
line: Course laid in. Engaging impulse engines.

title: Waltz
line: Captain. I'm picking up a signal. It's from Gul Dukat. Ship's log, stardate 51413.6. We have rescued Captain Sisko, but we did not have time to locate Gul Dukat's shuttle. We are now en route to our rendezvous with the troop convoy near the Badlands, and the Captain is recovering in sickbay.

title: Waltz
line: Benjamin? I've notified Starfleet of Dukat's last known position. They'll find him.

title: Waltz
line: No, they won't. You know, old man, sometimes life seems so complicated. Nothing is truly good or truly evil. Everything seems to be a shade of gray. And then you spend some time with a man like Dukat and you realize that there is really such a thing as truly evil.

title: Waltz
line: To realize that is one thing. To do something about it is another. So what are you going to do?

title: Waltz
line: I'll tell you what I'm not going to do. I'm not going to let him destroy Bajor. I fear no evil. From now on, it's him or me.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Morn, if you're not too busy, I'd appreciate it if you did something about that shipment of Livanian beets you have sitting in Cargo Bay Three. It's been there for over two weeks. It's starting to rot.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Morn.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: It's a hologram. Morn's been away on business for the last two weeks. You're slipping, Odo. You should've caught on a lot sooner.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: You replaced Morn with a hologram? Why?

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Evening.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Hello, Morn.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: That's why. People love him. He's like a mascot. Everyone who comes in here expects to see him, and if they don't, it doesn't feel like home to them.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: And that's not good for business.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: The last time he went away, my sales dropped almost five percent.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Why doesn't it talk?

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Do you have any idea how much an interactive holoprojector costs? Besides, it's a relief not to have to listen to him go on. You know Morn. He never shuts up. I'd trade this for the real thing any day.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: I'm sure Morn would be very touched to hear you say that.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Morn!

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: It's just a hologram.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: You look like you saw a ghost.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Turn it off.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Why?

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: We just got word. Morn's cargo ship was caught in an ion storm.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Is he all right?

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Was he rescued?

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: He's dead.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Did you bring anything?

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Huh?

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: To the memorial service.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: I didn't know I was supposed to.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Well, it's Lurian custom to bring gifts of food and drink for the deceased so they have something to sustain them in the afterlife.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Oh. Maybe I can get something in Quark's. I hate to think of the big fellow going without.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Morn was an excellent sparring partner. I will miss our weekly combat in the holosuites.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: I can't believe he's really gone.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: I did not realize he was such a close friend.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Well, I used to have a little crush on him.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Morn?

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: It was before we met. Besides, he wasn't interested.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: What do you mean, he wasn't interested?

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Forget I mentioned it.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Is that a bottle opener?

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: For Morn. I thought it might come in handy.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Very thoughtful.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: This is unbelievable. Look at all these people. If you see anyone empty-handed sell them a bottle of Yridian ale. Tell them it was Morn's favorite.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Very kind of you to do this, Quark.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: I'm sure Morn would have appreciated it.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: It's the least I could do. I'll miss him. Sorry.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Can I get you anything?

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: I don't ordinarily imbibe on the job, but maybe a Yridian ale. It was Morn's favorite.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Oh. Perfect.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: What are you looking at?

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: Your respect for the dead is heart-warming.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
line: I'll have you know that Morn died without paying this month's tab.

title: Who Mourns For Morn?
