title: Chrysalis
line: Which two?

title: Chrysalis
line: Now that would be telling. I'm glad you liked my friends. I know they liked you.

title: Chrysalis
line: I felt so comfortable around them. I didn't have to worry that someone was going to throw a tantrum, or break into tears all of a sudden.

title: Chrysalis
line: They only usually do that at staff meetings.

title: Chrysalis
line: Jack's always talking about how we're better than normal people. He says that's why they keep us locked up. But he's wrong. He couldn't get by in the real world. He'd get himself into too much trouble. So would Lauren and Patrick.

title: Chrysalis
line: That's why they belong in the Institute. In fact, Doctor Loews wants me to get them back there as soon as possible.

title: Chrysalis
line: I'm not going with them, am I.

title: Chrysalis
line: You don't belong there. Not anymore.

title: Chrysalis
line: Do they know?

title: Chrysalis
line: Not yet.

title: Chrysalis
line: They've been like a family to me for as long as I can remember.

title: Chrysalis
line: I know how much you care about them.

title: Chrysalis
line: As difficult as they can be sometimes, I'm going to miss them. We had our own little world, just the four of us. So, what's a genetically enhanced girl supposed to do when she wakes up from a long sleep? Point to one of those little specks of light out there, pack her bag, and go make a life for herself?

title: Chrysalis
line: Why does she have to go anywhere at all?

title: Chrysalis
line: Sarina isn't going back to the Institute with you.

title: Chrysalis
line: She's not?

title: Chrysalis
line: No. She's staying here.

title: Chrysalis
line: Oh really? Huh. How nice for you.

title: Chrysalis
line: I've arranged for her to have her own quarters.

title: Chrysalis
line: We're never going to see her again.

title: Chrysalis
line: You have no right to do this. No right!

title: Chrysalis
line: Look, I know you're going to miss her, but it's the best thing for Sarina.

title: Chrysalis
line: We did not help you so you could take her away from us!

title: Chrysalis
line: Stop thinking about yourself for a second, Jack, and think about her. Face it. She doesn't belong with you anymore.

title: Chrysalis
line: Why? Because we're not normal? Because we're crazy?

title: Chrysalis
line: Oh, Jack.

title: Chrysalis
line: Couldn't you make us normal like you did for Sarina, and then we could all stay together.

title: Chrysalis
line: Go on, Julian. Tell him. There's nothing you can do for us. We're too far gone.

title: Chrysalis
line: Oh, who wants to be normal anyway? We're better than they are. You don't see any of them trying to save the universe from collapsing, do you? Let's get back to work.

title: Chrysalis
line: Well, they took it rather hard.

title: Chrysalis
line: I should go talk to them.

title: Chrysalis
line: In the morning. Give them a little time to get used to the idea. Come on, I've got just the thing to cheer you up.

title: Chrysalis
line: Dabo!

title: Chrysalis
line: She's unbelievable!

title: Chrysalis
line: Tell him how you do it. Go on.

title: Chrysalis
line: It has to do with a series of binomial equations and probability factors.

title: Chrysalis
line: Explain how you track the dependent variables.

title: Chrysalis
line: It's really not that interesting.

title: Chrysalis
line: Dabo!

title: Chrysalis
line: Well, hasn't this been fun. Why not take a seat and top off the evening with a lovely bottle of spring wine?

title: Chrysalis
line: Should we?

title: Chrysalis
line: He's just wants you to stop playing so he doesn't lose any more money.

title: Chrysalis
line: Did I mention that the wine was on the house?

title: Chrysalis
line: Julian, let's sit down.

title: Chrysalis
line: But she's winning.

title: Chrysalis
line: I've played enough.

title: Chrysalis
line: This way. This way. Excuse me please. Excuse me. Ezri, over here.

title: Chrysalis
line: Dabo!

title: Chrysalis
line: Sarina? This way.

title: Chrysalis
line: Julian, would you mind if we left?

title: Chrysalis
line: I'm sorry. I thought you were having a good time.

title: Chrysalis
line: Oh, I was. But there was so much commotion. Maybe I'm just tired.

title: Chrysalis
line: I'll tell you what. Tomorrow night why don't we have a nice quiet dinner in my quarters. I have a week's leave coming up. I thought we might go to Risa together, get away from all the distractions around here, spend a little time alone.

title: Chrysalis
line: All right.

title: Chrysalis
line: I'll let you get some rest then.

title: Chrysalis
line: She's wonderful, Miles. I've never met anyone like her. She's brilliant, sweet, everything's new to her. Being with her is so refreshing. She takes such delight in what she's experiencing. It makes me appreciate things I usually take for granted.

title: Chrysalis
line: Like hot coffee?

title: Chrysalis
line: Like coffee. Music. The way the stars shine.

title: Chrysalis
line: What is wrong with this thing?

title: Chrysalis
line: Are you listening to me?

title: Chrysalis
line: Yes. Yeah. Coffee, music, stars.

title: Chrysalis
line: Well, don't you have anything to say?

title: Chrysalis
line: As a matter of fact, I do, Julian. I haven't seen you like this for a long time, and I'm really happy for you. But don't you think it's all happening a little fast?

title: Chrysalis
line: We're genetically engineered. We do everything fast.

title: Chrysalis
line: Julian, she's your patient.

title: Chrysalis
line: Not anymore. I've asked Doctor Girani to take over her care. Miles, I don't think you understand what this means to me. All these years I've had to hide the fact that my DNA had been resequenced. I'd listen to people talk about the genetically engineered, saying they were all misfits. I used to fantasize about meeting someone who was like me, who could live a normal life. But it never happened. Until Sarina. Don't you see? She's the woman I've been waiting for all my life.

title: Chrysalis
line: Good luck.

title: Chrysalis
line: Computer, music. Something romantic.

title: Chrysalis
line: Computer, locate Sarina Douglas.

title: Chrysalis
line: Sarina Douglas is in her quarters on the Habitat ring corridor H six section twenty seven epsilon.

title: Chrysalis
line: Sarina, it's me. Computer, override door locks. Authorization Bashir delta five seven alpha.

title: Chrysalis
line: I've been waiting in my quarters for you. Sarina? Is something wrong? Sarina.

title: Chrysalis
line: Apparently the thalamic pathways I generated are still functioning, but Doctor Girani's not detected any neural activity in them.

title: Chrysalis
line: Do you have any idea what's wrong?

title: Chrysalis
line: Not a clue. It's as if she were just slipping away and there's nothing I can do but wait and hope she pulls out of it.

title: Chrysalis
line: You can go in now.

title: Chrysalis
line: Sarina? Don't be afraid. Everything's going to be all right. I'm not going to give up on you. Ever.

title: Chrysalis
line: I don't know what's wrong with her. I need your help.

title: Chrysalis
line: Why should we help you? You just want to steal her away from us.

title: Chrysalis
line: Look at her. Do you really want her to spend the rest of her life like this? I've been trying to find a way to reach her, but I can't. Maybe there isn't one. All I'm asking is that you try. The three of you know her better than anyone else. Please. I don't want to lose her.

title: Chrysalis
line: All right, Julian. Leave her here with us for a while. We'll see what we can do.

title: Chrysalis
line: Thank you.

title: Chrysalis
line: Are you sure?

title: Chrysalis
line: I'm sure.

title: Chrysalis
line: We have to tell him.

title: Chrysalis
line: Why? This way we can all stay together.

title: Chrysalis
line: Let's go.

title: Chrysalis
line: This way.

title: Chrysalis
line: That way.

title: Chrysalis
line: I think we passed it.

title: Chrysalis
line: Can I help you?

title: Chrysalis
line: That's a stupid question.

title: Chrysalis
line: Come in.

title: Chrysalis
line: We have to talk to you.

title: Chrysalis
line: About Sarina?

title: Chrysalis
line: Tell him.

title: Chrysalis
line: She can still talk, it's just that she's afraid to.

title: Chrysalis
line: I don't understand. What's she afraid of?

title: Chrysalis
line: We don't know.

title: Chrysalis
line: But we think it has something to do with you.

title: Chrysalis
line: I'm going to go talk to her. Stay here.

title: Chrysalis
line: Sarina, talk to me. Please. I know you can. What's wrong? Is it me? If it is, don't be afraid. I'm going to do whatever it takes to make it right because I love you. I want us to be together. Tell me, do you love me?

title: Chrysalis
line: I don't know. I don't even understand what love is. I don't understand anything.

title: Chrysalis
line: Sarina.

title: Chrysalis
line: What am I supposed to do? What am I supposed to feel? Tell me. I want to make you happy. I owe you everything.

title: Chrysalis
line: Shh. No, you don't owe me. You don't owe me anything.

title: Chrysalis
line: I'm sorry. I wish I could be the woman you want me to be.

title: Chrysalis
line: Shh.

title: Chrysalis
line: Morning. Is she gone?

title: Chrysalis
line: Her shuttle leaves in a few minutes.

title: Chrysalis
line: What about the others?

title: Chrysalis
line: They left for the Institute this morning.

title: Chrysalis
line: I understand you've arranged a position for Sarina at the Corgal Research Center.

title: Chrysalis
line: Yeah, an internship. She's going to work under one of the scientists there, live with his family.

title: Chrysalis
line: You okay?

title: Chrysalis
line: How could I have been so blind? What was I thinking trying to move things along so fast? She needed time. I didn't give it to her. I came this close to driving her back inside herself. I'm supposed to be a doctor. I'm supposed to put my patient's needs above my own.

title: Chrysalis
line: You didn't want to be lonely anymore. Nobody does. I have to go to work. Do you want to come over for dinner tonight? Keiko's making tempura.

title: Chrysalis
line: No thanks.

title: Chrysalis
line: So here you are, on your way to one of those tiny little specks of light out there.

title: Chrysalis
line: I guess that's what a genetically enhanced girl should do when she wakes up from her sleep. Go make a life for herself. I'm going to miss you.

title: Chrysalis
line: I'm going to miss you.

title: Chrysalis
line: You won't forget me?

title: Chrysalis
line: Forget you? Never.

title: Chrysalis
line: Final boarding call.

title: Chrysalis
line: Well, I'd better go.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: A little lower. Lower. Lower.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: How's that?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I hope this taught you a lesson.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: What's that?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Never play springball against a changeling.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Just for that, next time I'm not going to let you win a single game.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Then you'd better work on your backhand.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Right now, all I want to do is sleep for two or three days.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Go right ahead, I should be back by the time you wake up.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Back? From where?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I received a coded message from Gul Russol this morning.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Gul Russol? I thought he was executed when Cardassia joined the Dominion.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: So did I, but apparently we were wrong. The message says he wants to meet with me.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Why?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I don't know, but he's my most reliable Cardassian informant.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You mean he was. What if Russol is dead and this is just a trap?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I've thought about that, but I have to be sure. I owe him that much.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Want me to come with you?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Russol insists I come alone. Don't worry, Nerys. I'll be careful.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Worried? Ha. This just gives me more time to work on my backhand.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Chief, how much longer is the Promenade going to be closed? My bar is empty, my waiters are bored and I'm losing money.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Leave me alone, Quark or I'll feed you to one of those plasma conductors.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Are you threatening me?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: We're working as fast as we can.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: As spokesman for the Promenade Merchant's Association, I'm going to file an official protest with Captain Sisko.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Put it in writing, Quark.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I'll go find a PADD.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: So, how much longer, Chief?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Well, we should be through here by the end of the day, sir.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Oh, I'm not talking about the Promenade, I'm talking about the Defiant. When is the gravity net going to be repaired? The last time I stepped onto the bridge, I felt ten kilos heavier.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I'm afraid it's going to take some time.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: How much time?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: About three weeks. We have to replace the graviton stabilizer.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You have three days. I'm going to take the Defiant back out on patrol and I don't want my crew getting queasy because the gravity keeps fluctuating.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: But sir, the sector quartermaster said it would take three weeks to get us a new stabilizer.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: That is your problem, Chief. Now, I'm leaving for Bajor for a conference and I want that stabilizer replaced by the time I get back. Do I make myself clear?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Yes, sir.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I don't want to sound negative, but I don't see how you're going to get the Defiant ready in three days.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Neither do I.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: This quartermaster you've been dealing with, what's his name?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Chief, Chief, Chief Willoughby.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I mean his first name.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I don't know.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Is he married?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Married? What does that have to do with getting us a graviton stabilizer?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Everything. This Chief Willoughby must get hundreds of supply requisitions every day. He can't possibly fill them all, so he puts everyone on a waiting list.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I know how he feels. I do the same thing.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Well, the secret is getting him to put you at the top of that list. The best way to do that is to form a relationship with him. Get to know the name of his wife, his children, find out what he likes to eat

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I don't have time to form a relationship with Willoughby.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I do. I can get you that stabilizer, Chief.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: In three days?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Leave everything to me.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: All right, butt don't do anything I wouldn't do.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Chief, I can't operate under those kinds of restrictions.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: At least promise me you won't do anything to get us court-martialed.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I'll try.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Nog!

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Just kidding, Chief.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Russol? Russol.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I'm afraid he couldn't be here.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Weyoun.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Founder. It is an honor to stand in your presence once again.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Where's Gul Russol?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I'm afraid the Cardassian Central Command had him put to death almost a year ago. I regret having to deceive you, but it was the only way I could think of to get you here.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Well, I'm here. What do you want?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: To serve you. I no longer consider myself a member of the Dominion.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You're defecting?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Do with me as you wish. I place my fate entirely in your hands.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You don't believe me, do you?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I believe Gul Russol is dead. You say you're defecting from the Dominion. Why?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Founder, please.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I've told you before I'm not a Founder.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: As you wish. Odo, I'll tell you everything you want to know but first, we really should get aboard your runabout. The Jem'Hadar are already hunting for me and if I'm found

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You haven't answered my question. Why did you decide to defect?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I realized my place is with you.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You can do better than that.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Then let's just say I left Cardassia because my life was in danger.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: From whom?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Everyone.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Aren't you being a little paranoid?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Of course I'm paranoid. Everyone's trying to kill me.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Why?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Because this war with the Federation was supposed to have been won months ago.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Well, things don't always turn out as planned.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Quite true. And when things go wrong, someone has to take the blame. And this time, it's me. Now we really should be going. Think about it, Odo. The information I possess could help the Federation win this war.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: And you're willing to share that information?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: All you have to do is ask.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: We've heard rumors that the Dominion has established a new Ketracel White storage facility somewhere in Sector five zero seven.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: The facility's located in the Pelosa system. I can supply you with the exact coordinates.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Odo to the Rio Grande. Two to beam up.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Sit here where I can keep an eye on you.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: If it makes you feel better. But you should know I would never harm a god.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I'm not a god, I'm a security officer. As far as I'm concerned, you're just another prisoner.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You have no idea how much it hurts me to hear you say that.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I spoke to Edgar.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Edgar who?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Your new best friend, Chief Edgar Willoughby. He wanted me to thank you for that bottle of Gamzian wine you sent him.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I didn't send him any wine.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I took the liberty of sending it for you. By the way, his wife's name is Cynthia. They have a daughter, Melissa, age eight and a son, Edgar junior, aged five.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Did you get the stabilizer?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Not quite.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: What do you mean, not quite?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Unfortunately, he's out of stabilizers and won't be getting a new shipment for another week.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: That's it. I'm doomed.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Not necessarily. Eddie told me the USS Sentinel has an extra stabilizer.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: What makes you think they're going to give it to us?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I didn't say they were going to give it to us. But they might be willing to trade for it.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Trade? For what?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Depends on what they need and what we have.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Well, I suppose it doesn't hurt to try. But remember, be discreet.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Rule of Acquisition one sixty eight, whisper your way to success.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Words to live by.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Chief, one more thing. I need your authorisation code.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: What for?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: The shipping orders.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Bring them to me and I'll authorize them.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I just thought it would save time. When did you say the Captain was going to be back?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Stop looking so worried, Chief. I've got it all under control.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I sure hope so.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I wish you'd stop doing that.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Doing what?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Staring at me.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Was I? I didn't mean to.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You've been doing it for the last ten hours.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I'm sorry. It's just such an honor to be sitting here with a security officer.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: We're being hailed.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Don't respond.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: It's a Cardassian transmission.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Scramble the comm. frequencies so they can't lock onto us.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I'm trying.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Founder. It's an honor to speak with you once again. You look surprised to see me, Odo.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I'm well aware the Vorta are all clones, but I'm not sure the universe is ready for two Weyouns.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I couldn't agree more.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: So which of you is the Weyoun I've had the misfortune of dealing with over the past few years?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Actually, neither of us.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: That was Weyoun Five. Our illustrious predecessor was killed a month ago.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: And I had the honor of replacing him.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: What a sad day that was

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: For the Dominion. Weyoun Five was a great man. A true patriot. His death in a transporter accident was most unfortunate.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: And still under investigation.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: A very thorough investigation that has found no evidence of foul play.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Interesting, So if you're Weyoun Six, you must be Seven.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Clones. Keeping track of them is a full time job.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: And why were you activated if he's still alive?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Normally I wouldn't have been, but when a clone is found to be defective

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I'm not defective!

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Of course

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You are. What other explanation is there for your behavior? Leaving your post. Defecting to the enemy.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Are you calling Odo your enemy?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Absolutely not.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I was referring to the Federation, as you're well aware.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Enough bickering. Order him to trigger his implant.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I was getting to that.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: What implant?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Like all Vorta, I have a termination implant in my brain stem.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Prove your loyalty to the Founders. Activate it.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: The only Founder I'm loyal to is Odo, and he wants me alive.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I told you it was a waste of time to try to reason with him. You're a dead man, whether you activate that implant or not. That ship will never make it back to Deep Space Nine.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Founder, there's really no need for you to be involved in this petty dispute. If you'll just hold your position until one of our ships can reach you

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I have no intention of releasing my prisoner to you.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: If you don't, I can't be responsible for the consequences.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: That's an empty threat. He wouldn't dare harm a Founder.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Maybe he won't, but I will. Think it over, Shape shifter. One of our attack ships is on the way.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Forgive me, Odo I should've told you the truth about myself.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Well, it's not too late to start. Why did you defect?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: It's simple really. From the moment I was activated, I felt this war was wrong. Please don't misunderstand me, I still worship the Founders, but I believe their obsession with conquering the Alpha Quadrant is misguided. It's time they learned to live in peace with the Solids. I know it's not my place to question the Founders. Maybe Weyoun Seven is right. I am defective.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: On the contrary. What you're saying about the war, about the Founders, makes perfect sense.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I want to thank you, Odo, for the way you stood up for me, protected me.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Well don't let it go to your head. I'd do the same for any prisoner.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Of course you would. You're a god.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: To think a Weyoun could be capable of such treachery.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I knew there was something wrong with him from the moment we met. He lacked your appetite for cruelty.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: He's a disgrace to me and all Vorta. Though I suppose he can't be held completely responsible for his behavior. The Vorta cloning process is a very delicate one. Every once in a while a clone is found to be defective. It's never happened to a Weyoun before, but it does happen. And speaking of treachery, there is still the little matter of the death of Weyoun Five.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You really believe I had something to do with that?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You were supposed to be on that transporter pad with him.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I was called away. An urgent meeting with the Central Command.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: How convenient.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I always was lucky. Are you sure I can't interest you in a glass of kanar?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I'm afraid our problems won't be washed away quite that easily.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I don't know what you're so concerned about. Odo couldn't possibly hope to outrun a Jem'Hadar attack ship.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: But what if he refuses to hand over his prisoner?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Then he'll die.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: He will not. We can't kill a Founder. I forbid it.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Unless we stop them, Odo is going to take your predecessor back to the Federation, where he will undoubtedly reveal all he knows, all you know, about our strategic operations. You know what that means, don't you?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: It means we could lose the war.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: That's right. And I will not allow that to happen. Cardassia has risked too much, suffered too much. I will not stand by and let all of our plans, all of our dreams for the future, end in defeat just to spare the life of one Shape shifter.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I don't believe the Jem'Hadar would want to fire on Odo, even if they were ordered to.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: They don't need to know he's on board. You simply order them to destroy the runabout.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I suppose it could work. But if the Founders ever found out that we were responsible for Odo's death.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Who's going to tell them?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Odo doesn't even consider himself a Founder.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Then we agree. The runabout must be destroyed. Excellent. Now I really think you should try a little kanar.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Morning, Lieutenant.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I'd make myself scarce if I were you.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Why?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Chief! In here now.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I tried to warn you.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Do you mind explaining this?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Where's the Captain's desk?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Oh, you don't know? This is your authorisation code, isn't it?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Nog.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: What about him?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Well, he must have traded the Captain's desk for the graviton stabilizer.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Excuse me?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Don't worry, Colonel. I will get the desk back.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You're damn right you will. The Captain is returning from Bajor in two days, and when he does, I want his desk sitting right here where it belongs.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Don't worry, Chief. I didn't give away the Captain's desk. I just loaned it to someone.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Who?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Al Lorenzo.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Who's Al Lorenzo?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: The Chief of Operations on Decos Prime.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: What does he want with the Captain's desk?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: He wants to take a picture of it.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Why?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: He likes to collect holophotos of himself sitting behind the desks of famous Starfleet captains. Usually he just sneaks into their offices, but with the war on it's been hard for him to get away.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Ha. Well that makes sense.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: He's got quite a collection. Captain DeSoto's desk, Captain Picard's desk.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Okay, fine. So once he has his picture, he's going to send us the graviton stabilizer?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: No. He's giving us an induction modulator.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: But we don't need an induction modulator.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: But the USS Musashi does.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Ah. So the Musashi's going to send us the stabilizer.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: No, they're giving us a phaser emitter.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: We don't need a phaser emitter.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I know, but the USS Sentinel does, and they have the extra stabilizer.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: And they're willing to give it up for a phaser emitter?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: That's the rumor.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Rumor? You've made all of these deals based on a rumor?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: From a very reliable source.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: But what if it turns out not to be true?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You have to have faith, Chief.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: In a rumor?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: No, in the Great Material Continuum.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Who are they?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: It's not a they, it's the force that binds the universe together.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I must have missed that class in Engineering School.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: On Ferenginar, we learn about the Continuum while we still have our first set of ears.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: This is no time for Ferengi fairy tales.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: The Continuum is real. You see, there are millions upon millions of worlds in the universe, each one filled with too much of one thing and not enough of another. And the Great Continuum flows through them all like a mighty river, from have to want and back again. And if we navigate the Continuum with skill and grace, our ship will be filled with everything our hearts desire.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Right now, I'd settle for a stabilizer and the Captain's desk.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: The river will provide.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: If it doesn't sink us first.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Odo?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: What's wrong?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I think I was dreaming.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Sounded more like a nightmare.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I was on Earth, Starfleet Headquarters. I was supposed to report for my debriefing, but I couldn't find the right office. Then I started calling your name, but you didn't answer. And then suddenly I was being chased by some Jem'Hadar. Or were they Klingons? Silly, isn't it?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Not at all. It isn't easy to turn your back on your own people. Believe me, I know.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Odo, do you think Starfleet would allow you to conduct my debriefing?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Possibly.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: It would make it much easier.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: What is it?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Trouble.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I can't believe they're firing on us.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Trust me, they are.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: But the Jem'Hadar would never obey an order to harm a Founder.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Maybe they finally got it through their head that I'm not a Founder.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Or they don't know who they're firing at. We've got to let them know you're on board.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: They're jamming all the frequencies. I can't get through.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: They've been ordered not to communicate with us.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Damar said he was determined not to let us get back to the station.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: See if you can get above them.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Why?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I'll explain later. Just do it.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: What now?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Lock phasers on their dorsal field junction. Their shields are weakest there.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Well, congratulations. You just saved our lives.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: And murdered loyal servants of the Dominion. May the Founders forgive me.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Has it ever occurred to you that the reason you believe the Founders are gods is because that's what they want you to believe? That they built that into your genetic code?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Of course they did. That's what gods do. After all, why be a god if there's no one to worship you?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Rom, where's Nog?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I don't know, Chief. Nog left the station a couple of hours ago in a runabout.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Who gave him permission to use a runabout?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You did.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I never should've given him my authorisation code. Did he say when he'd be back?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Not to me.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: How could he do this to me? How could he leave me adrift, mid-river without a paddle?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: What river would that be?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You know, the Great Material Continuum.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Oh. That river. It can be very treacherous.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Tell me about it. I suppose the good news is with Nog gone, nothing else can go missing.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Where are my cases of bloodwine!

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I do not know, General. But I promise you I will find out.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I don't understand it. How could a runabout destroy a Jem'Hadar fighter?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Isn't it obvious? My predecessor must have helped Odo get past the ship's defenses.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Then how do we stop them?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: How else? Send more ships. Send a whole battalion if necessary, from our base at Olmerak.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Consider it done.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Remember to tell them to fire on sight.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Fire at whom?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Founder, how may I serve you?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: By answering my question.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: We spotted a Federation runabout spying on our base in the Olmerak system.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Surely one ship shouldn't be much of a threat.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: We'll have it destroyed within the hour.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Are you feeling all right?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Why do you ask?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Your face.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I'm fine. But from now on, I want the temperature in these rooms lowered by fifteen degrees. I do not share the Cardassians' love of heat.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Nor do I. Lower the temperature.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: As you wish.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Is there anything else I can do for you?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Have you located Weyoun Six?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: It's only a matter of time.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: So you keep saying.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I assure you, Founder. He will be dealt with.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Did you notice her face? How parched it looked?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You heard her. These rooms are too hot.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I wonder. I'm telling you she's not well.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: She's not the Founder you should be worried about. Contact Olmerak and order those ships to intercept the runabout.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: That was filling.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I would hope so. You sampled the replicator's entire menu.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I enjoyed the different textures.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You mean tastes, don't you?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Not at all. The Vorta sense of taste is quite limited. About the only foods we really enjoy are kava nuts and rippleberries.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Ah. I take it this is also a result of your genetic programming?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: It's the Founders' way of making sure we remember our past. You must know the story of how the Founders created the Vorta?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: No, but I have the feeling you're going to tell me all about it.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: The Vorta used to be quite different from what we are today. We were forest dwellers. Small, timid, ape-like creatures living in hollowed out trees.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Eating nuts and berries.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: And living in fear of the many predators that would hunt us for food. One day, a wounded changeling came stumbling through the forest fleeing from a mob of angry solids.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Why were they chasing him?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: What does it matter? Solids have always feared and distrusted shape-shifters, you know that. Well, a family of Vorta hid the changeling from his pursuers. And in return for saving his life, the changeling promised the Vorta that one day we would be transformed into powerful beings. That we would become an important part of a great new empire that would stretch across the Galaxy.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: And the changeling kept his word.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: That's right. Imagine, Odo. My people were once little more than apes, and look at us now. Look at what you've done for us.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: If the story were true, it would at least prove that my people are capable of generosity and kindness.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You care about your people very much, don't you, Odo? In spite of all that's happened between you.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Maybe I do, but that doesn't change the fact that they're responsible for a war that's killed millions.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Odo, there's something you need to know. A sickness has spread throughout the Great Link. The Founders are dying. I was summoned to a meeting by the female changeling. She wanted to discuss troop deployments with me, and suddenly her hands began to shrivel. It lasted only a second or two, but over the last few weeks, it's happened a number of times. It's like she's withering.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: And you're sure the other changelings are also infected?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: She said the entire Link is suffering from the disease.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Everyone but me.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: If they're unable to find a cure, you'll be the last of your kind.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Why didn't you tell me this earlier?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Because I knew how much it would hurt you. I'm sorry to bring you such sad news. But at least you're not infected. The Dominion will survive.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Meaning what?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Think about it, Odo. You have an opportunity to rectify the mistakes your people have made. To build a new Dominion based on cooperation, not conquest. On peace, not war. A new order under your leadership.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: And what's your role going to be in this new order?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Whatever you want it to be. I wish only to serve you.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: All right, and you can start by telling me how one runabout is going to survive an assault by four Jem'Hadar ships.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I'm sure you'll think of something.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: There's a Kuiper Belt not far from here. We might be able to hide among the comet fragments. But we don't have much time. They're closing fast.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: These comet fragments are nothing but huge chunks of ice. The Jem'Hadar will have no trouble finding us.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Not if we become the ice.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Well, with the power off and the runabout in thermal contact with the ice, we won't generate enough of an energy signature for their sensors to read.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: We become the ice. Only a god could think of such a thing.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Well let's just hope the Jem'Hadar give up their search before we freeze to death.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: My faith will keep me warm.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Perhaps. But in an hour you may want to trade in that faith for a thermal blanket.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: What do you think?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: It's white.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I know it's white. I'm going to paint it.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: It's the wrong shape, it's the wrong height, the wrong width. Other than that, it's perfect. The Captain will never suspect you switched desks on him.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Julian, I need help, not sarcasm.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I'm afraid Nog's the only one who can help you now.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: If he gets back to the station before the Captain does.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Maybe he's not coming back. Maybe he'd decided to make a run for it.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: That isn't the Captain's desk.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: He's going to paint it.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Get it out of here.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Can I help you, General?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: No. But he can.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Bloodwine?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Sixteen cases, sent to me by my wife. Now where are they?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: How should I know?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You authorized their removal. That is your authorisation code, is it not?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Nog.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Chief, I want that bloodwine back here by tomorrow. Understood?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Odo, when you said you were cutting power to all systems did that include life support?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I'm afraid so.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Ah. That explains it.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Explains what?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Why I'm having trouble breathing.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: We should have enough oxygen left for another three hours. Of course, by then we'll have probably frozen to death.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: But you can't die. You have to survive to rebuild the Dominion.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: They've found us.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: What do we do now?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: We can't stay here.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You're not going to try to outrun those ships, are you?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: What choice do we have?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: We're on fire.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: There's an extinguisher behind you. What are you waiting for?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I live only to serve you.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: What are you doing? Why'd you activate the comm. system?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: All right, call off those ships.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Why should I?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Because you don't need them anymore. Weyoun Six places his index finger behind his ear and his thumb under his chin, then applies pressure. He collapses.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I'm glad to see you've come to your senses.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: What have you done?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I've saved your life and the Dominion's as well.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: He's activated his termination implant and proven himself to be a worthy Vorta at last.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I obey the Founders in all things. Now call off those ships!

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: We don't know what he told Odo. He may have revealed important tactical

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: That's a risk we'll just have to take. I've ordered the Jem'Hadar to break off the attack. I see your runabout has suffered some battle damage. Will you require

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Any further assistance?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I think you've done enough.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I sincerely regret any inconvenience we may have caused you, Odo. Please have a safe and pleasant journey back to Deep Space Nine.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: They say voluntary termination is quick and painless. I'm afraid it's not true.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I'll get you a pain suppressor.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: That won't be necessary but there is one thing you can do for me.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: What's that?

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Give me your blessing.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I can't.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Please, Odo. Tell me that I haven't failed, that I've served you well.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: You have. And for that you have my gratitude, and my blessing.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Miles, the Captain's back.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: I know. He sent for me.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Good luck.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Thanks.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Ah, Chief.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Captain, your desk

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Yes, it looks nice, doesn't it? I came in this morning and found Ensign Nog polishing it.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: It was looking a little dull.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Well, here is the maintenance request from the Gettysburg. It should be docking here later today. That'll be all.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Yes, sir.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River
line: Oh, about the stabilizer.

title: Treachery, Faith and the Great River

line: The Orantho's Captain and First Officer are dead, and the Slivin's deflector is damaged. It cannot generate a graviton burst. And the Ning'tao's Captain is too young and inexperienced. I am the logical choice.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Things with the company.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: No offense, Norvo, but you're not exactly holding the company together. Mother can pay a real accountant to do the work she's given you.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I don't know, Zee.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Well think about it.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: You're right. The problem's definitely in the secondary input transtator.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: But the transtator checks out perfectly.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I'm sure it does, but it's the wrong transtator for this drill.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: What?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: You need a fifty two J, this is a fifty two L.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: It says fifty two J.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I know. But it's definitely an L. It must've been accidently mislabeled.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Or deliberately.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Another equipment failure? Perhaps if you hadn't dismissed Mister Lorkin, this wouldn't have happened.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: He was dismissed on my Mother's personal order.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Then we'll have to find a way of changing her mind, won't we. Who's your new mechanic, Janel?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: This is Mister O'Brien. He's a friend of the family.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: That wouldn't be Chief O'Brien, would it?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: How did you know that?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I have several friends in the New Sydney Police. I heard they recently rescued a Starfleet Chief named O'Brien from an unpleasant situation.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: That's me. I don't believe I caught your name.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Thadial Bokar. I'm a commodities broker, attempting to establish business ties with the illustrious Tigan family.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Will you excuse us for a moment, Chief? Mister Bokar and I have some business to discuss. Thank you for your help. I'll have a new transtator installed right away.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Glad to do it.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Sabotaging our drills isn't going to convince me to do more business with the Orion Syndicate.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: We'll argue about that later. We have more immediate concerns. O'Brien is with Starfleet Intelligence.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: No, he isn't. He works with my sister on Deep Space Nine.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: That may be what he wants you to think. But why was he on New Sydney trying to infiltrate the Syndicate?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: He was looking for some woman.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Some woman. Do you know the name of this woman?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: No.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Well I do. Her name was Morica Bilby.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: What?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Now, of course, I haven't heard from Morica Bilby in quite some time. Tumor has it that she's dead, but I wouldn't know anything about that. What I do know is that Chief O'Brien should leave this system, quickly, before something happens to him.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: So, you're not leaving until tomorrow?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Probably. It really depends on Ezri.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Why?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Well, she's my superior officer. I go when she goes. Besides, I'm not looking forward to seeing Captain Sisko. He has a boot with my name on it.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: This isn't a good time for guests. There's a lot of work to do. The quicker you're on your way, the better.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Your brother seems eager to get rid of us.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Oh, don't mind him. He's been under a lot of pressure.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Do you know a man named Thadial Bokar? Says he's a commodities broker.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: No. But I make it a point to know as little as possible about the family business. Why?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Well, he came to the mine to talk with Janel while I was working on the drill. There was something about him reminded me of when I was working undercover with the Orion Syndicate. You know, something about the way they dealt with civilians.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: You think this Mister Bokar is a member of the Syndicate?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: It's just a feeling. A pretty strong feeling.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: We should tell Janel.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I think Janel already knows. I know I'm not offering you any hard evidence here, Lieutenant, but your brother seems like a man who's being pressured by the Syndicate. He's experiencing sudden equipment breakdowns, work stoppages, mysterious accidents. That's the way the Syndicate extorts money from legitimate companies. 'Do business with us or we'll ruin you.'

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Janel is not someone who is easily intimidated. And my mother? She would burn this place to the ground before she did business with the Syndicate.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Well, there's one way to find out. Do you have access to the company's financial records?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: What would you do on Deep Space Nine?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Take a vacation. Clear my head.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Clear your head of what?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I don't know.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Then why do you need a vacation?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I guess I don't, really. I just. But it'd be nice to spend some time with Ezri

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: You're spending time with her right now, aren't you?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Yes.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: We're ready to open twenty five beta.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I'll be right there. Norvo, this is a very bad time for you to take a vacation. We have far too much work to do. Have you finished the review?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Almost.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Well then, maybe you should get to it.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Yes, ma'am.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Let's go.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Now I remember why I never went into the family business. All these contracts and invoices, balance sheets and shipping orders. I feel like I'm trapped in some kind of Ferengi nightmare. What? What is it?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I don't know. What's going on here?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: What do you mean?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Did you come here to find me or to prevent me finding out the truth?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I don't know what you're talking about, so maybe you should just tell me, Chief.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: The connection between the Orion Syndicate and your family is Morica Bilby. She was on the company's payroll when she died. Did you know about this?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: No. Of course not.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Someone in your family did, and since they didn't mention it they obviously don't want us to know.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Are you suggesting

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I'm not suggesting anything, but you have to face the possibility that somebody in your family may have been involved in her death.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: There. Nine months ago, Morica Bilby shows up on the payroll as a shipping consultant.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Five bars of latinum a week for services rendered. What services? There's no cross reference. No indication of what she was doing for the company.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Whatever it was, she must have been good at the job. Look here. Her salary increases to ten bars a week, then twenty, then thirty.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: The last payment entry was six weeks ago.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: The day before she was killed. Who's in charge of the payroll?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: My mother, ultimately. But she's turned over most of the day to day operations to Janel, and Norvo's been doing the bookkeeping. Any one of them could know about Morica's payments. Or all of them.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Lieutenant, we have to show this to the authorities on New Sydney.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Not yet. Not until I find out what's happened. That's an order.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Yes, sir.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Why was this woman on our payroll?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: We were returning a favor.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: To whom?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: To the Orion Syndicate.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: And what favor did they do for us?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Remember when the Ferengis opened up the Timor Two mine and there was a ten point drop in the price of pergium? Well, that came at a bad moment. We were overextended on some loans, our cash reserves were depleted, and a Jem'Hadar raid destroyed an entire shipment before it reached the refinery on Rigel Four.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: So you turned to the Syndicate?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: They came to me! They offered us a way out and I took it. I did what I had to do. And I don't remember you asking a lot of questions when our cash problems were resolved overnight.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Because I trusted you. Obviously it was a mistake.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: What about Morica?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: About a month after Bokar arranged the loan, he came to me and said it was time to return the favor. There was a woman who needed a job with a salary, but without any actual work involved. He said she was the widow of one of their associates and they needed to take care of her. I didn't feel like I was in a position to say no. So I started making the payments. No one would've been the wiser if Norvo had altered the payroll records like I asked him.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: You dragged your little brother into this?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: You're the one who says there's nothing more important than the company. Well, that's all I was thinking about. The company. You dumped it in my lap and I saved it, so don't start complaining now. if it weren't for me, we would have been finished.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Don't you rationalize what you've done.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: All right! All right! We can talk about who saved what later. Right now, we have to concentrate on what happened to Morica. The payroll records show a steady increase in her payments. Why?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: She wasn't happy with her salary. She said the Syndicate had promised her a comfortable living and she wasn't comfortable on what we were paying her.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: How did she die?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I don't know.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Janel, if you have anything to do with this, now is the time to speak.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: What are you saying? That I had her killed?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I'm asking.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Mother, he wouldn't have killed her.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: You stay out of this. Listen to me. I will get you the very best solicitor on New Sydney, but you must tell me the truth.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I didn't kill her.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Oh, Janel, why don't I believe you? Why don't I believe that this woman just happened to die at the exact moment she was pressuring you for more money?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Why won't you listen to him? He didn't do it.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I may not have shed any tears when I found out she was dead, but I didn't kill her.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Then who did?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: The police said it was an accident!

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Norvo, you don't know what happened to Morica, do you?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I'm the idiot brother. How would I know?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Tell me you don't know anything about this.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I tried to reason with her, but she was very angry. Angry at the Syndicate, angry at us. Even angry at her husband for getting himself killed. I didn't go there to kill her, Zee. I really didn't. But she wouldn't listen to me. She started yelling, said that our family was just as bad as the Syndicate. That we were all liars and cheats. And then suddenly I realized that if she were dead all of our problems would go away.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Oh, Norvo.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I took care of it. You always said that I was too weak to handle the tough ones. I'm not. I proved it. I handled a problem that you couldn't. I handled it.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I need to inspect the ore samples from fifty three C. We have to make a decision on whether to open up a new

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Janel, forget about the mine. It doesn't matter. I want you to listen to me. After Norvo's trial is over, you need to go.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Go where?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: It doesn't matter. Just go. Find another life for yourself. Trust me. You'll be happier.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: They've taken Norvo. I'm going to stay on New Sydney for the trial and then I'm going to head back to Deep Space Nine.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: This isn't my fault, is it, Ezri? I didn't do this, did I?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Mind if I join you? When'd you get back?

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: Last night. Norvo was sentenced to thirty years.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I wish I could say I'm sorry, but considering what he did he got off easy.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: I understand why you feel that way. But you didn't know him, Miles. Norvo was very gifted. When we were young he had so much potential. Norvo was always the one that we all thought would be something special. And I don't know what happened. I don't know how my brother turned into. You know, I guess I just spent so many years dreaming of ways to get out of that house that I didn't see what was really going on inside, what was happening to Norvo. The endless humiliation, the constant drumbeat of criticism, the way his heart was carved up into little pieces. I should have seen it. I should have tried to stop it.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: You can't blame yourself. You're not responsible for that.

title: Prodigal Daughter
line: But I am, don't you see? I should have gone home a long time ago.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: Have you ever seen anything so disgusting? The way he's undressing her with his eyes. And look at his hands.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: What about his hands?

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: His gestures. They're obscene. You should arrest him.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: You're joking.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: He's pitiful. Doesn't he realize she loves me?

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: I don't think he does. To be honest, I don't think she does either.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: Thanks for your support.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: Brother! I just talked to Moogie. She says Grand Nagus Zek has disappeared.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: What do you mean, disappeared?

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: He left her a note saying he was going on a business safari to open new territories for financial exploitation.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: That's our Nagus.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: He said he'd be back in five days. That was twelve days ago!

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: Twelve?

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: Has he done this before?

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: Not for this long. Moogie did some checking. No one's heard from him. He could be hurt or even dead. We have to do something!

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: He probably stopped off on Risa. You know, for a little rest and relaxation.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: Risa? With all those gorgeous women? He wouldn't do that to Moogie.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: Have you looked at our mother lately? She's not getting any younger. Now do us both a favor and stop worrying about Zek. He'll show up.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: Are you sure?

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: Goodbye, Rom. Goodbye. Where'd Ezri go?

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: Oh, she slipped out the back with Bashir.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: They left together?

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: I think they were holding hands.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: Oh.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: Blessed Exchequer, whose greed is eternal. Allow this humble bribe to open your ears and hear this plea from your most devout debtor. Continue to bless my bar with a steady stream of thirsty customers whose pockets are lined with latinum, and whose skills at dabo are shaky at best. And while you're at it, see if you can do something about Doctor Bashir. Don't hurt him or anything, just get him off the station for a couple of months. Oh, and one other thing. I opened negotiations with Ezri three months ago, but I can't seem to close the deal. Anything you can do to help

line: Come in. Ezri.

line: I don't know what you think is going on here, but think again.

line: Don't tell me. This is some new kind of therapy? Am I suppose to start talking about my childhood or something?

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: I hope not.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: Good, because I'd rather talk about us. Dax, Dax, you're the most fascinating woman I've ever met. I love you. There. I said it!

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: My name's not Dax.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: Oh, I get it. Your clothes, the knife, this aggressive attitude. It's all role playing. Call me Shmun.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: Shmun?

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: Yeah. And I'll call you T'lana. You know, from 'Vulcan Love Slave' Volume Three.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: You're a very confused man, aren't you? If your friend Zek is depending on you, he's in a lot more trouble than he thinks.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: Zek? What does he have to do with any of this?

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: I'll let him explain.

line: Hello, Quark. It's me, your Grand Nagus. You'll never guess where I am.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: Risa?

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: If you said Risa, guess again. I'm in the alternate universe!

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: You're not my Dax. You're from over there.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: You're catching on.

title: The Emperor's New Cloak
line: You're probably wondering how I got here well, you're going to have to keep on wondering, because I don't have time to tell you. You see, I'm in a bit of trouble. line: He should've gone to Risa.

line: Watch the steps.

line: I see them, brother. I told you cloaking the cloaking device was a good idea.

line: No. But if it makes you feel any better, the cloaking device on the Defiant is a lot heavier.

line: Tell it to my hernia.

line: You know what's bothering me? It seems wrong to be stealing a cloaking device for the Alliance.

line: But what about this other Ezri? She's a Trill.

line: So?

line: So, shouldn't she be with the rebels fighting against the Alliance?

line: Be sure to point that out when you meet her. Just don't forget, she carries a knife. Shh. Someone's coming. Set it down, quick.

line: I'm telling you, Captain, we have to find a way to expand our lines beyond the Kalandra system.

line: One thing's for sure, their personalities aren't identical. How do we know the Regent will keep his word and send Zek back to us?

line: Ferengi! I'll have you hanging by your ears.
